bayesDREAM.io.summary

Summary export for bayesDREAM results.

Exports model results as R-friendly CSV files with:

  • Median and 95% credible intervals for all parameters
  • Cell-wise and feature-wise summaries
  • Observed log2FC, predicted log2FC, inflection points for trans fits
  • Derivative roots and function classification

Supports three function types:

  • additive_hill: Two Hill components with independent weights
  • single_hill: Single Hill function with optional weight
  • polynomial: Polynomial in x with configurable degree

  51    def _build_x_range_from_x_true(self, x_true: np.ndarray, n_grid: int = 2000, eps: float = 1e-6) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, float, float]:
  52        """
  53        Build a dense x grid spanning observed x_true range, spaced evenly in log2(x).
  54        Returns x_range and (x_obs_min, x_obs_max).
  55        """
  56        x_true = np.asarray(x_true, dtype=float)
  57        x_obs_min = max(np.nanmin(x_true), eps)
  58        x_obs_max = np.nanmax(x_true)
  59        if not np.isfinite(x_obs_min) or not np.isfinite(x_obs_max) or x_obs_max <= x_obs_min:
  60            # fallback to a sane range if degenerate
  61            x_obs_min = eps
  62            x_obs_max = 1.0
  63    
  64        # Create evenly spaced points in log2 space for derivative root finding
  65        log2_min = np.log2(x_obs_min)
  66        log2_max = np.log2(x_obs_max)
  67        
  68        # widen slightly so bracketing doesn’t fail right at the edges
  69        pad = 0.25  # in log2 units (~19% each side); tweak if you want
  70        x_range = 2.0 ** np.linspace(log2_min - pad, log2_max + pad, 6000)
  71        return x_range, x_obs_min, x_obs_max

  73    def _single_hill_derivative_roots(
  74        self,
  75        alpha: float,
  76        Vmax: float,
  77        K: float,
  78        n: float,
  79        x_range: np.ndarray,
  80        compute_third: bool = True
  81    ) -> Tuple[List[float], List[float], List[float]]:
  82        """
  83        Find derivative roots for single Hill function: y(x) = A + alpha * Vmax * x^n / (K^n + x^n)
  84
  85        Since dy/dx = alpha * dHill/dx, roots of dy/dx are roots of dHill/dx (when alpha != 0).
  86
  87        Parameters
  88        ----------
  89        alpha : float
  90            Weight/scale factor
  91        Vmax : float
  92            Hill amplitude
  93        K : float
  94            Half-max concentration
  95        n : float
  96            Hill coefficient
  97        x_range : np.ndarray
  98            Grid of x values to search for roots
  99        compute_third : bool
 100            Whether to compute third derivative roots
 101
 102        Returns
 103        -------
 104        roots_d1 : List[float]
 105            First derivative roots (where dy/dx = 0)
 106        roots_d2 : List[float]
 107            Second derivative roots (where d²y/dx² = 0, inflection points)
 108        roots_d3 : List[float]
 109            Third derivative roots (where d³y/dx³ = 0)
 110        """
 111        # if alpha is (numerically) zero, y is flat -> all derivatives are ~0; roots are ill-defined.
 112        if not np.isfinite(alpha) or abs(alpha) < 1e-12:
 113            return [], [], []
 114    
 115        def d1(x):
 116            return alpha * self._hill_first_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n)
 117    
 118        def d2(x):
 119            return alpha * self._hill_second_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n)
 120    
 121        roots1 = self._find_roots_empirical(d1, x_range)
 122        roots2 = self._find_roots_empirical(d2, x_range)
 123    
 124        roots3 = []
 125        if compute_third:
 126            def d3(x):
 127                return alpha * self._hill_third_derivative(x, Vmax, K, n)
 128            roots3 = self._find_roots_empirical(d3, x_range)
 129    
 130        return roots1, roots2, roots3
 131

 133    # Polynomial Derivative Helpers
 134    # ========================================================================
 135
 136    def _poly_derivative_coefs(self, coefs_asc: np.ndarray, order: int) -> np.ndarray:
 137        """
 138        Given polynomial coefficients in ascending order:
 139            p(x) = sum_{i=0}^d c[i] x^i
 140        Return coefficients of the 'order'-th derivative, also ascending.
 141        """
 142        c = np.asarray(coefs_asc, dtype=float).copy()
 143        for _ in range(order):
 144            if c.size <= 1:
 145                return np.array([0.0], dtype=float)
 146            # derivative: new_c[i-1] = i * c[i] for i>=1
 147            c = np.array([i * c[i] for i in range(1, c.size)], dtype=float)
 148        return c
 149    
 150    
 151    def _poly_eval(self, x: np.ndarray, coefs_asc: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
 152        """
 153        Evaluate polynomial with ascending coefs at x (vectorized).
 154        """
 155        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
 156        c = np.asarray(coefs_asc, dtype=float)
 157        # Horner's method (ascending -> reverse for Horner)
 158        y = np.zeros_like(x, dtype=float)
 159        for a in c[::-1]:
 160            y = y * x + a
 161        return y
 162    
 163    
 164    def _poly_derivative_roots(
 165        self,
 166        coefs_asc: np.ndarray,
 167        x_range: np.ndarray,
 168        compute_third: bool = True
 169    ) -> Tuple[List[float], List[float], List[float]]:
 170        """
 171        Find derivative roots for polynomial: p(x) = sum_{i=0}^d coef_i * x^i
 172
 173        Uses analytic derivative coefficients and empirical root finding.
 174
 175        Parameters
 176        ----------
 177        coefs_asc : np.ndarray
 178            Coefficients in ascending order [c0, c1, ..., cd]
 179        x_range : np.ndarray
 180            Grid of x values to search for roots
 181        compute_third : bool
 182            Whether to compute third derivative roots
 183
 184        Returns
 185        -------
 186        roots_d1 : List[float]
 187            First derivative roots (where p'(x) = 0, extrema)
 188        roots_d2 : List[float]
 189            Second derivative roots (where p''(x) = 0, inflection points)
 190        roots_d3 : List[float]
 191            Third derivative roots (where p'''(x) = 0)
 192        """
 193        c1 = self._poly_derivative_coefs(coefs_asc, 1)
 194        c2 = self._poly_derivative_coefs(coefs_asc, 2)
 195        c3 = self._poly_derivative_coefs(coefs_asc, 3) if compute_third else None
 196    
 197        def d1(x):
 198            return self._poly_eval(x, c1)
 199    
 200        def d2(x):
 201            return self._poly_eval(x, c2)
 202    
 203        roots1 = self._find_roots_empirical(d1, x_range)
 204        roots2 = self._find_roots_empirical(d2, x_range)
 205    
 206        roots3 = []
 207        if compute_third:
 208            def d3(x):
 209                return self._poly_eval(x, c3)
 210            roots3 = self._find_roots_empirical(d3, x_range)
 211    
 212        return roots1, roots2, roots3

 214    def _n_effective_from_ci(self, n_mean, n_lo, n_hi):
 215        """
 216        Feature-wise rule: if 0 is inside the 95% CI, treat n as exactly 0
 217        for *all* downstream calculations.
 218        """
 219        n_mean = np.asarray(n_mean, dtype=float)
 220        n_lo = np.asarray(n_lo, dtype=float)
 221        n_hi = np.asarray(n_hi, dtype=float)
 222        zero_in_ci = (n_lo <= 0.0) & (0.0 <= n_hi)
 223        n_eff = n_mean.copy()
 224        n_eff[zero_in_ci] = 0.0
 225        return n_eff, zero_in_ci

 231    def _full_log2fc_from_extrema_and_boundaries(
 232        self,
 233        A, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
 234        beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b,
 235        x_range,
 236        eps=1e-10
 237    ):
 238        """
 239        full_log2fc = log2(y_max / y_min) over x in [0, inf] using:
 240          - boundary limits at x->0 and x->inf
 241          - interior extrema from y'(x)=0
 242    
 243        Fixes:
 244          - uses *per-feature widened* x grid that covers observed range AND EC50s
 245          - uses permissive root finder for y'
 246          - DOES NOT clamp negative y to eps (invalid for log2); ignores nonpositive candidates
 247        """
 248        # --- Hill boundary limits (handle n==0 -> constant 0.5*V) ---
 249        def hill_limit_at_0(V, n):
 250            if abs(n) < 1e-15:
 251                return 0.5 * V
 252            return V if n < 0 else 0.0
 253    
 254        def hill_limit_at_inf(V, n):
 255            if abs(n) < 1e-15:
 256                return 0.5 * V
 257            return 0.0 if n < 0 else V
 258    
 259        y0 = A + alpha * hill_limit_at_0(Vmax_a, n_a) + beta * hill_limit_at_0(Vmax_b, n_b)
 260        yinf = A + alpha * hill_limit_at_inf(Vmax_a, n_a) + beta * hill_limit_at_inf(Vmax_b, n_b)
 261    
 262        # --- Build a widened x grid for finding y' roots ---
 263        xr = np.asarray(x_range, dtype=float)
 264        xr = xr[np.isfinite(xr) & (xr > 0)]
 265        if xr.size < 2:
 266            # fallback wide grid
 267            xr = np.logspace(-8, 8, 6000)
 268    
 269        log2_min = np.log2(np.min(xr))
 270        log2_max = np.log2(np.max(xr))
 271    
 272        # include EC50s in the span
 273        if np.isfinite(K_a) and K_a > 0:
 274            log2_min = min(log2_min, np.log2(K_a))
 275            log2_max = max(log2_max, np.log2(K_a))
 276        if np.isfinite(K_b) and K_b > 0:
 277            log2_min = min(log2_min, np.log2(K_b))
 278            log2_max = max(log2_max, np.log2(K_b))
 279    
 280        # extra padding for safety (2^2 = 4x each side)
 281        pad = 2.0
 282        xgrid = 2.0 ** np.linspace(log2_min - pad, log2_max + pad, max(6000, xr.size))
 283    
 284        # --- y'(x) and roots ---
 285        def yprime(x):
 286            return self._additive_hill_first_derivative(
 287                x, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
 288                beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b
 289            )
 290    
 291        # IMPORTANT: use the permissive root finder
 292        roots = self._find_roots_empirical_loose(yprime, xgrid)
 293    
 294        # --- evaluate candidates ---
 295        ys = [y0, yinf]
 296    
 297        # always include EC50s as candidates (cheap + helps if root finding misses one)
 298        for xx in (K_a, K_b):
 299            if np.isfinite(xx) and (xx is not None) and (xx > 0):
 300                Ha = self._hill_value(xx, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a)
 301                Hb = self._hill_value(xx, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b)
 302                ys.append(A + alpha * Ha + beta * Hb)
 303    
 304        # extrema candidates
 305        for r in (roots or []):
 306            if not (np.isfinite(r) and r > 0):
 307                continue
 308            Ha = self._hill_value(r, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a)
 309            Hb = self._hill_value(r, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b)
 310            ys.append(A + alpha * Ha + beta * Hb)
 311    
 312        ys = np.asarray(ys, dtype=float)
 313    
 314        # DO NOT clamp negative/zero values for log2; those are invalid for log2(y)
 315        ys = ys[np.isfinite(ys) & (ys > eps)]
 316        if ys.size < 2:
 317            return np.nan
 318    
 319        return float(np.log2(np.max(ys) / np.min(ys)))
 320
 321    def _full_delta_p_from_extrema_and_boundaries(
 322        self,
 323        A, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
 324        beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b,
 325        x_range,
 326        eps=1e-10
 327    ):
 328        """
 329        full_delta_p = y_max - y_min over x in [0, inf] using:
 330          - boundary limits at x->0 and x->inf
 331          - interior extrema from y'(x)=0
 332
 333        For binomial distributions where delta_p = p - p_ntc.
 334        """
 335        # --- Hill boundary limits (handle n==0 -> constant 0.5*V) ---
 336        def hill_limit_at_0(V, n):
 337            if abs(n) < 1e-15:
 338                return 0.5 * V
 339            return V if n < 0 else 0.0
 340
 341        def hill_limit_at_inf(V, n):
 342            if abs(n) < 1e-15:
 343                return 0.5 * V
 344            return 0.0 if n < 0 else V
 345
 346        y0 = A + alpha * hill_limit_at_0(Vmax_a, n_a) + beta * hill_limit_at_0(Vmax_b, n_b)
 347        yinf = A + alpha * hill_limit_at_inf(Vmax_a, n_a) + beta * hill_limit_at_inf(Vmax_b, n_b)
 348
 349        # --- Build a widened x grid for finding y' roots ---
 350        xr = np.asarray(x_range, dtype=float)
 351        xr = xr[np.isfinite(xr) & (xr > 0)]
 352        if xr.size < 2:
 353            # fallback wide grid
 354            xr = np.logspace(-8, 8, 6000)
 355
 356        log2_min = np.log2(np.min(xr))
 357        log2_max = np.log2(np.max(xr))
 358
 359        # include EC50s in the span
 360        if np.isfinite(K_a) and K_a > 0:
 361            log2_min = min(log2_min, np.log2(K_a))
 362            log2_max = max(log2_max, np.log2(K_a))
 363        if np.isfinite(K_b) and K_b > 0:
 364            log2_min = min(log2_min, np.log2(K_b))
 365            log2_max = max(log2_max, np.log2(K_b))
 366
 367        # extra padding for safety (2^2 = 4x each side)
 368        pad = 2.0
 369        xgrid = 2.0 ** np.linspace(log2_min - pad, log2_max + pad, max(6000, xr.size))
 370
 371        # --- y'(x) and roots ---
 372        def yprime(x):
 373            return self._additive_hill_first_derivative(
 374                x, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
 375                beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b
 376            )
 377
 378        # IMPORTANT: use the permissive root finder
 379        roots = self._find_roots_empirical_loose(yprime, xgrid)
 380
 381        # --- evaluate candidates ---
 382        ys = [y0, yinf]
 383
 384        # always include EC50s as candidates (cheap + helps if root finding misses one)
 385        for xx in (K_a, K_b):
 386            if np.isfinite(xx) and (xx is not None) and (xx > 0):
 387                Ha = self._hill_value(xx, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a)
 388                Hb = self._hill_value(xx, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b)
 389                ys.append(A + alpha * Ha + beta * Hb)
 390
 391        # extrema candidates
 392        for r in (roots or []):
 393            if not (np.isfinite(r) and r > 0):
 394                continue
 395            Ha = self._hill_value(r, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a)
 396            Hb = self._hill_value(r, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b)
 397            ys.append(A + alpha * Ha + beta * Hb)
 398
 399        ys = np.asarray(ys, dtype=float)
 400
 401        # For delta_p, we don't require positive values (probabilities can be any value)
 402        ys = ys[np.isfinite(ys)]
 403        if ys.size < 2:
 404            return np.nan
 405
 406        return float(np.max(ys) - np.min(ys))

 408    def _full_log2fc_candidates_no_roots(
 409        self,
 410        A, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
 411        beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b,
 412        x_candidates,
 413        eps=1e-10
 414    ):
 415        """
 416        full_log2fc using only boundary limits + supplied interior candidate points.
 417        Fixes:
 418          - includes EC50s as candidates
 419          - ignores nonpositive y instead of clamping to eps
 420        """
 421        def hill_limit_at_0(V, n):
 422            if abs(n) < 1e-15:
 423                return 0.5 * V
 424            return V if n < 0 else 0.0
 425    
 426        def hill_limit_at_inf(V, n):
 427            if abs(n) < 1e-15:
 428                return 0.5 * V
 429            return 0.0 if n < 0 else V
 430    
 431        y0 = A + alpha * hill_limit_at_0(Vmax_a, n_a) + beta * hill_limit_at_0(Vmax_b, n_b)
 432        yinf = A + alpha * hill_limit_at_inf(Vmax_a, n_a) + beta * hill_limit_at_inf(Vmax_b, n_b)
 433    
 434        xs = []
 435        if x_candidates is not None:
 436            for x in x_candidates:
 437                if x is None:
 438                    continue
 439                x = float(x)
 440                if np.isfinite(x) and (x > 0):
 441                    xs.append(x)
 442    
 443        # add EC50s as cheap robust candidates
 444        for xx in (K_a, K_b):
 445            if np.isfinite(xx) and (xx is not None) and (xx > 0):
 446                xs.append(float(xx))
 447    
 448        ys = [y0, yinf]
 449        for x in xs:
 450            Ha = self._hill_value(x, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a)
 451            Hb = self._hill_value(x, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b)
 452            ys.append(A + alpha * Ha + beta * Hb)
 453    
 454        ys = np.asarray(ys, dtype=float)
 455        ys = ys[np.isfinite(ys) & (ys > eps)]
 456        if ys.size < 2:
 457            return np.nan
 458    
 459        return float(np.log2(np.max(ys) / np.min(ys)))

 461    def _observed_log2fc_candidates_no_roots(
 462        self,
 463        A, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
 464        beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b,
 465        x_obs_min, x_obs_max,
 466        x_candidates=None,
 467        eps=1e-10
 468    ):
 469        """
 470        observed_log2fc over [x_obs_min, x_obs_max] using endpoints + interior candidates.
 471        Fix: ignores nonpositive y instead of clamping.
 472        """
 473        x0 = float(max(x_obs_min, eps))
 474        x1 = float(max(x_obs_max, eps))
 475    
 476        def y_at(x):
 477            Ha = self._hill_value(x, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a)
 478            Hb = self._hill_value(x, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b)
 479            return A + alpha * Ha + beta * Hb
 480    
 481        xs = [x0, x1]
 482    
 483        if x_candidates is not None:
 484            for x in x_candidates:
 485                if x is None:
 486                    continue
 487                x = float(x)
 488                if np.isfinite(x) and (x0 <= x <= x1) and (x > 0):
 489                    xs.append(x)
 490    
 491        # also include EC50s if they fall in-window
 492        for xx in (K_a, K_b):
 493            if np.isfinite(xx) and (xx is not None) and (x0 <= xx <= x1):
 494                xs.append(float(xx))
 495    
 496        ys = np.asarray([y_at(x) for x in xs], dtype=float)
 497        ys = ys[np.isfinite(ys) & (ys > eps)]
 498        if ys.size < 2:
 499            return np.nan
 500    
 501        return float(np.log2(np.max(ys) / np.min(ys)))

 562        """
 563        observed_delta_p over [x_obs_min, x_obs_max] using endpoints + interior candidates.
 564        Returns y_max - y_min (for binomial distributions).

 567        x1 = float(max(x_obs_max, eps))

 569        def y_at(x):

 573
 574        xs = [x0, x1]
 575
 576        if x_candidates is not None:
 577            for x in x_candidates:
 578                if x is None:
 579                    continue
 580                x = float(x)
 581                if np.isfinite(x) and (x0 <= x <= x1) and (x > 0):
 582                    xs.append(x)
 583
 584        # also include EC50s if they fall in-window
 585        for xx in (K_a, K_b):
 586            if np.isfinite(xx) and (xx is not None) and (x0 <= xx <= x1):
 587                xs.append(float(xx))
 588
 589        ys = np.asarray([y_at(x) for x in xs], dtype=float)
 590        ys = ys[np.isfinite(ys)]
 591        if ys.size < 2:
 592            return np.nan
 593
 594        return float(np.max(ys) - np.min(ys))
 595
 596    def _is_flat_feature(self,
 597                         alpha_lower, alpha_upper,
 598                         beta_lower, beta_upper,
 599                         n_a_lower, n_a_upper,
 600                         n_b_lower, n_b_upper):
 601        """
 602        A feature is flat if neither Hill component is active.
 603        """
 604        dep_a = not (alpha_lower <= 0 <= alpha_upper) and not (n_a_lower <= 0 <= n_a_upper)
 605        dep_b = not (beta_lower  <= 0 <= beta_upper) and not (n_b_lower <= 0 <= n_b_upper)
 606        return not (dep_a or dep_b)
 607
 608    def _build_u_range_from_observed_x(
 609        self,
 610        x_obs_min: float,
 611        x_obs_max: float,
 612        x_ntc: float,
 613        n_grid: int = 2000,
 614        pad_u: float = 0.25,     # same idea as your pad in log2 units
 615        eps: float = 1e-10
 616    ) -> np.ndarray:
 617        x0 = max(float(x_obs_min), eps)
 618        x1 = max(float(x_obs_max), eps)
 619        xntc = max(float(x_ntc), eps)
 620    
 621        u_min = np.log2(x0) - np.log2(xntc)
 622        u_max = np.log2(x1) - np.log2(xntc)
 623    
 624        # widen slightly
 625        u = np.linspace(u_min - pad_u, u_max + pad_u, int(n_grid))
 626        return u
 627    
 628    def _g_derivs_at_u(
 629        self,
 630        u: np.ndarray,
 631        A, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
 632        beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b,
 633        x_ntc: float,
 634        eps: float = 1e-10
 635    ):
 636        """
 637        Vectorized g'(u), g''(u), g'''(u) for:
 638          g(u) = log2(y(x)) - log2(y_ntc),  x = x_ntc * 2^u
 639          y(x) = A + alpha*Ha(x) + beta*Hb(x)
 640        Uses S=y, S',S'',S''' w.r.t x and chain-rule to u.
 641    
 642        Returns: g1, g2, g3 arrays (same shape as u).
 643        """
 644        u = np.asarray(u, dtype=float)
 645        x = max(float(x_ntc), eps) * (2.0 ** u)
 646        ln2 = np.log(2.0)
 647    
 648        # S(x)
 649        # (use your stable hill_value; vectorize via np.vectorize or do explicit log-space like you did elsewhere)
 650        # We'll do explicit log-space for speed/consistency:
 651        x_safe = np.maximum(x, eps)
 652    
 653        def hill_vec(Vmax, K, n):
 654            K_safe = max(float(K), eps)
 655            n = float(n)
 656            if abs(n) < 1e-15:
 657                return np.full_like(x_safe, 0.5 * float(Vmax), dtype=float)
 658            x_n = self._exp_clip(n * np.log(x_safe))
 659            K_n = self._exp_clip(n * np.log(K_safe))
 660            return float(Vmax) * x_n / (K_n + x_n)
 661    
 662        Ha = hill_vec(Vmax_a, K_a, n_a)
 663        Hb = hill_vec(Vmax_b, K_b, n_b)
 664        S = float(A) + float(alpha) * Ha + float(beta) * Hb
 665        S = np.where(np.isfinite(S), S, np.nan)
 666    
 667        # S', S'', S''' (w.r.t x)
 668        Sp  = self._additive_hill_first_derivative(x_safe,  alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b)
 669        Spp = self._additive_hill_second_derivative(x_safe, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b)
 670        Sppp= self._additive_hill_third_derivative(x_safe,  alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b)
 671    
 672        # Guard bad S
 673        bad = ~np.isfinite(S) | (S <= eps)
 674        if np.all(bad):
 675            nan = np.full_like(u, np.nan, dtype=float)
 676            return nan, nan, nan
 677    
 678        # ratios
 679        r1 = Sp / S
 680        r2 = Spp / S
 681        r3 = Sppp / S
 682    
 683        # g'(u) = x * S'/S
 684        g1 = x_safe * r1
 685    
 686        # g''(u) = ln2 * [ x*S'/S + x^2*S''/S - x^2*(S'/S)^2 ]
 687        x2 = x_safe * x_safe
 688        g2 = ln2 * (x_safe * r1 + x2 * r2 - x2 * (r1 ** 2))
 689    
 690        # g'''(u) = (ln2)^2 * [ x*r1 + 3x^2*r2 - 3x^2*r1^2 + x^3*r3 - 3x^3*r1*r2 + 2x^3*r1^3 ]
 691        x3 = x2 * x_safe
 692        ln2_sq = ln2 * ln2
 693        g3 = ln2_sq * (x_safe * r1 + 3.0 * x2 * r2 - 3.0 * x2 * (r1 ** 2)
 694                       + x3 * r3 - 3.0 * x3 * r1 * r2 + 2.0 * x3 * (r1 ** 3))
 695    
 696        # Apply bad-mask
 697        g1 = np.where(bad, np.nan, g1)
 698        g2 = np.where(bad, np.nan, g2)
 699        g3 = np.where(bad, np.nan, g3)
 700        return g1, g2, g3
 701
 702    def _S_derivs_at_u(
 703        self,
 704        u: np.ndarray,
 705        A, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
 706        beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b,
 707        x_ntc: float,
 708        eps: float = 1e-12
 709    ):
 710        u = np.asarray(u, dtype=float)
 711        x = max(float(x_ntc), eps) * (2.0 ** u)
 712        x = np.maximum(x, eps)
 713    
 714        # S(x)
 715        Ha = np.vectorize(self._hill_value)(x, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a)
 716        Hb = np.vectorize(self._hill_value)(x, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b)
 717        S  = float(A) + float(alpha) * Ha + float(beta) * Hb
 718    
 719        # derivatives wrt x
 720        Sp   = self._additive_hill_first_derivative (x, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b, epsilon=1e-12)
 721        Spp  = self._additive_hill_second_derivative(x, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b, epsilon=1e-12)
 722        Sppp = self._additive_hill_third_derivative (x, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b, epsilon=1e-12)
 723    
 724        # log2FC is undefined if S<=0; mask these out so they don't create bracketing artifacts
 725        bad = ~np.isfinite(S) | (S <= eps)
 726        S    = np.where(bad, np.nan, S)
 727        Sp   = np.where(bad, np.nan, Sp)
 728        Spp  = np.where(bad, np.nan, Spp)
 729        Sppp = np.where(bad, np.nan, Sppp)
 730    
 731        return x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp
 732    
 733    def _find_roots_on_grid(
 734        self,
 735        func_u,
 736        u_grid,
 737        *,
 738        tol_u_dedup=1e-3,
 739        flat_atol=1e-10,
 740        flat_q=0.95,
 741        include_tangent=True,
 742        tangent_atol=None,
 743        tangent_neighbor_mult=25.0,
 744        maxiter=200,
 745    ):
 746        """
 747        Robust 1D root finder on a fixed grid:
 748          - sign-change bracketing on adjacent grid points
 749          - optional tangent roots (touching 0)
 750          - flat-curve bailout to avoid spurious/infinite roots
 751    
 752        Parameters
 753        ----------
 754        func_u : callable
 755            Vectorized: takes u array -> y array (same length).
 756        u_grid : array-like
 757            Monotone grid in u.
 758        tol_u_dedup : float
 759            Deduplicate roots closer than this in u.
 760        flat_atol : float
 761            If the function is essentially zero everywhere (robustly), return [].
 762        flat_q : float
 763            Quantile of |y| used to estimate amplitude for flatness.
 764        include_tangent : bool
 765            Also detect "touching" roots without sign change.
 766        tangent_atol : float or None
 767            Absolute tolerance for tangent detection. If None, set from robust amplitude.
 768        tangent_neighbor_mult : float
 769            Neighbors must be this many times larger than tangent_atol to accept tangent.
 770        """
 771        u = np.asarray(u_grid, dtype=float).ravel()
 772        if u.size < 3:
 773            return []
 774    
 775        y = np.asarray(func_u(u), dtype=float).ravel()
 776        if y.size != u.size:
 777            raise ValueError(f"func_u(u_grid) returned shape {y.shape}, expected {(u.size,)}")
 778    
 779        finite = np.isfinite(u) & np.isfinite(y)
 780        if finite.sum() < 3:
 781            return []
 782    
 783        # ---- flat-curve bailout (prevents "infinite roots" in near-zero curves)
 784        amp = np.nanquantile(np.abs(y[finite]), flat_q)
 785        if (not np.isfinite(amp)) or (amp < flat_atol):
 786            return []
 787    
 788        # choose tangent threshold
 789        if tangent_atol is None:
 790            tangent_atol = max(1e-12, 1e-6 * amp)
 791    
 792        def f_scalar(z):
 793            return float(np.asarray(func_u(np.array([z], dtype=float))).ravel()[0])
 794    
 795        roots = []
 796    
 797        # ---- sign-change bracketing on ADJACENT points (no deadband / no snapping)
 798        for i in range(u.size - 1):
 799            if not (np.isfinite(y[i]) and np.isfinite(y[i + 1])):
 800                continue
 801    
 802            ui, uj = u[i], u[i + 1]
 803            yi, yj = y[i], y[i + 1]
 804    
 805            # exact zeros on grid
 806            if yi == 0.0:
 807                roots.append(ui)
 808                continue
 809            if yj == 0.0:
 810                roots.append(uj)
 811                continue
 812    
 813            # strict sign change
 814            if yi * yj < 0.0:
 815                try:
 816                    r = brentq(f_scalar, ui, uj, maxiter=maxiter)
 817                    if np.isfinite(r):
 818                        roots.append(r)
 819                except Exception:
 820                    pass
 821    
 822        # ---- tangent roots (touching 0 without sign change)
 823        if include_tangent:
 824            ay = np.abs(y)
 825            for i in range(1, u.size - 1):
 826                if not (np.isfinite(y[i - 1]) and np.isfinite(y[i]) and np.isfinite(y[i + 1])):
 827                    continue
 828    
 829                if ay[i] > tangent_atol:
 830                    continue
 831    
 832                # local minimum of |y|
 833                if not (ay[i] <= ay[i - 1] and ay[i] <= ay[i + 1]):
 834                    continue
 835    
 836                # neighbors must be clearly away from zero
 837                if (ay[i - 1] < tangent_neighbor_mult * tangent_atol) or (ay[i + 1] < tangent_neighbor_mult * tangent_atol):
 838                    continue
 839    
 840                # same sign on both sides = touching
 841                if np.sign(y[i - 1]) == np.sign(y[i + 1]):
 842                    roots.append(u[i])
 843    
 844        # ---- dedup & sort
 845        roots = sorted([float(r) for r in roots if np.isfinite(r)])
 846        if not roots:
 847            return []
 848    
 849        deduped = [roots[0]]
 850        for r in roots[1:]:
 851            if abs(r - deduped[-1]) > tol_u_dedup:
 852                deduped.append(r)
 853    
 854        return deduped
 855
 856    def _find_roots_empirical_ugrid(
 857        self,
 858        func_u,
 859        u_range: np.ndarray,
 860        tol_u_dedup: float = 1e-3,
 861        zero_atol: float = 1e-12,
 862        zero_rtol: float = 1e-9,
 863        noise_mult: float = 8.0,
 864        hysteresis: float = 3.0,
 865        include_near_zero_minima: bool = True,
 866        brentq_maxiter: int = 100,
 867    ) -> List[float]:
 868        """
 869        Robust root finder on a u-grid that:
 870          - returns [] for truly flat curves (prevents 'infinite roots')
 871          - avoids spurious roots in long near-zero plateaus / jittery regions
 872          - still finds real roots (including sign-change roots) reliably
 873    
 874        Strategy:
 875          1) Compute a deadband threshold thr using scale + noise floor (MAD of diffs).
 876          2) Snap |y|<=thr to 0 for sign bookkeeping.
 877          3) Bracket roots only between successive NONZERO sign points (skips plateaus).
 878          4) Optionally add tangent roots via isolated minima of |y| near 0.
 879        """
 880        u = np.asarray(u_range, dtype=float)
 881        if u.size < 2:
 882            return []
 883    
 884        y = np.asarray(func_u(u), dtype=float)
 885    
 886        finite = np.isfinite(u) & np.isfinite(y)
 887        if finite.sum() < 3:
 888            return []
 889    
 890        uu = u[finite]
 891        yy = y[finite]
 892    
 893        # scale
 894        scale = np.nanmax(np.abs(yy))
 895        if not np.isfinite(scale) or scale == 0.0:
 896            return []
 897    
 898        # noise floor from finite first differences
 899        dy = np.diff(yy)
 900        dy = dy[np.isfinite(dy)]
 901        if dy.size > 0:
 902            mad = np.median(np.abs(dy - np.median(dy)))
 903            noise = 1.4826 * mad
 904        else:
 905            noise = 0.0
 906    
 907        thr = max(zero_atol, zero_rtol * scale, noise_mult * noise)
 908        thr_hi = hysteresis * thr
 909    
 910        # --- flat curve guard: if everything is inside deadband, treat as "no roots"
 911        if np.all(np.abs(yy) <= thr):
 912            return []
 913    
 914        # snap for sign bookkeeping
 915        y_snap = yy.copy()
 916        y_snap[np.abs(y_snap) <= thr] = 0.0
 917        s = np.sign(y_snap)
 918    
 919        roots: List[float] = []
 920    
 921        # --- 1) sign-change roots, bracketing ONLY between nonzero sign points
 922        nz = np.where(s != 0)[0]
 923        if nz.size >= 2:
 924            for a, b in zip(nz[:-1], nz[1:]):
 925                if s[a] == s[b]:
 926                    continue
 927    
 928                uL, uR = float(uu[a]), float(uu[b])
 929    
 930                # hysteresis: at least one endpoint must be meaningfully away from 0
 931                if (abs(yy[a]) < thr_hi) and (abs(yy[b]) < thr_hi):
 932                    continue
 933    
 934                try:
 935                    root = brentq(
 936                        lambda z: float(np.asarray(func_u(np.array([z]))).ravel()[0]),
 937                        uL, uR,
 938                        maxiter=brentq_maxiter
 939                    )
 940                except Exception:
 941                    # fallback: linear interpolation in u
 942                    yL = float(yy[a]); yR = float(yy[b])
 943                    t = abs(yL) / (abs(yL) + abs(yR))
 944                    root = uL + t * (uR - uL)
 945    
 946                if np.isfinite(root):
 947                    roots.append(float(root))
 948    
 949        # --- 2) tangent roots: isolated minima of |y| near 0
 950        if include_near_zero_minima and yy.size >= 3:
 951            ay = np.abs(yy)
 952            mins = np.where((ay[1:-1] <= ay[:-2]) & (ay[1:-1] <= ay[2:]))[0] + 1
 953            for i in mins:
 954                if ay[i] > thr:
 955                    continue
 956    
 957                # "isolated": neighbors should be clearly away from zero
 958                if (ay[i - 1] < thr_hi) and (ay[i + 1] < thr_hi):
 959                    continue
 960    
 961                # and it's a touch (no sign change across neighbors)
 962                if np.sign(yy[i - 1]) == 0 or np.sign(yy[i + 1]) == 0:
 963                    continue
 964                if np.sign(yy[i - 1]) != np.sign(yy[i + 1]):
 965                    continue
 966    
 967                roots.append(float(uu[i]))
 968    
 969        if not roots:
 970            return []
 971    
 972        # de-duplicate in u
 973        roots = np.array([r for r in roots if np.isfinite(r)], dtype=float)
 974        if roots.size == 0:
 975            return []
 976    
 977        roots.sort()
 978        out = [float(roots[0])]
 979        last = float(roots[0])
 980        for r in roots[1:]:
 981            r = float(r)
 982            if abs(r - last) > tol_u_dedup:
 983                out.append(r)
 984                last = r
 985    
 986        return out
 987
 988    def _roots_x_to_u_str(self, roots_x: List[float], x_ntc: float, eps: float = 1e-10) -> str:
 989        if (roots_x is None) or (len(roots_x) == 0) or (x_ntc is None) or (not np.isfinite(x_ntc)) or (x_ntc <= 0):
 990            return np.nan
 991        log2_xntc = np.log2(max(float(x_ntc), eps))
 992        u = []
 993        for r in roots_x:
 994            if r is None:
 995                continue
 996            r = float(r)
 997            if np.isfinite(r) and (r > 0):
 998                u.append(np.log2(max(r, eps)) - log2_xntc)
 999        if len(u) == 0:
1000            return np.nan
1001        return ";".join([f"{val:.4f}" for val in u])
1002

1005    # Technical Fit Summary
1006    # ========================================================================
1007
1008    def save_ntc_summary(
1009        self,
1010        output_dir: Optional[str] = None,
1011        modality_name: Optional[str] = None
1012    ):
1013        """
1014        Save NTC fit parameters as feature-wise CSV.
1015
1016        Creates: ntc_feature_summary_{modality}.csv
1017
1018        Columns:
1019        - feature: Feature name
1020        - modality: Modality name
1021        - distribution: Distribution type
1022        - group_{i}_alpha_y_median: Median alpha_y for group i (point estimate from fit_ntc)
1023        - group_{i}_alpha_y_lower: 2.5% quantile for group i
1024        - group_{i}_alpha_y_upper: 97.5% quantile for group i
1025
1026        Parameters
1027        ----------
1028        output_dir : str, optional
1029            Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label)
1030        modality_name : str, optional
1031            Modality to export (default: primary modality)
1032        """
1033        if output_dir is None:
1034            output_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
1035
1036        if modality_name is None:
1037            modality_name = self.model.primary_modality
1038
1039        # Get modality
1040        modality = self.model.get_modality(modality_name)
1041
1042        # Check if technical fit has been run for this modality
1043        if not hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit') or modality.alpha_y_prefit is None:
1044            raise ValueError(f"NTC fit not found for modality '{modality_name}'. Run fit_ntc() first.")
1045
1046        # Get alpha_y for this modality (prefer distribution-specific versions)
1047        if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_mult') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_mult is not None:
1048            alpha_y = modality.alpha_y_prefit_mult  # [C, T] point estimate
1049        elif hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None:
1050            alpha_y = modality.alpha_y_prefit_add  # [C, T] point estimate
1051        else:
1052            alpha_y = modality.alpha_y_prefit  # [C, T] point estimate
1053
1054        # Convert to numpy if tensor
1055        if isinstance(alpha_y, torch.Tensor):
1056            alpha_y = alpha_y.cpu().numpy()
1057
1058        # For multinomial, alpha_y is [C, T, K]; for all others, [C, T].
1059        # If an old-format tensor with a leading samples dim (S) was stored, collapse it.
1060        if modality.distribution == 'multinomial':
1061            if alpha_y.ndim == 4:  # [S, C, T, K] — collapse S
1062                alpha_y = alpha_y.mean(axis=0)
1063            # alpha_y is now [C, T, K]
1064        else:
1065            if alpha_y.ndim == 3:  # [S, C, T] — collapse S
1066                alpha_y = alpha_y.mean(axis=0)
1067            # alpha_y is now [C, T]
1068
1069        # Get feature names - prefer modality.feature_names (what users see)
1070        if modality.feature_names is not None:
1071            feature_names = modality.feature_names
1072        else:
1073            feature_names = modality.feature_meta.index.tolist()
1074        n_features = len(feature_names)
1075        n_groups = alpha_y.shape[0]  # [C, T] → C groups
1076
1077        alpha_median = alpha_y  # [C, T] — point estimate stored as median at fit time
1078        alpha_lower = alpha_y  # no uncertainty (point estimate)
1079        alpha_upper = alpha_y
1080
1081        # Extract mu_ntc and o_y medians from posterior_samples_ntc ([S, T] → [T])
1082        def _extract_scalar_posterior(ps, key):
1083            v = ps.get(key)
1084            if v is None:
1085                return None
1086            if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor):
1087                v = v.cpu().numpy()
1088            if v.ndim == 1:
1089                return v
1090            return np.median(v, axis=0).flatten()  # collapse samples + any extra dims → [T]
1091
1092        ps = getattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc', None) or {}
1093        mu_ntc_vals = _extract_scalar_posterior(ps, 'mu_ntc')
1094        o_y_vals    = _extract_scalar_posterior(ps, 'o_y')
1095
1096        # Build DataFrame
1097        cis_gene = getattr(self.model, 'cis_gene', None)
1098        is_primary = modality_name == self.model.primary_modality
1099        data = {'feature': feature_names}
1100        if is_primary and cis_gene is not None:
1101            data['is_cis_gene'] = [f == cis_gene for f in feature_names]
1102        data['modality'] = modality_name
1103        data['distribution'] = modality.distribution
1104
1105        # Add columns for each group.
1106        # For multinomial alpha_y is [C, T, K]: export one column per (group, category).
1107        # For all others alpha_y is [C, T]: one column per group.
1108        if modality.distribution == 'multinomial':
1109            K_alpha = alpha_median.shape[2]
1110            for g in range(n_groups):
1111                for k in range(K_alpha):
1112                    data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_cat{k}_median'] = alpha_median[g, :, k]
1113                    data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_cat{k}_lower'] = alpha_lower[g, :, k]
1114                    data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_cat{k}_upper'] = alpha_upper[g, :, k]
1115        else:
1116            for g in range(n_groups):
1117                data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_median'] = alpha_median[g, :]
1118                data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_lower'] = alpha_lower[g, :]
1119                data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_upper'] = alpha_upper[g, :]
1120
1121        if mu_ntc_vals is not None:
1122            data['mu_ntc'] = mu_ntc_vals
1123        if o_y_vals is not None:
1124            data['o_y'] = o_y_vals
1125
1126        df = pd.DataFrame(data)
1127
1128        # Append cis gene row if this is the primary modality and alpha_x_prefit is available
1129        alpha_x = getattr(self.model, 'alpha_x_prefit', None)
1130        cis_appended = False
1131        if is_primary and cis_gene is not None and alpha_x is not None:
1132            alpha_x_np = alpha_x.cpu().numpy() if isinstance(alpha_x, torch.Tensor) else np.asarray(alpha_x)
1133            cis_ps = getattr(self.model.get_modality('cis'), 'posterior_samples_ntc', None) or {}
1134            cis_mu = _extract_scalar_posterior(cis_ps, 'mu_ntc')
1135            cis_oy = _extract_scalar_posterior(cis_ps, 'o_x')  # stored as o_x in cis modality
1136            cis_row = {
1137                'feature': cis_gene,
1138                'is_cis_gene': True,
1139                'modality': modality_name,
1140                'distribution': modality.distribution,
1141            }
1142            for g in range(n_groups):
1143                val = float(alpha_x_np[g]) if g < len(alpha_x_np) else float('nan')
1144                cis_row[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_median'] = val
1145                cis_row[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_lower'] = val
1146                cis_row[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_upper'] = val
1147            if mu_ntc_vals is not None:
1148                cis_row['mu_ntc'] = float(cis_mu[0]) if cis_mu is not None else float('nan')
1149            if o_y_vals is not None:
1150                cis_row['o_y'] = float(cis_oy[0]) if cis_oy is not None else float('nan')
1151            df = pd.concat([df, pd.DataFrame([cis_row])], ignore_index=True)
1152            cis_appended = True
1153
1154        # Save
1155        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
1156        output_file = os.path.join(output_dir, f'ntc_feature_summary_{modality_name}.csv')
1157        df.to_csv(output_file, index=False)
1158
1159        print(f"[SAVE] Technical summary saved to {output_file}")
1160        print(f"       {len(df)} features × {n_groups} groups ({n_features} trans + cis gene)"
1161              if cis_appended
1162              else f"       {n_features} features × {n_groups} groups")
1163
1164        return df

1169
1170    def save_cis_summary(
1171        self,
1172        output_dir: Optional[str] = None,
1173        include_cell_level: bool = True
1174    ):
1175        """
1176        Save cis fit parameters as guide-wise and cell-wise CSVs.
1177
1178        Creates:
1179        - cis_guide_summary.csv: Guide-level summary
1180        - cis_cell_summary.csv: Cell-level data (if include_cell_level=True)
1181
1182        Guide-level columns (single-guide mode):
1183        - guide: Guide name
1184        - target: Target gene
1185        - n_cells: Number of cells
1186        - x_true_mean: Mean x_true (averaged over cells in guide, then over posterior samples)
1187        - x_true_lower: 2.5% quantile
1188        - x_true_upper: 97.5% quantile
1189        - raw_counts_mean: Average raw counts
1190
1191        Guide-level columns (high MOI mode):
1192        - guide: Guide name
1193        - targets: Comma-separated target gene(s)
1194        - n_cells: Number of cells carrying this guide
1195        - x_eff_g_mean: Mean per-guide effective expression
1196        - x_eff_g_lower: 2.5% quantile
1197        - x_eff_g_upper: 97.5% quantile
1198        - sigma_eff_mean: Mean per-guide effect uncertainty
1199        - raw_counts_mean: Average raw counts for cells carrying this guide
1200
1201        Cell-level columns:
1202        - cell: Cell barcode
1203        - guide: Guide name (single-guide mode only)
1204        - target: Target classification (cis gene or 'ntc')
1205        - technical_group_code: Technical group (if available)
1206        - x_true_mean: Mean cell-level x_true
1207        - x_true_lower: 2.5% quantile
1208        - x_true_upper: 97.5% quantile
1209        - raw_counts: Raw counts for this cell
1210
1211        Parameters
1212        ----------
1213        output_dir : str, optional
1214            Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label)
1215        include_cell_level : bool
1216            Whether to save cell-level summary (default: True)
1217        """
1218        if output_dir is None:
1219            output_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
1220
1221        # Check if cis fit has been run
1222        if not hasattr(self.model, 'x_true') or self.model.x_true is None:
1223            raise ValueError("Cis fit not found. Run fit_cis() first.")
1224
1225        is_high_moi = getattr(self.model, 'is_high_moi', False)
1226
1227        # Get x_true samples — shape is [n_samples, n_cells] (cell-level)
1228        if hasattr(self.model, 'posterior_samples_cis') and 'x_true' in self.model.posterior_samples_cis:
1229            x_true_cell_samples = self.model.posterior_samples_cis['x_true']
1230            if isinstance(x_true_cell_samples, torch.Tensor):
1231                x_true_cell_samples = x_true_cell_samples.cpu().numpy()
1232        else:
1233            # Use point estimate
1234            x_true_pt = self.model.x_true
1235            if isinstance(x_true_pt, torch.Tensor):
1236                x_true_pt = x_true_pt.cpu().numpy()
1237            x_true_cell_samples = x_true_pt[np.newaxis, :]  # [1, n_cells]
1238
1239        # Get raw counts from cis modality
1240        cis_mod = self.model.get_modality('cis')
1241        cis_counts = cis_mod.counts[0, :]  # [n_cells]
1242
1243        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
1244
1245        # ── Guide-level summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────
1246        if is_high_moi:
1247            # In high MOI mode, guide-level parameters are x_eff_g and sigma_eff [G]
1248            cis_ps = self.model.posterior_samples_cis
1249
1250            x_eff_g_samples = cis_ps['x_eff_g']  # [n_samples, G]
1251            if isinstance(x_eff_g_samples, torch.Tensor):
1252                x_eff_g_samples = x_eff_g_samples.cpu().numpy()
1253
1254            sigma_eff_samples = cis_ps['sigma_eff']  # [n_samples, G]
1255            if isinstance(sigma_eff_samples, torch.Tensor):
1256                sigma_eff_samples = sigma_eff_samples.cpu().numpy()
1257
1258            guides = self.model.guide_meta['guide'].tolist()
1259            G = len(guides)
1260
1261            # Cells per guide from guide_assignment (N x G binary matrix)
1262            guide_assignment = self.model.guide_assignment  # numpy [N, G]
1263            n_cells_per_guide = guide_assignment.sum(axis=0).astype(int)  # [G]
1264
1265            # Average raw counts for cells carrying each guide
1266            raw_counts_mean = []
1267            for gi in range(G):
1268                cell_mask = guide_assignment[:, gi].astype(bool)
1269                if cell_mask.any():
1270                    raw_counts_mean.append(float(cis_counts[cell_mask].mean()))
1271                else:
1272                    raw_counts_mean.append(float('nan'))
1273
1274            # Targets: comma-separated list from guide_targets_dict
1275            gtd = getattr(self.model, 'guide_targets_dict', {})
1276            targets_col = [
1277                ','.join(gtd.get(g, ['unknown']))
1278                for g in guides
1279            ]
1280
1281            guide_df = pd.DataFrame({
1282                'guide': guides,
1283                'targets': targets_col,
1284                'n_cells': n_cells_per_guide,
1285                'x_eff_g_mean': x_eff_g_samples.mean(axis=0),
1286                'x_eff_g_lower': np.quantile(x_eff_g_samples, 0.025, axis=0),
1287                'x_eff_g_upper': np.quantile(x_eff_g_samples, 0.975, axis=0),
1288                'sigma_eff_mean': sigma_eff_samples.mean(axis=0),
1289                'raw_counts_mean': raw_counts_mean,
1290            })
1291
1292            guide_file = os.path.join(output_dir, 'cis_guide_summary.csv')
1293            guide_df.to_csv(guide_file, index=False)
1294            print(f"[SAVE] Cis guide summary saved to {guide_file}")
1295            print(f"       {G} guides (high MOI)")
1296
1297        else:
1298            # Get guide-level metadata
1299            guide_meta = self.model.meta.groupby('guide').agg({
1300                'target': 'first',
1301                'cell': 'count'
1302            }).rename(columns={'cell': 'n_cells'})
1303
1304            guides = guide_meta.index.tolist()
1305
1306            # Aggregate x_true from cell-level to guide-level (mean over cells per guide)
1307            # Use positional indices (iloc) because meta.index may be cell-name strings
1308            guide_to_cell_indices = {
1309                g: np.where(self.model.meta['guide'].values == g)[0].tolist()
1310                for g in guides
1311            }
1312
1313            # Build [n_samples, n_guides] by averaging cells within each guide
1314            n_samples = x_true_cell_samples.shape[0]
1315            n_guides = len(guides)
1316            x_true_guide_samples = np.zeros((n_samples, n_guides))
1317            for gi, g in enumerate(guides):
1318                cell_idx = guide_to_cell_indices[g]
1319                x_true_guide_samples[:, gi] = x_true_cell_samples[:, cell_idx].mean(axis=1)
1320
1321            # Compute mean and CI per guide
1322            x_true_mean = x_true_guide_samples.mean(axis=0)
1323            x_true_lower = np.quantile(x_true_guide_samples, 0.025, axis=0)
1324            x_true_upper = np.quantile(x_true_guide_samples, 0.975, axis=0)
1325
1326            # Compute average raw counts per guide
1327            guide_to_cells = self.model.meta.groupby('guide')['cell'].apply(list).to_dict()
1328            raw_counts_mean = []
1329            for guide in guides:
1330                guide_cells = guide_to_cells.get(guide, [])
1331                guide_cell_indices = [i for i, cell in enumerate(self.model.meta['cell']) if cell in guide_cells]
1332                if len(guide_cell_indices) > 0:
1333                    raw_counts_mean.append(cis_counts[guide_cell_indices].mean())
1334                else:
1335                    raw_counts_mean.append(np.nan)
1336
1337            guide_df = pd.DataFrame({
1338                'guide': guides,
1339                'target': guide_meta['target'].values,
1340                'n_cells': guide_meta['n_cells'].values,
1341                'x_true_mean': x_true_mean,
1342                'x_true_lower': x_true_lower,
1343                'x_true_upper': x_true_upper,
1344                'raw_counts_mean': raw_counts_mean
1345            })
1346
1347            guide_file = os.path.join(output_dir, 'cis_guide_summary.csv')
1348            guide_df.to_csv(guide_file, index=False)
1349            print(f"[SAVE] Cis guide summary saved to {guide_file}")
1350            print(f"       {len(guides)} guides")
1351
1352        # ── Cell-level summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────
1353        if include_cell_level:
1354            cell_data = {
1355                'cell': self.model.meta['cell'].values,
1356                'target': self.model.meta['target'].values,
1357            }
1358
1359            # In single-guide mode, include per-cell guide assignment
1360            if not is_high_moi:
1361                cell_data['guide'] = self.model.meta['guide'].values
1362
1363            # Add technical_group_code if available
1364            if 'technical_group_code' in self.model.meta.columns:
1365                cell_data['technical_group_code'] = self.model.meta['technical_group_code'].values
1366
1367            # Use cell-level x_true directly from posterior samples
1368            cell_data['x_true_mean'] = x_true_cell_samples.mean(axis=0)
1369            cell_data['x_true_lower'] = np.quantile(x_true_cell_samples, 0.025, axis=0)
1370            cell_data['x_true_upper'] = np.quantile(x_true_cell_samples, 0.975, axis=0)
1371            cell_data['raw_counts'] = cis_counts
1372
1373            cell_df = pd.DataFrame(cell_data)
1374
1375            cell_file = os.path.join(output_dir, 'cis_cell_summary.csv')
1376            cell_df.to_csv(cell_file, index=False)
1377            print(f"[SAVE] Cis cell summary saved to {cell_file}")
1378            print(f"       {len(cell_df)} cells")
1379
1380            return guide_df, cell_df
1381
1382        return guide_df
1383

1385    # Trans Fit Summary
1386    # ========================================================================
1387
1388    def _subset_posterior_features(self, posterior: dict, n: int, orig_n: int) -> dict:
1389        """
1390        Return a copy of posterior with each array sliced to the first n features.
1391
1392        Feature dimension is identified as any axis with size == orig_n.
1393        Arrays with no feature dimension (e.g. scalar or sample-only) are kept as-is.
1394        """
1395        subset = {}
1396        for k, v in posterior.items():
1397            if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor):
1398                v = v.cpu().numpy()
1399            if not isinstance(v, np.ndarray):
1400                subset[k] = v
1401                continue
1402            # Find axes whose size == orig_n (the feature dimension)
1403            feat_axes = [ax for ax, sz in enumerate(v.shape) if sz == orig_n]
1404            if not feat_axes:
1405                subset[k] = v  # no feature dim — keep whole array (e.g. scalar params)
1406            else:
1407                # Slice the first matching axis
1408                ax = feat_axes[0]
1409                idx = [slice(None)] * v.ndim
1410                idx[ax] = slice(None, n)
1411                subset[k] = v[tuple(idx)]
1412        return subset
1413
1414    def save_trans_summary(
1415        self,
1416        output_dir: Optional[str] = None,
1417        modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1418        compute_inflection: bool = True,
1419        compute_derivative_roots: bool = True,
1420        compute_log2fc_params: bool = True,
1421        compute_lfc_ci: bool = True,
1422        x_ntc: Optional[float] = None,
1423        y_ntc=None,
1424        verbose: bool = True,
1425        max_features: Optional[int] = None,
1426    ):
1427        """
1428        Save trans fit parameters as feature-wise CSV.
1429
1430        Creates: trans_feature_summary_{modality}.csv
1431
1432        Columns (depend on function_type and distribution):
1433        - feature: Feature name
1434        - modality: Modality name
1435        - distribution: Distribution type
1436        - function_type: Function type (additive_hill, single_hill, polynomial)
1437        - x_obs_min, x_obs_max: Observed x range (min/max of guide-level x_true)
1438
1439        For negbinom/normal/studentt distributions:
1440        - observed_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over observed x range from fitted function
1441        - full_log2fc_median/lower/upper: log2(y_max / y_min) over theoretical x range (0 to ∞)
1442
1443        For binomial distributions (e.g., splicing_sj):
1444        - observed_delta_p: y_max - y_min over observed x range (probability difference)
1445        - full_delta_p_median/lower/upper: y_max - y_min over theoretical x range
1446
1447        FDR columns (all function types):
1448        - fdr_alpha: Bayesian q-value for component A (positive Hill, or the single Hill
1449                     component in single_hill).  The minimum expected FDR among all called
1450                     sets that include this feature's component A.  Analogous to a
1451                     Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value: calling all features with
1452                     fdr_alpha <= q controls the expected false discovery rate at q.
1453                     For additive_hill, computed over the *pooled* family of 2*n_features
1454                     tests (alpha + beta), which accounts for the increased multiple-testing
1455                     burden relative to single_hill.
1456        - fdr_beta:  Bayesian q-value for component B (negative Hill).  NaN for
1457                     single_hill and polynomial.  Computed in the same pooled family as
1458                     fdr_alpha for additive_hill.
1459
1460        For additive_hill (all parameters needed to recreate: y = A + alpha*Vmax_a*Hill(x;K_a,n_a) + beta*Vmax_b*Hill(x;K_b,n_b)):
1461        - A_median, A_lower, A_upper: Baseline (intercept)
1462        - Vmax_a_median, Vmax_a_lower, Vmax_a_upper: Component A magnitude
1463        - K_a_median, K_a_lower, K_a_upper: Component A half-max (EC50)
1464        - EC50_a_median, EC50_a_lower, EC50_a_upper: Same as K_a (alias)
1465        - n_a_median, n_a_lower, n_a_upper: Component A Hill coefficient (cooperativity)
1466        - alpha_median, alpha_lower, alpha_upper: Component A weight
1467        - Vmax_b_median, Vmax_b_lower, Vmax_b_upper: Component B magnitude
1468        - K_b_median, K_b_lower, K_b_upper: Component B half-max (EC50)
1469        - EC50_b_median, EC50_b_lower, EC50_b_upper: Same as K_b (alias)
1470        - n_b_median, n_b_lower, n_b_upper: Component B Hill coefficient (cooperativity)
1471        - beta_median, beta_lower, beta_upper: Component B weight
1472        - pi_y_median, pi_y_lower, pi_y_upper: Sparsity weight (optional)
1473        - inflection_a_median, inflection_a_lower, inflection_a_upper: Component A inflection x
1474        - inflection_b_median, inflection_b_lower, inflection_b_upper: Component B inflection x
1475        - classification: Function shape classification based on dependency masks:
1476          - 'single_positive': Only one Hill component active, with positive n (increasing)
1477          - 'single_negative': Only one Hill component active, with negative n (decreasing)
1478          - 'additive_positive': Both components active, both with positive n
1479          - 'additive_negative': Both components active, both with negative n
1480          - 'non_monotonic_min': Both active, opposite signs, concave up at x=x_ntc (local min)
1481          - 'non_monotonic_max': Both active, opposite signs, concave down at x=x_ntc (local max)
1482          - 'flat': No active components
1483        - first_deriv_roots_median: Roots of first derivative (x values where dy/dx=0)
1484        - second_deriv_roots_median: Roots of second derivative (x values where d²y/dx²=0, inflections)
1485        - third_deriv_roots_median: Roots of third derivative (x values where d³y/dx³=0)
1486        - n_first_deriv_roots: Number of first derivative roots (0 for monotonic)
1487        - n_second_deriv_roots: Number of second derivative roots (inflection points)
1488        - n_third_deriv_roots: Number of third derivative roots
1489
1490        If compute_log2fc_params=True (log2FC relative to NTC):
1491        - x_ntc: NTC mean for cis gene (same for all trans genes)
1492        - y_ntc: NTC mean for each trans gene
1493        - log2fc_at_u0: log2FC value at u=0 (x = x_ntc), i.e., g(0) = log2(y(x_ntc)) - log2(y_ntc)
1494        - EC50_a_log2fc, EC50_b_log2fc: EC50 in log2FC x-space (log2(K) - log2(x_ntc))
1495        - inflection_a_log2fc_median, inflection_b_log2fc_median: Inflection points in log2FC x-space
1496
1497        For negbinom/normal/studentt (log2FC y-space):
1498        - dg_du_at_u0, dg_du_at_u0_lower, dg_du_at_u0_upper: First derivative of log2FC at u=0 with 95% CI
1499        - d2g_du2_at_u0, d2g_du2_at_u0_lower, d2g_du2_at_u0_upper: Second derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
1500        - d3g_du3_at_u0, d3g_du3_at_u0_lower, d3g_du3_at_u0_upper: Third derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
1501        - first_deriv_roots_log2fc_median: Roots of dg/du=0 in u-space (g = log2(y) - log2(y_ntc))
1502        - second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median: Roots of d²g/du²=0
1503        - third_deriv_roots_log2fc_median: Roots of d³g/du³=0
1504        - A_log2fc: Baseline in log2FC y-space (log2(A) - log2(y_ntc))
1505
1506        For binomial distributions (delta_p y-space):
1507        - delta_p_at_u0: Probability difference at u=0, i.e., p(x_ntc) - p_ntc
1508        - dp_du_at_u0, dp_du_at_u0_lower, dp_du_at_u0_upper: First derivative of delta_p at u=0 with 95% CI
1509        - d2p_du2_at_u0, d2p_du2_at_u0_lower, d2p_du2_at_u0_upper: Second derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
1510        - d3p_du3_at_u0, d3p_du3_at_u0_lower, d3p_du3_at_u0_upper: Third derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
1511        - first_deriv_roots_delta_p_median: Roots of dp/du=0 in u-space
1512        - second_deriv_roots_delta_p_median: Roots of d²p/du²=0
1513        - third_deriv_roots_delta_p_median: Roots of d³p/du³=0
1514        - A_delta_p: Baseline in delta_p space (A - y_ntc)
1515
1516        For single_hill:
1517        - B_median, B_lower, B_upper: Hill magnitude
1518        - K_median, K_lower, K_upper: Hill coefficient
1519        - xc_median, xc_lower, xc_upper: Half-max point (EC50 or IC50)
1520        - inflection_median, inflection_lower, inflection_upper: Inflection x
1521        - full_log2fc_median, full_log2fc_lower, full_log2fc_upper: Full dynamic range
1522
1523        For polynomial:
1524        - coef_{i}_median, coef_{i}_lower, coef_{i}_upper: Coefficient i
1525        - full_log2fc_median, full_log2fc_lower, full_log2fc_upper: Full dynamic range
1526
1527        Overdispersion and technical group effects (for simulation):
1528        - phi_y_median, phi_y_lower, phi_y_upper: NB overdispersion (phi_y = 1/o_y^2) from fit_trans
1529        - o_y_median, o_y_lower, o_y_upper: Posterior o_y (sqrt overdispersion) from fit_trans
1530        - o_y_ntc_median: Median o_y from fit_ntc (posterior_samples_ntc)
1531        - group_{g}_alpha_y_median: Technical group effect for group g (median, from fit_ntc)
1532
1533        Parameters
1534        ----------
1535        output_dir : str, optional
1536            Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label)
1537        modality_name : str, optional
1538            Modality to export (default: primary modality)
1539        compute_inflection : bool
1540            Whether to compute inflection points for Hill functions (default: True)
1541        compute_derivative_roots : bool
1542            Whether to compute roots of first and second derivatives (default: True).
1543            Roots are found empirically over the observed x_range.
1544        compute_log2fc_params : bool
1545            If True (default), compute parameters in log2FC space relative to NTC:
1546            - x-axis: log2(x) - log2(x_ntc) where x_ntc is cis gene NTC mean
1547            - y-axis: log2(y) - log2(y_ntc) where y_ntc is trans gene NTC mean
1548            Requires posterior_samples_ntc to be available, or x_ntc/y_ntc to be
1549            provided manually.
1550        x_ntc : float, optional
1551            Manually provided NTC mean for the cis gene (x-axis reference point).
1552            If None (default), computed from posterior_samples_ntc of the cis modality.
1553            Useful when fit_technical was not run (e.g., single-group subsets).
1554        y_ntc : array-like, optional
1555            Manually provided NTC means for each trans feature (y-axis reference points).
1556            Shape: (n_features,). If None (default), computed from posterior_samples_ntc
1557            of the trans modality.
1558        compute_lfc_ci : bool
1559            If True (default), compute 95% credible intervals for observed_log2fc and
1560            full_log2fc by iterating over all posterior samples. This is the main
1561            bottleneck for large feature sets (~1.5h for 20k features × 1000 samples).
1562            Set to False to skip the CI loops and use the posterior mean for lower/upper
1563            bounds instead. EC50_log2fc, inflection_log2fc, and all parameter CIs are
1564            unaffected — they remain fast vectorised computations.
1565        """
1566        if output_dir is None:
1567            output_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
1568
1569        if modality_name is None:
1570            modality_name = self.model.primary_modality
1571
1572        # Get modality
1573        modality = self.model.get_modality(modality_name)
1574
1575        # Check if trans fit has been run for this modality
1576        # Primary modality: use model-level posterior (model.posterior_samples_trans)
1577        # Non-primary modality: use modality-level posterior
1578        if modality_name == self.model.primary_modality:
1579            if not hasattr(self.model, 'posterior_samples_trans') or self.model.posterior_samples_trans is None:
1580                raise ValueError(f"Trans fit not found for primary modality '{modality_name}'. Run fit_trans() first.")
1581            posterior = self.model.posterior_samples_trans
1582        else:
1583            if not hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_trans') or modality.posterior_samples_trans is None:
1584                raise ValueError(f"Trans fit not found for modality '{modality_name}'. Run fit_trans(modality_name='{modality_name}') first.")
1585            posterior = modality.posterior_samples_trans
1586
1587        # Get feature names - prefer modality.feature_names (what users see and use)
1588        feature_meta = modality.feature_meta
1589
1590        # Extract per-feature actual category count for multinomial masking.
1591        # Used to identify phantom (padded) category slots so they are excluded
1592        # from FDR computation and the correct A_K (residual baseline) is selected.
1593        n_cats_per_feature = None
1594        if modality.distribution == 'multinomial' and feature_meta is not None and len(feature_meta) > 0:
1595            if 'n_categories' in feature_meta.columns:
1596                n_cats_per_feature = feature_meta['n_categories'].values.astype(int)
1597        if modality.feature_names is not None:
1598            # First priority: use modality.feature_names (this is what users see)
1599            feature_names = modality.feature_names
1600        elif feature_meta is not None and len(feature_meta) > 0:
1601            # Fallback: try feature_meta columns or index
1602            # Check if index is integer-based (RangeIndex or integer dtype)
1603            index_is_integer = (
1604                isinstance(feature_meta.index, pd.RangeIndex) or
1605                feature_meta.index.dtype in ['int64', 'int32', 'int']
1606            )
1607
1608            if index_is_integer:
1609                # Prefer named columns for feature identifiers
1610                if 'gene' in feature_meta.columns:
1611                    feature_names = feature_meta['gene'].tolist()
1612                elif 'gene_name' in feature_meta.columns:
1613                    feature_names = feature_meta['gene_name'].tolist()
1614                elif 'feature' in feature_meta.columns:
1615                    feature_names = feature_meta['feature'].tolist()
1616                else:
1617                    # Fall back to index
1618                    feature_names = feature_meta.index.tolist()
1619            else:
1620                # Index is named, use it
1621                feature_names = feature_meta.index.tolist()
1622        else:
1623            # No feature_names or feature_meta, use range
1624            feature_names = list(range(modality.counts.shape[0]))
1625
1626        n_features = len(feature_names)
1627
1628        # Optionally limit to first N features (useful for testing / debugging speed)
1629        if max_features is not None and max_features < n_features:
1630            _orig_n = n_features
1631            feature_names = feature_names[:max_features]
1632            n_features = max_features
1633            if n_cats_per_feature is not None:
1634                n_cats_per_feature = n_cats_per_feature[:max_features]
1635            posterior = self._subset_posterior_features(posterior, max_features, _orig_n)
1636            if verbose:
1637                print(f"[save_trans_summary] max_features={max_features}: "
1638                      f"using first {max_features} of {_orig_n} features")
1639
1640        # Determine function type from posterior keys
1641        keys = set(posterior.keys())
1642        if {'poly_coefs'} <= keys:
1643            function_type = 'polynomial'
1644        elif {'Vmax_a','K_a','n_a','Vmax_b','K_b','n_b'} <= keys:
1645            # Could be additive or nested; decide by presence of an indicator you store,
1646            # OR fall back to model setting if available.
1647            function_type = getattr(self.model, 'function_type', 'additive_hill')
1648        elif {'Vmax_a','K_a','n_a'} <= keys:
1649            function_type = 'single_hill'
1650        else:
1651            raise ValueError(
1652                f"Cannot determine function_type from posterior_samples_trans keys. "
1653                f"Found: {list(posterior.keys())}"
1654            )
1655
1656        # Initialize DataFrame with basic info
1657        data = {
1658            'feature': feature_names,
1659            'modality': modality_name,
1660            'distribution': modality.distribution,
1661            'function_type': function_type
1662        }
1663
1664        # Get x_range from model (guide-level x_true values)
1665        # This defines the "observed" x range as min to max of x_eff_g (guide-level x_true).
1666        # If the modality covers fewer cells than the model, use only the modality's cells
1667        # so x_obs_min/x_obs_max reflect the x values actually used during fitting.
1668        x_range = None
1669        x_obs_min = None
1670        x_obs_max = None
1671        if hasattr(self.model, 'x_true') and self.model.x_true is not None:
1672            x_true = self.model.x_true
1673            if isinstance(x_true, torch.Tensor):
1674                x_true = x_true.cpu().numpy()
1675            if x_true.ndim > 1:
1676                x_true = x_true.mean(axis=0)  # Average over posterior samples
1677            # Subset to modality cells when the modality covers fewer cells than the model
1678            if modality.cell_names is not None:
1679                all_model_cells = self.model.meta['cell'].tolist()
1680                _cidx_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(all_model_cells)}
1681                _cidx = [_cidx_map[c] for c in modality.cell_names if c in _cidx_map]
1682                x_true = x_true[_cidx]
1683            # Store observed x range (min to max of guide-level x_true)
1684            x_obs_min = max(x_true.min(), 1e-6)
1685            x_obs_max = x_true.max()
1686            x_range, x_obs_min, x_obs_max = self._build_x_range_from_x_true(x_true, n_grid=6000, eps=1e-6)
1687            data['x_obs_min'] = x_obs_min
1688            data['x_obs_max'] = x_obs_max
1689
1690
1691        # Get x_ntc and y_ntc for log2FC parameter computation.
1692        # Always look these up and add to data if found — they are useful metadata
1693        # regardless of whether compute_log2fc_params is True.
1694        _x_ntc = float(x_ntc) if x_ntc is not None else None
1695        _y_ntc = np.asarray(y_ntc) if y_ntc is not None else None
1696
1697        # x_ntc: from cis modality's technical fit (mu_ntc averaged over samples/groups)
1698        if _x_ntc is None:
1699            try:
1700                cis_mod = self.model.get_modality('cis')
1701                if hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc') and cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc is not None:
1702                    if 'mu_ntc' in cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc:
1703                        mu_ntc_cis = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc['mu_ntc']
1704                        if isinstance(mu_ntc_cis, torch.Tensor):
1705                            mu_ntc_cis = mu_ntc_cis.cpu().numpy()
1706                        _x_ntc = float(mu_ntc_cis.mean())
1707            except Exception:
1708                pass
1709
1710        # y_ntc: from trans modality's technical fit (mu_ntc averaged over posterior samples → [T])
1711        if _y_ntc is None:
1712            if hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc') and modality.posterior_samples_ntc is not None:
1713                if 'mu_ntc' in modality.posterior_samples_ntc:
1714                    mu_ntc_trans = modality.posterior_samples_ntc['mu_ntc']
1715                    if isinstance(mu_ntc_trans, torch.Tensor):
1716                        mu_ntc_trans = mu_ntc_trans.cpu().numpy()
1717                    while mu_ntc_trans.ndim > 2:
1718                        mu_ntc_trans = mu_ntc_trans.mean(axis=0)
1719                    _y_ntc = mu_ntc_trans.mean(axis=0)
1720
1721        # Subset y_ntc to match max_features if applied
1722        if max_features is not None and _y_ntc is not None:
1723            _y_ntc_arr = np.asarray(_y_ntc)
1724            if _y_ntc_arr.ndim >= 1 and _y_ntc_arr.shape[0] > max_features:
1725                _y_ntc = _y_ntc_arr[:max_features]
1726
1727        # Guard: y_ntc must match n_features.  A common cause of mismatch is that
1728        # posterior_samples_ntc['mu_ntc'] was not subsetted when the modality was
1729        # subsetted to fewer features (e.g. a random 100-gene subset).  When the
1730        # modality has feature_names we try to align by name; otherwise we fall back
1731        # to discarding y_ntc so the rest of the summary still completes.
1732        if _y_ntc is not None and np.asarray(_y_ntc).shape[0] != n_features:
1733            _y_ntc_arr = np.asarray(_y_ntc)
1734            aligned = False
1735            # Try name-based alignment
1736            ntc_feat_names = None
1737            if (hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc')
1738                    and isinstance(modality.posterior_samples_ntc, dict)):
1739                ntc_feat_names = modality.posterior_samples_ntc.get('feature_names')
1740            cur_feat_names = getattr(modality, 'feature_names', None)
1741            if ntc_feat_names is not None and cur_feat_names is not None:
1742                ntc_idx_map = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(ntc_feat_names)}
1743                subset_idx = [ntc_idx_map.get(n, -1) for n in cur_feat_names]
1744                if all(si >= 0 for si in subset_idx):
1745                    _y_ntc = _y_ntc_arr[subset_idx]
1746                    aligned = True
1747            if not aligned:
1748                print(
1749                    f"[WARNING] y_ntc length ({_y_ntc_arr.shape[0]}) does not match "
1750                    f"n_features ({n_features}) and cannot be aligned by feature name. "
1751                    f"y_ntc will be ignored for log2FC computation. "
1752                    f"To fix: subset posterior_samples_ntc['mu_ntc'] to match the current "
1753                    f"modality features, or pass y_ntc manually to save_trans_summary()."
1754                )
1755                _y_ntc = None
1756
1757        # Always add x_ntc / y_ntc to data if available (useful metadata even without log2fc params)
1758        if _x_ntc is not None:
1759            data['x_ntc'] = _x_ntc
1760        if _y_ntc is not None:
1761            data['y_ntc'] = _y_ntc
1762
1763        if compute_log2fc_params:
1764            if _x_ntc is None:
1765                print("[WARNING] Cannot compute log2FC params: x_ntc not available from cis modality. "
1766                      "Provide x_ntc manually to save_trans_summary().")
1767                compute_log2fc_params = False
1768            if _y_ntc is None:
1769                print("[WARNING] Cannot compute log2FC params: y_ntc not available from trans modality. "
1770                      "Provide y_ntc manually to save_trans_summary().")
1771                compute_log2fc_params = False
1772
1773        # Add function-specific parameters
1774        _S = next((v.shape[0] for v in posterior.values()
1775                   if isinstance(v, (np.ndarray, torch.Tensor)) and
1776                   (v.numpy() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else v).ndim >= 2), '?')
1777        if verbose:
1778            print(f"\n[save_trans_summary] function_type={function_type}  "
1779                  f"n_features={n_features}  posterior_samples={_S}")
1780            print(f"  compute_derivative_roots={compute_derivative_roots}  "
1781                  f"compute_log2fc_params={compute_log2fc_params}  "
1782                  f"compute_inflection={compute_inflection}")
1783            print(f"  x_ntc={'set' if _x_ntc is not None else 'None'}  "
1784                  f"y_ntc={'set' if _y_ntc is not None else 'None'}")
1785        _t0 = time.time()
1786
1787        if function_type == 'additive_hill':
1788            data = self._add_additive_hill_params(
1789                data, posterior, n_features,
1790                compute_inflection,
1791                compute_derivative_roots, x_range,
1792                compute_log2fc_params, _x_ntc, _y_ntc,
1793                x_obs_min, x_obs_max,
1794                n_cats_per_feature=n_cats_per_feature,
1795                compute_lfc_ci=compute_lfc_ci,
1796                verbose=verbose,
1797            )
1798        elif function_type == 'single_hill':
1799            data = self._add_single_hill_params(
1800                data, posterior, n_features,
1801                compute_inflection=compute_inflection,
1802                compute_derivative_roots=compute_derivative_roots,
1803                x_range=x_range,
1804                x_obs_min=x_obs_min,
1805                x_obs_max=x_obs_max,
1806                compute_log2fc_params=compute_log2fc_params,
1807                compute_lfc_ci=compute_lfc_ci,
1808                x_ntc=_x_ntc,
1809                y_ntc=_y_ntc,
1810                verbose=verbose,
1811            )
1812        elif function_type == 'polynomial':
1813            data = self._add_polynomial_params(
1814                data, posterior, n_features,
1815                compute_derivative_roots=compute_derivative_roots,
1816                compute_log2fc_params=compute_log2fc_params,
1817                x_range=x_range,
1818                x_obs_min=x_obs_min,
1819                x_obs_max=x_obs_max,
1820                verbose=verbose,
1821            )
1822        if verbose:
1823            print(f"  _add_{function_type}_params: {time.time() - _t0:.1f}s")
1824
1825        # Compute Bayesian q-values (FDR columns) for Hill components
1826        _t0 = time.time()
1827        fdr_cols = self._compute_bayesian_fdr(posterior, function_type, n_features,
1828                                              n_cats_per_feature=n_cats_per_feature)
1829        data.update(fdr_cols)
1830        if verbose:
1831            print(f"  _compute_bayesian_fdr:      {time.time() - _t0:.1f}s")
1832
1833        # Add phi_y (overdispersion) from posterior o_y: phi_y = 1 / o_y^2
1834        # Also add o_y directly.
1835        if 'o_y' in posterior:
1836            o_y = posterior['o_y']
1837            if isinstance(o_y, torch.Tensor):
1838                o_y = o_y.cpu().numpy()
1839            # Handle [n_samples, n_features] or [n_samples, 1, n_features]
1840            if o_y.ndim == 3 and o_y.shape[1] == 1:
1841                o_y = o_y.squeeze(1)
1842            phi_y = 1.0 / (o_y ** 2)
