1843            if phi_y.ndim >= 2:
1844                data['phi_y_median'] = np.median(phi_y, axis=0)
1845                data['phi_y_lower'] = np.quantile(phi_y, 0.025, axis=0)
1846                data['phi_y_upper'] = np.quantile(phi_y, 0.975, axis=0)
1847                data['o_y_median'] = np.median(o_y, axis=0)
1848                data['o_y_lower'] = np.quantile(o_y, 0.025, axis=0)
1849                data['o_y_upper'] = np.quantile(o_y, 0.975, axis=0)
1850            else:
1851                data['phi_y_median'] = phi_y
1852                data['phi_y_lower'] = phi_y
1853                data['phi_y_upper'] = phi_y
1854                data['o_y_median'] = o_y
1855                data['o_y_lower'] = o_y
1856                data['o_y_upper'] = o_y
1857
1858        # Add fit_ntc o_y (median across posterior samples, per feature)
1859        ps_ntc = getattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc', None) or {}
1860        ntc_oy = ps_ntc.get('o_y')
1861        if ntc_oy is not None:
1862            if isinstance(ntc_oy, torch.Tensor):
1863                ntc_oy = ntc_oy.cpu().numpy()
1864            if ntc_oy.ndim == 3 and ntc_oy.shape[1] == 1:
1865                ntc_oy = ntc_oy.squeeze(1)
1866            if ntc_oy.ndim >= 2:
1867                data['o_y_ntc_median'] = np.median(ntc_oy, axis=0)[:n_features]
1868            else:
1869                data['o_y_ntc_median'] = ntc_oy[:n_features]
1870
1871        # Add alpha_y (technical group effects) from modality.alpha_y_prefit
1872        if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit') and modality.alpha_y_prefit is not None:
1873            # Get alpha_y (prefer distribution-specific versions)
1874            if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_mult') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_mult is not None:
1875                alpha_y_tech = modality.alpha_y_prefit_mult
1876            elif hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None:
1877                alpha_y_tech = modality.alpha_y_prefit_add
1878            else:
1879                alpha_y_tech = modality.alpha_y_prefit
1880            if isinstance(alpha_y_tech, torch.Tensor):
1881                alpha_y_tech = alpha_y_tech.cpu().numpy()
1882            # Shape: [n_samples, n_groups, n_features] (legacy posterior) or [n_groups, n_features] (point)
1883            if alpha_y_tech.ndim == 3:
1884                alpha_y_median = np.median(alpha_y_tech, axis=0)  # [n_groups, n_features]
1885            elif alpha_y_tech.ndim == 2:
1886                alpha_y_median = alpha_y_tech  # already [n_groups, n_features] point estimate
1887            else:
1888                alpha_y_median = None
1889            if alpha_y_median is not None and alpha_y_median.ndim == 2:
1890                n_groups = alpha_y_median.shape[0]
1891                for g in range(n_groups):
1892                    data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_median'] = alpha_y_median[g, :n_features]
1893
1894        df = pd.DataFrame(data)
1895
1896        # Merge with feature_meta from modality
1897        if modality.feature_meta is not None and len(modality.feature_meta) > 0:
1898            # Reset index to get feature names as a column for merging
1899            feature_meta_df = modality.feature_meta.reset_index()
1900            # Rename index column to avoid conflicts
1901            if 'index' in feature_meta_df.columns:
1902                feature_meta_df = feature_meta_df.rename(columns={'index': 'feature_meta_idx'})
1903
1904            # Ensure feature column is string type for consistent merging
1905            df['feature'] = df['feature'].astype(str)
1906
1907            # Merge on feature names - try to match by index or common columns
1908            if 'feature' in feature_meta_df.columns:
1909                feature_meta_df['feature'] = feature_meta_df['feature'].astype(str)
1910                df = df.merge(feature_meta_df, on='feature', how='left')
1911            elif 'gene' in feature_meta_df.columns:
1912                feature_meta_df['gene'] = feature_meta_df['gene'].astype(str)
1913                df = df.merge(feature_meta_df, left_on='feature', right_on='gene', how='left')
1914            elif 'gene_name' in feature_meta_df.columns:
1915                feature_meta_df['gene_name'] = feature_meta_df['gene_name'].astype(str)
1916                df = df.merge(feature_meta_df, left_on='feature', right_on='gene_name', how='left')
1917            else:
1918                # Try direct concatenation if feature order matches
1919                if len(feature_meta_df) == len(df):
1920                    for col in feature_meta_df.columns:
1921                        if col not in df.columns:
1922                            df[col] = feature_meta_df[col].values
1923
1924        # Save
1925        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
1926        output_file = os.path.join(output_dir, f'trans_feature_summary_{modality_name}.csv')
1927        df.to_csv(output_file, index=False)
1928
1929        print(f"[SAVE] Trans summary saved to {output_file}")
1930        print(f"       {n_features} features, function_type={function_type}")
1931
1932        return df
1933
1934    # ========================================================================
1935    # Helper Methods
1936    # ========================================================================
1937
1938    def _compute_empirical_log2fc(self, modality):
1939        """Compute empirical log2FC from raw counts (perturbed vs NTC means)."""
1940        counts = modality.counts  # [n_features, n_cells]
1941
1942        # Get NTC and perturbed masks
1943        ntc_mask = (self.model.meta['target'] == 'ntc').values
1944        pert_mask = (self.model.meta['target'] == self.model.cis_gene).values
1945
1946        if ntc_mask.sum() == 0 or pert_mask.sum() == 0:
1947            # Return NaN if no NTC or perturbed cells
1948            return np.full(counts.shape[0], np.nan), np.full(counts.shape[0], np.nan)
1949
1950        # Compute mean expression
1951        ntc_mean = counts[:, ntc_mask].mean(axis=1)
1952        pert_mean = counts[:, pert_mask].mean(axis=1)
1953
1954        # Log2 fold change
1955        log2fc = np.log2((pert_mean + 1) / (ntc_mean + 1))
1956
1957        # Compute standard error (approximate)
1958        ntc_std = counts[:, ntc_mask].std(axis=1)
1959        pert_std = counts[:, pert_mask].std(axis=1)
1960
1961        n_ntc = ntc_mask.sum()
1962        n_pert = pert_mask.sum()
1963
1964        # SE on log scale (delta method approximation)
1965        se_ntc = ntc_std / (np.sqrt(n_ntc) * (ntc_mean + 1))
1966        se_pert = pert_std / (np.sqrt(n_pert) * (pert_mean + 1))
1967        log2fc_se = np.sqrt(se_ntc**2 + se_pert**2) / np.log(2)
1968
1969        return log2fc, log2fc_se
1970
1971    def _compute_bayesian_fdr(
1972        self,
1973        posterior: dict,
1974        function_type: str,
1975        n_features: int,
1976        activity_epsilon: float = 0.01,
1977        n_cats_per_feature: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
1978    ) -> dict:
1979        """
1980        Compute per-component Bayesian q-values (FDR-equivalents) for Hill components.
1981
1982        The Bayesian q-value for component i is the minimum expected false discovery rate
1983        (FDR) of any called set that includes component i:
1984
1985            q_i = min_{k' >= rank(i)}  BayesFDR(top-k'),
1986
1987        where features are ranked by local FDR ascending (most-significant first),
1988
1989            lfdr_i = 1 - P(alpha_i * Vmax_a_i / A_i > epsilon)
1990
1991        and BayesFDR(top-k) = mean of lfdr over the k most-significant features.
1992
1993        Using the product alpha * Vmax_a / A (normalized effect size) instead of E[alpha]
1994        avoids the alpha–Vmax non-identifiability: the data constrains the product well
1995        even when the individual factors are poorly identified.  The ratio relative to A
1996        makes the threshold expression-scale invariant.
1997
1998        The choice of epsilon (default 0.01) is essentially arbitrary because true
1999        negatives have alpha * Vmax_a / A ~ 1e-50 while true positives have values
2000        >= ~0.15; any epsilon in [1e-8, 0.1] gives identical calls.
2001
2002        For additive_hill (two components per feature), alpha and beta components are
2003        treated as a *single pooled family* of 2*n_features tests.
2004
2005        Parameters
2006        ----------
2007        posterior : dict
2008            Posterior samples dict from fit_trans (keys include 'alpha', 'beta', etc.).
2009        function_type : str
2010            'additive_hill', 'single_hill', or 'polynomial'.
2011        n_features : int
2012            Number of trans features.
2013        activity_epsilon : float
2014            Threshold for the normalized effect size alpha * Vmax / A above which a
2015            component is considered active.  Insensitive to the exact value chosen;
2016            default 0.01 (1% of baseline).
2017
2018        Returns
2019        -------
2020        dict with keys:
2021            fdr_alpha : ndarray (n_features,)
2022                Bayesian q-value for component A (positive Hill / only component).
2023                Interpret as: the minimum expected FDR at which this feature's positive
2024                component would be included in a called set.
2025            fdr_beta : ndarray (n_features,)
2026                Bayesian q-value for component B (negative Hill).
2027                NaN for single_hill and polynomial.
2028
2029        Notes
2030        -----
2031        The q-value formula uses the "running minimum from the right" trick to ensure
2032        monotonicity: q_i <= q_j whenever lfdr_i <= lfdr_j.  Concretely:
2033
2034            cumfdr     = cumulative mean of sorted lfdr array
2035            qvals      = reverse running minimum of cumfdr
2036                       = minimum.accumulate(cumfdr[::-1])[::-1]
2037        """
2038
2039        def _to_numpy(key: str):
2040            """Extract posterior samples for a parameter as numpy array."""
2041            if key not in posterior:
2042                return None
2043            param = posterior[key]
2044            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
2045                param = param.cpu().numpy()
2046            # Squeeze cis-gene dim (axis 1 when size 1):
2047            # [S, 1, T]      → [S, T]       (standard non-multinomial alpha)
2048            # [S, 1, T, K-1] → [S, T, K-1]  (multinomial per-category alpha)
2049            if param.ndim >= 3 and param.shape[1] == 1:
2050                param = param.squeeze(1)
2051            return param
2052
2053        def _posterior_mean(key: str) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
2054            """Extract posterior mean for a parameter → shape (n_features,)."""
2055            param = _to_numpy(key)
2056            if param is None:
2057                return None
2058            if param.ndim == 0:
2059                return np.full(n_features, float(param))
2060            if param.ndim == 1:
2061                if param.shape[0] == n_features:
2062                    return param.copy()
2063                return np.full(n_features, float(param.mean()))
2064            # ≥ 2D: average over sample axis 0
2065            val = param.mean(axis=0)
2066            val = np.squeeze(val)
2067            if val.shape == () or val.shape == (1,):
2068                return np.full(n_features, float(val))
2069            return val
2070
2071        def _p_active(alpha_key: str, vmax_key: str) -> np.ndarray:
2072            """
2073            Compute P(alpha * Vmax / A > epsilon) across posterior samples.
2074
2075            Falls back to E[alpha] if full samples or A are unavailable.
2076            """
2077            alpha_s = _to_numpy(alpha_key)
2078            vmax_s  = _to_numpy(vmax_key)
2079            A_s     = _to_numpy('A')
2080
2081            # Need 2D sample arrays for the product computation
2082            if (alpha_s is not None and alpha_s.ndim >= 2 and
2083                    vmax_s is not None and vmax_s.ndim >= 2 and
2084                    A_s    is not None and A_s.ndim    >= 2):
2085                ratio = alpha_s * vmax_s / np.maximum(A_s, 1e-12)
2086                return (ratio > activity_epsilon).mean(axis=0)
2087
2088            # Fallback: use posterior mean of alpha
2089            E_alpha = _posterior_mean(alpha_key)
2090            if E_alpha is None:
2091                return np.ones(n_features, dtype=float)
2092            return np.clip(E_alpha, 0.0, 1.0)
2093
2094        def _qvalues(lfdr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
2095            """
2096            Convert a local-FDR array to Bayesian q-values.
2097
2098            q_i = min_{k' >= rank(i)} cumulative_mean(lfdr_sorted[:k'])
2099
2100            Implemented as a right-to-left running minimum of the cumulative mean,
2101            which ensures q-values are non-decreasing as local FDR increases.
2102            """
2103            n = len(lfdr)
2104            if n == 0:
2105                return np.array([], dtype=float)
2106            order = np.argsort(lfdr)
2107            lfdr_sorted = lfdr[order]
2108            cumfdr = np.cumsum(lfdr_sorted) / (np.arange(n, dtype=float) + 1.0)
2109            # Running minimum from right guarantees monotonicity
2110            qvals_sorted = np.minimum.accumulate(cumfdr[::-1])[::-1]
2111            qvals = np.empty(n, dtype=float)
2112            qvals[order] = qvals_sorted
2113            return qvals
2114
2115        nan_col = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
2116
2117        if function_type == 'polynomial':
2118            # Polynomial has no sparsity indicator; FDR not applicable
2119            return {'fdr_alpha': nan_col.copy(), 'fdr_beta': nan_col.copy()}
2120
2121        if function_type == 'single_hill':
2122            p_active_a = _p_active('alpha', 'Vmax_a')
2123            qvals_a = _qvalues(1.0 - p_active_a)
2124            # Floor: a test with zero posterior evidence (p_active ≈ 0) can only reach
2125            # q < FDR_threshold by being "carried" by many other true positives in the
2126            # pooled cumulative mean.  The FDR of the call set is still controlled, but
2127            # the individual gene has no evidence at all.  Hard-floor q to 1 so these
2128            # genes can never be classified as active.
2129            qvals_a = np.where(p_active_a < 1e-9, 1.0, qvals_a)
2130            return {
2131                'fdr_alpha': qvals_a,
2132                'fdr_beta':  nan_col.copy(),
2133            }
2134
2135        if function_type in ('additive_hill', 'nested_hill'):
2136            # Detect per-category (multinomial) alpha: shape [S, T, K-1] where K-1 > 1
2137            # (after _to_numpy, [S, 1, T] would have been squeezed to [S, T], so ndim==3
2138            # with shape[1] != 1 uniquely identifies the per-category multinomial case)
2139            alpha_raw_fdr = _to_numpy('alpha')
2140            _is_multinomial_fdr = (
2141                alpha_raw_fdr is not None and alpha_raw_fdr.ndim == 3
2142                and alpha_raw_fdr.shape[1] != 1
2143            )
2144
2145            if _is_multinomial_fdr:
2146                # Per-category FDR for multinomial.
2147                # alpha: [S, T, K-1], Vmax_a: [S, T, K-1], A: [S, T, K] (Dirichlet)
2148                vmax_a_raw_fdr = _to_numpy('Vmax_a')  # [S, T, K-1]
2149                vmax_b_raw_fdr = _to_numpy('Vmax_b')  # [S, T, K-1] or None
2150                beta_raw_fdr   = _to_numpy('beta')    # [S, T, K-1] or None
2151                A_raw_fdr      = _to_numpy('A')       # [S, T, K]
2152
2153                n_alpha_cats = alpha_raw_fdr.shape[2]
2154
2155                def _p_active_cat_k(alpha_arr, vmax_arr, A_arr, k):
2156                    """P(alpha_k * Vmax_k / A_k > epsilon) for category k."""
2157                    if alpha_arr is None or vmax_arr is None or alpha_arr.ndim < 3:
2158                        return np.ones(n_features, dtype=float)
2159                    ak = alpha_arr[:, :, k]   # [S, T]
2160                    vk = vmax_arr[:, :, k]    # [S, T]
2161                    if A_arr is not None and A_arr.ndim == 3 and k < A_arr.shape[2]:
2162                        Ak = A_arr[:, :, k]   # [S, T] — kth Dirichlet baseline
2163                        ratio = ak * vk / np.maximum(Ak, 1e-12)
2164                    else:
2165                        ratio = ak * vk
2166                    return (ratio > activity_epsilon).mean(axis=0)
2167
2168                p_active_a_cats = [_p_active_cat_k(alpha_raw_fdr, vmax_a_raw_fdr, A_raw_fdr, k)
2169                                   for k in range(n_alpha_cats)]
2170
2171                has_beta_fdr = (beta_raw_fdr is not None and vmax_b_raw_fdr is not None
2172                                and beta_raw_fdr.ndim == 3)
2173                n_beta_cats = beta_raw_fdr.shape[2] if has_beta_fdr else 0
2174                p_active_b_cats = ([_p_active_cat_k(beta_raw_fdr, vmax_b_raw_fdr, A_raw_fdr, k)
2175                                    for k in range(n_beta_cats)]
2176                                   if has_beta_fdr else [])
2177
2178                # Build phantom mask: after Modality.__init__ reordering, the tensor layout is
2179                #   columns 0 .. K_actual-2     : real explicit Hills
2180                #   columns K_actual-1 .. K_max-2 : phantom (padded, zero data)
2181                #   column  K_max-1              : real residual (not an explicit Hill)
2182                # So explicit Hill k is phantom for feature t when k >= K_actual[t] - 1.
2183                # Phantom entries are excluded from BH pooling by setting p_active = 0
2184                # so the floor (p_active < 1e-9 → q = 1) removes them cleanly.
2185                if n_cats_per_feature is not None:
2186                    for k, pa in enumerate(p_active_a_cats):
2187                        # feature t is phantom for cat k when k >= n_cats_per_feature[t] - 1
2188                        phantom_mask = k >= (n_cats_per_feature - 1)
2189                        p_active_a_cats[k] = np.where(phantom_mask, 0.0, pa)
2190                    for k, pb in enumerate(p_active_b_cats):
2191                        phantom_mask = k >= (n_cats_per_feature - 1)
2192                        p_active_b_cats[k] = np.where(phantom_mask, 0.0, pb)
2193
2194                # Pool all non-phantom categories into one BH family
2195                all_p_active = np.concatenate(p_active_a_cats + p_active_b_cats)
2196                qvals_cat = _qvalues(1.0 - all_p_active)
2197                # Floor: phantom (p_active=0) and truly null (p_active≈0) → q=1
2198                qvals_cat = np.where(all_p_active < 1e-9, 1.0, qvals_cat)
2199
2200                # Split back into per-category arrays and build result dict.
2201                # Phantom entries already have q=1 from the floor above.
2202                result = {}
2203                offset = 0
2204                q_per_cat_a = []
2205                for k in range(n_alpha_cats):
2206                    qk = qvals_cat[offset:offset + n_features]
2207                    result[f'fdr_alpha_cat{k}'] = qk
2208                    q_per_cat_a.append(qk)
2209                    offset += n_features
2210                q_per_cat_b = []
2211                for k in range(n_beta_cats):
2212                    qk = qvals_cat[offset:offset + n_features]
2213                    result[f'fdr_beta_cat{k}'] = qk
2214                    q_per_cat_b.append(qk)
2215                    offset += n_features
2216
2217                # Feature-level summary: min over REAL categories only.
2218                # Phantom categories have q=1 and will never drive the min below 1.
2219                result['fdr_alpha'] = (np.stack(q_per_cat_a, axis=0).min(axis=0)
2220                                       if q_per_cat_a else np.ones(n_features))
2221                result['fdr_beta']  = (np.stack(q_per_cat_b, axis=0).min(axis=0)
2222                                       if q_per_cat_b else nan_col.copy())
2223                # Kth residual category: affected iff any K-1 category is affected
2224                result['fdr_alpha_K'] = result['fdr_alpha']
2225                return result
2226
2227            # Standard (non-multinomial) path: pool alpha + beta into one family
2228            p_active_a = _p_active('alpha', 'Vmax_a')
2229            p_active_b = _p_active('beta',  'Vmax_b')
2230
2231            # Pool both components into a single family of 2*n_features tests.
2232            # The first n_features entries correspond to alpha (component A),
2233            # the next n_features to beta (component B).
2234            lfdr_all  = np.concatenate([1.0 - p_active_a, 1.0 - p_active_b])
2235            qvals_all = _qvalues(lfdr_all)
2236            # Floor: tests with p_active ≈ 0 get q = 1 (see single_hill comment above).
2237            p_active_all = np.concatenate([p_active_a, p_active_b])
2238            qvals_all = np.where(p_active_all < 1e-9, 1.0, qvals_all)
2239            return {
2240                'fdr_alpha': qvals_all[:n_features],
2241                'fdr_beta':  qvals_all[n_features:],
2242            }
2243
2244        # Unknown function type — return NaN
2245        return {'fdr_alpha': nan_col.copy(), 'fdr_beta': nan_col.copy()}
2246
2247    def _add_additive_hill_params(self, data, posterior, n_features, compute_inflection,
2248                                    compute_derivative_roots=True, x_range=None,
2249                                    compute_log2fc_params=False, x_ntc=None, y_ntc=None,
2250                                    x_obs_min=None, x_obs_max=None, fdr_threshold=0.05,
2251                                    n_cats_per_feature=None, compute_lfc_ci=True, verbose=False):
2252        """
2253        Add additive Hill parameters to data dict.
2254
2255        Uses individual parameter architecture: Vmax_a, K_a (EC50), n_a, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b.
2256
2257        For binomial/multinomial:
2258        - Vmax_a = Vmax_sum * alpha (effective magnitude for component A)
2259        - Vmax_b = Vmax_sum * beta (effective magnitude for component B)
2260        - Where Vmax_sum comes from Beta/Dirichlet prior
2261        - Model: y = A + Vmax_sum * (alpha * Hill_a + beta * Hill_b)
2262
2263        For negbinom/normal/studentt:
2264        - Vmax_a and Vmax_b are independent magnitudes sampled from log-normal priors
2265        """
2266        # All additive Hill models use individual parameters (Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, etc.)
2267        if 'Vmax_a' not in posterior:
2268            raise ValueError(
2269                f"Cannot find additive Hill parameters in posterior. Expected 'Vmax_a', 'K_a', 'n_a', etc. "
2270                f"Found keys: {list(posterior.keys())}"
2271            )
2272
2273        return self._add_additive_hill_params_individual(
2274            data, posterior, n_features, compute_inflection,
2275            compute_derivative_roots, x_range,
2276            compute_log2fc_params, x_ntc, y_ntc, x_obs_min, x_obs_max,
2277            fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold,
2278            n_cats_per_feature=n_cats_per_feature,
2279            compute_lfc_ci=compute_lfc_ci,
2280            verbose=verbose,
2281        )
2282
2283    # Helper function to compute y(x) given parameters
2284    def _hill_value(self, x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-12):
2285        x_safe = max(float(x), epsilon)
2286        K_safe = max(float(K), epsilon)
2287        Vmax = float(Vmax); n = float(n)
2288    
2289        logx = np.log(x_safe)
2290        logK = np.log(K_safe)
2291    
2292        x_n = self._exp_clip(n * logx)
2293        K_n = self._exp_clip(n * logK)
2294    
2295        denom = K_n + x_n
2296        with np.errstate(over='ignore', under='ignore', invalid='ignore', divide='ignore'):
2297            out = Vmax * x_n / denom
2298    
2299        return out if np.isfinite(out) else np.nan
2300
2301    def _add_additive_hill_params_individual(self, data, posterior, n_features, compute_inflection,
2302                                              compute_derivative_roots=True, x_range=None,
2303                                              compute_log2fc_params=False, x_ntc=None, y_ntc=None,
2304                                              x_obs_min=None, x_obs_max=None, fdr_threshold=0.05,
2305                                              n_cats_per_feature=None, compute_lfc_ci=True, verbose=False):
2306        """
2307        Add additive Hill parameters from individual parameter architecture (Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, etc.).
2308
2309        Includes:
2310        - Basic parameters with mean and 95% CI
2311        - Function classification based on dependency masks
2312        - Derivative roots (where dy/dx=0 and d²y/dx²=0)
2313        - full_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over theoretical range (in log2 space)
2314        - observed_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over observed x range (in log2 space)
2315        - Log2FC versions of parameters relative to NTC (if compute_log2fc_params=True)
2316
2317        For binomial distributions:
2318        - Uses delta_p (y_max - y_min) instead of log2fc (log2(y_max/y_min))
2319        - Derivative roots are found in y-space (dy/dx=0), then converted to u-space
2320        """
2321
2322        # Check distribution type for delta_p vs log2fc handling
2323        distribution = data.get('distribution', 'negbinom')
2324        is_binomial = (distribution == 'binomial')
2325
2326        def extract_param(name):
2327            """Helper to extract parameter with consistent handling of samples vs point estimates."""
2328            param = posterior[name]
2329            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
2330                param = param.cpu().numpy()
2331
2332            # Handle different dimensionalities
2333            # Common shapes:
2334            # - [n_samples, n_features]: standard 2D
2335            # - [n_samples, 1, n_features]: has cis gene dimension (size 1) to squeeze
2336            # - [n_samples, n_features, n_categories]: multinomial, average over categories
2337            if param.ndim >= 2:
2338                if param.ndim == 3:
2339                    # Check if middle dimension is size 1 (cis gene dim to squeeze)
2340                    if param.shape[1] == 1:
2341                        param = param.squeeze(1)  # [n_samples, 1, n_features] -> [n_samples, n_features]
2342                    else:
2343                        # Otherwise it's [n_samples, n_features, n_categories] - average over categories
2344                        param = param.mean(axis=2)
2345                elif param.ndim > 3:
2346                    # Higher dimensions: squeeze size-1 dims, then average remaining extras
2347                    # First try to squeeze the cis gene dimension (axis 1) if size 1
2348                    if param.shape[1] == 1:
2349                        param = param.squeeze(1)
2350                    # Average over any remaining dimensions beyond 2
2351                    if param.ndim > 2:
2352                        param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
2353
2354                mean_val = np.median(param, axis=0)
2355                lower_val = np.quantile(param, 0.025, axis=0)
2356                upper_val = np.quantile(param, 0.975, axis=0)
2357            else:
2358                # Point estimate: [n_features]
2359                mean_val = param
2360                lower_val = param
2361                upper_val = param
2362
2363            return mean_val, lower_val, upper_val
2364
2365        def extract_param_full(name):
2366            """Extract full posterior samples for per-sample computations."""
2367            param = posterior[name]
2368            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
2369                param = param.cpu().numpy()
2370            # Handle [n_samples, 1, n_features] -> [n_samples, n_features]
2371            if param.ndim == 3 and param.shape[1] == 1:
2372                param = param.squeeze(1)
2373            elif param.ndim > 2:
2374                # For other 3D+ cases, average over extra dimensions
2375                if param.shape[1] == 1:
2376                    param = param.squeeze(1)
2377                if param.ndim > 2:
2378                    param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
2379            return param  # [n_samples, n_features] or [n_features]
2380
2381        def extract_param_abs(name):
2382            """
2383            Posterior summaries for abs(parameter). This is needed for inflection because it depends on |n|.
2384            Returns mean, lower(2.5%), upper(97.5%) of |param|.
2385            """
2386            param = posterior[name]
2387            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
2388                param = param.cpu().numpy()
2389        
2390            # Match extract_param logic:
2391            if param.ndim == 3 and param.shape[1] == 1:
2392                param = param.squeeze(1)
2393            elif param.ndim > 2:
2394                if param.shape[1] == 1:
2395                    param = param.squeeze(1)
2396                if param.ndim > 2:
2397                    param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
2398        
2399            param_abs = np.abs(param)
2400
2401            if param_abs.ndim >= 2:
2402                mean_val = np.median(param_abs, axis=0)
2403                lower_val = np.quantile(param_abs, 0.025, axis=0)
2404                upper_val = np.quantile(param_abs, 0.975, axis=0)
2405            else:
2406                mean_val = lower_val = upper_val = param_abs
2407
2408            return mean_val, lower_val, upper_val
2409
2410        # Component A (first Hill function)
2411        Vmax_a_median, Vmax_a_lower, Vmax_a_upper = extract_param('Vmax_a')
2412        K_a_median, K_a_lower, K_a_upper = extract_param('K_a')  # EC50
2413        n_a_median, n_a_lower, n_a_upper = extract_param('n_a')  # Hill coefficient
2414
2415        data['Vmax_a_median'] = Vmax_a_median
2416        data['Vmax_a_lower'] = Vmax_a_lower
2417        data['Vmax_a_upper'] = Vmax_a_upper
2418        data['EC50_a_median'] = K_a_median
2419        data['EC50_a_lower'] = K_a_lower
2420        data['EC50_a_upper'] = K_a_upper
2421        data['n_a_median'] = n_a_median
2422        data['n_a_lower'] = n_a_lower
2423        data['n_a_upper'] = n_a_upper
2424
2425        # Component B (second Hill function)
2426        Vmax_b_median, Vmax_b_lower, Vmax_b_upper = extract_param('Vmax_b')
2427        K_b_median, K_b_lower, K_b_upper = extract_param('K_b')  # EC50
2428        n_b_median, n_b_lower, n_b_upper = extract_param('n_b')  # Hill coefficient
2429
2430        data['Vmax_b_median'] = Vmax_b_median
2431        data['Vmax_b_lower'] = Vmax_b_lower
2432        data['Vmax_b_upper'] = Vmax_b_upper
2433        data['EC50_b_median'] = K_b_median
2434        data['EC50_b_lower'] = K_b_lower
2435        data['EC50_b_upper'] = K_b_upper
2436        data['n_b_median'] = n_b_median
2437        data['n_b_lower'] = n_b_lower
2438        data['n_b_upper'] = n_b_upper
2439
2440        # Use raw posterior medians for n; component activity is determined by FDR
2441        # (q_active_a / q_active_b, computed below) rather than CI-based n-zeroing.
2442        n_a_used = n_a_median
2443        n_b_used = n_b_median
2444
2445        # Pi_y (sparsity weight) - optional
2446        if 'pi_y' in posterior:
2447            pi_y_median, pi_y_lower, pi_y_upper = extract_param('pi_y')
2448            data['pi_y_median'] = pi_y_median
2449            data['pi_y_lower'] = pi_y_lower
2450            data['pi_y_upper'] = pi_y_upper
2451
2452        # Alpha and beta (component weights)
2453        # Default to 1.0 if not present (no sparsity)
2454        # Note: alpha/beta may be scalars (shared across features) or per-feature
2455        def _broadcast_to_features(arr, n_features):
2456            """Broadcast scalar or size-1 array to n_features length."""
2457            arr = np.atleast_1d(arr)
2458            if arr.size == 1:
2459                return np.full(n_features, arr.flat[0])
2460            return arr
2461
2462        if 'alpha' in posterior:
2463            alpha_median, alpha_lower, alpha_upper = extract_param('alpha')
2464            alpha_full = extract_param_full('alpha')
2465            # Broadcast if scalar
2466            alpha_median = _broadcast_to_features(alpha_median, n_features)
2467            alpha_lower = _broadcast_to_features(alpha_lower, n_features)
2468            alpha_upper = _broadcast_to_features(alpha_upper, n_features)
2469            if alpha_full.ndim == 1:
2470                # (n_features,) point estimate → (1, n_features)
2471                alpha_full = alpha_full[np.newaxis, :]
2472            elif alpha_full.shape[-1] == 1:
2473                # (n_samples, 1) scalar → (n_samples, n_features)
2474                alpha_full = np.broadcast_to(alpha_full, (alpha_full.shape[0], n_features)).copy()
2475        else:
2476            alpha_median = np.ones(n_features)
2477            alpha_lower = np.ones(n_features)
2478            alpha_upper = np.ones(n_features)
2479            alpha_full = np.ones((1, n_features))
2480
2481        if 'beta' in posterior:
2482            beta_median, beta_lower, beta_upper = extract_param('beta')
2483            beta_full = extract_param_full('beta')
2484            # Broadcast if scalar
2485            beta_median = _broadcast_to_features(beta_median, n_features)
2486            beta_lower = _broadcast_to_features(beta_lower, n_features)
2487            beta_upper = _broadcast_to_features(beta_upper, n_features)
2488            if beta_full.ndim == 1:
2489                # (n_features,) point estimate → (1, n_features)
2490                beta_full = beta_full[np.newaxis, :]
2491            elif beta_full.shape[-1] == 1:
2492                # (n_samples, 1) scalar → (n_samples, n_features)
2493                beta_full = np.broadcast_to(beta_full, (beta_full.shape[0], n_features)).copy()
2494        else:
2495            beta_median = np.ones(n_features)
2496            beta_lower = np.ones(n_features)
2497            beta_upper = np.ones(n_features)
2498            beta_full = np.ones((1, n_features))
2499
2500        data['alpha_median'] = alpha_median
2501        data['alpha_lower'] = alpha_lower
2502        data['alpha_upper'] = alpha_upper
2503        data['beta_median'] = beta_median
2504        data['beta_lower'] = beta_lower
2505        data['beta_upper'] = beta_upper
2506
2507        # Also save K_a and K_b explicitly (same as EC50 but clearer naming for function recreation)
2508        data['K_a_median'] = K_a_median
2509        data['K_a_lower'] = K_a_lower
2510        data['K_a_upper'] = K_a_upper
2511        data['K_b_median'] = K_b_median
2512        data['K_b_lower'] = K_b_lower
2513        data['K_b_upper'] = K_b_upper
2514
2515        # Get A (baseline) - required to recreate the fitted function
2516        if 'A' in posterior:
2517            A_median, A_lower, A_upper = extract_param('A')
2518            A_full = extract_param_full('A')
2519            # Broadcast if scalar
2520            A_median = _broadcast_to_features(A_median, n_features)
2521            A_lower = _broadcast_to_features(A_lower, n_features)
2522            A_upper = _broadcast_to_features(A_upper, n_features)
2523            if A_full.ndim == 1 or A_full.shape[-1] == 1:
2524                A_full = np.broadcast_to(A_full.reshape(-1, 1), (A_full.shape[0] if A_full.ndim > 1 else 1, n_features)).copy()
2525        else:
2526            A_median = np.zeros(n_features)
2527            A_lower = np.zeros(n_features)
2528            A_upper = np.zeros(n_features)
2529            A_full = np.zeros((1, n_features))
2530
2531        # Save A (baseline) to data dict
2532        data['A_median'] = A_median
2533        data['A_lower'] = A_lower
2534        data['A_upper'] = A_upper
2535
2536        # Multinomial: add per-category alpha/beta columns and A_K (Kth residual baseline)
2537        # For multinomial, alpha/beta have shape [S, T, K-1] after model sampling.
2538        # extract_param averages over category dim, so we add per-category summaries here.
2539        is_multinomial = (distribution == 'multinomial')
2540        if is_multinomial:
2541            def _extract_cat_param(name):
2542                """Return raw numpy [S, T, K-1] for a per-category parameter."""
2543                if name not in posterior:
2544                    return None
2545                p = posterior[name]
2546                if isinstance(p, torch.Tensor):
2547                    p = p.cpu().numpy()
2548                # Shape [S, 1, T, K-1] → [S, T, K-1] (squeeze cis-gene dim if present)
2549                if p.ndim == 4 and p.shape[1] == 1:
2550                    p = p.squeeze(1)
2551                # Only return if genuinely [S, T, K-1]
2552                if p.ndim == 3 and p.shape[1] == n_features:
2553                    return p
2554                return None
2555
2556            for param_name, prefix in [('alpha', 'alpha'), ('beta', 'beta')]:
2557                cat_arr = _extract_cat_param(param_name)
2558                if cat_arr is not None:
2559                    n_cats = cat_arr.shape[2]
2560                    for k in range(n_cats):
2561                        ck = cat_arr[:, :, k]  # [S, T]
2562                        data[f'{prefix}_cat{k}_median'] = np.median(ck, axis=0)
2563                        data[f'{prefix}_cat{k}_lower'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.025, axis=0)
2564                        data[f'{prefix}_cat{k}_upper'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.975, axis=0)
2565
2566            # A_K: the implicit Kth (residual) category baseline from Dirichlet A, shape [S, T, K].
2567            # Modality.__init__ ensures column K_max-1 is always a real category (by swapping
2568            # the last real category there for features with K_actual < K_max), so [:, :, -1]
2569            # is always the correct residual baseline.
2570            # Also export all K per-category A values and per-category Hill params so that
2571            # simulation can reconstruct the full per-category dose-response curves.
2572            if 'A' in posterior:
2573                A_raw = posterior['A']
2574                if isinstance(A_raw, torch.Tensor):
2575                    A_raw = A_raw.cpu().numpy()
2576                if A_raw.ndim == 4 and A_raw.shape[1] == 1:
2577                    A_raw = A_raw.squeeze(1)
2578                if A_raw.ndim == 3 and A_raw.shape[1] == n_features:
2579                    AK = A_raw[:, :, -1]  # [S, T] — residual always at K_max-1
2580                    data['A_K_median'] = np.median(AK, axis=0)
2581                    data['A_K_lower'] = np.quantile(AK, 0.025, axis=0)
2582                    data['A_K_upper'] = np.quantile(AK, 0.975, axis=0)
2583                    # Per-category A for k=0..K-2 (K-1 fitted, last is residual A_K above)
2584                    K_dim = A_raw.shape[2]
2585                    for k in range(K_dim - 1):
2586                        ck = A_raw[:, :, k]  # [S, T]
2587                        data[f'A_cat{k}_median'] = np.median(ck, axis=0)
2588                        data[f'A_cat{k}_lower'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.025, axis=0)
2589                        data[f'A_cat{k}_upper'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.975, axis=0)
2590
2591            # Per-category Hill parameters for simulation (Vmax, K, n for a- and b-components)
2592            for hill_param in ['Vmax_a', 'K_a', 'n_a', 'Vmax_b', 'K_b', 'n_b']:
2593                cat_arr = _extract_cat_param(hill_param)
2594                if cat_arr is not None:
2595                    n_cats = cat_arr.shape[2]
2596                    for k in range(n_cats):
2597                        ck = cat_arr[:, :, k]  # [S, T]
2598                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_median'] = np.median(ck, axis=0)
2599                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_lower'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.025, axis=0)
2600                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_upper'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.975, axis=0)
2601
2602        # Get full posterior samples (needed for FDR and per-sample CI computations)
2603        Vmax_a_full = extract_param_full('Vmax_a')
2604        K_a_full = extract_param_full('K_a')
2605        n_a_full = extract_param_full('n_a')
2606        Vmax_b_full = extract_param_full('Vmax_b')
2607        K_b_full = extract_param_full('K_b')
2608        n_b_full = extract_param_full('n_b')
2609
2610        # Compute product-based activity probabilities: P(alpha * Vmax_a / A > epsilon)
2611        # These avoid the alpha–Vmax non-identifiability by using the well-constrained product.
2612        _ACTIVITY_EPSILON = 0.01
2613        if (alpha_full.ndim >= 2 and Vmax_a_full.ndim >= 2 and A_full.ndim >= 2):
2614            _ratio_a = alpha_full * Vmax_a_full / np.maximum(A_full, 1e-12)
2615            p_active_a = (_ratio_a > _ACTIVITY_EPSILON).mean(axis=0)
2616        else:
2617            p_active_a = alpha_median.copy()  # fallback to median[alpha]
2618        if (beta_full.ndim >= 2 and Vmax_b_full.ndim >= 2 and A_full.ndim >= 2):
2619            _ratio_b = beta_full * Vmax_b_full / np.maximum(A_full, 1e-12)
2620            p_active_b = (_ratio_b > _ACTIVITY_EPSILON).mean(axis=0)
2621        else:
2622            p_active_b = beta_median.copy()  # fallback to median[beta]
2623        p_active_a = np.asarray(p_active_a, dtype=float).ravel()
2624        p_active_b = np.asarray(p_active_b, dtype=float).ravel()
2625
2626        # Convert p_active to Bayesian q-values (pooled over both components).
2627        # dep_mask uses q < fdr_threshold so the criterion is globally calibrated.
2628        _lfdr_all = np.concatenate([1.0 - p_active_a, 1.0 - p_active_b])
2629        _n_all = len(_lfdr_all)
2630        _ord = np.argsort(_lfdr_all)
2631        _cumfdr = np.cumsum(_lfdr_all[_ord]) / (np.arange(_n_all, dtype=float) + 1.0)
2632        _qsorted = np.minimum.accumulate(_cumfdr[::-1])[::-1]
2633        _qall = np.empty(_n_all, dtype=float); _qall[_ord] = _qsorted
2634        # Floor: tests with p_active ≈ 0 get q = 1 regardless of pool dilution.
2635        _p_active_all = np.concatenate([p_active_a, p_active_b])
2636        _qall = np.where(_p_active_all < 1e-9, 1.0, _qall)
2637        q_active_a = _qall[:n_features]
2638        q_active_b = _qall[n_features:]
2639
2640        # Compute inflection points for individual Hill components
2641        if compute_inflection:
2642            # Use raw n means (FDR controls activity, not CI-based n-zeroing)
2643            nA = np.asarray(n_a_used, dtype=float)
2644            nB = np.asarray(n_b_used, dtype=float)
2645
2646            # For CI, we should use |n| bounds. A conservative choice:
2647            #   nabs_lower = min(|n_lo|, |n_hi|)  (lower bound on magnitude)
2648            #   nabs_upper = max(|n_lo|, |n_hi|)
2649            nAabs_lo = np.minimum(np.abs(n_a_lower), np.abs(n_a_upper))
2650            nAabs_hi = np.maximum(np.abs(n_a_lower), np.abs(n_a_upper))
2651            nBabs_lo = np.minimum(np.abs(n_b_lower), np.abs(n_b_upper))
2652            nBabs_hi = np.maximum(np.abs(n_b_lower), np.abs(n_b_upper))
2653
2654            # FDR-inactive components: zero inflection magnitude bounds
2655            _fdr_inactive_a = q_active_a >= fdr_threshold
2656            _fdr_inactive_b = q_active_b >= fdr_threshold
2657            nAabs_lo[_fdr_inactive_a] = 0.0
2658            nAabs_hi[_fdr_inactive_a] = 0.0
2659            nBabs_lo[_fdr_inactive_b] = 0.0
2660            nBabs_hi[_fdr_inactive_b] = 0.0
2661        
2662            inflection_a_mean = self._compute_hill_inflection(nA,      K_a_median)
2663            inflection_a_lower = self._compute_hill_inflection(nAabs_lo, K_a_lower)  # magnitude-lower
2664            inflection_a_upper = self._compute_hill_inflection(nAabs_hi, K_a_upper)  # magnitude-upper
2665
2666            inflection_b_mean = self._compute_hill_inflection(nB,      K_b_median)
2667            inflection_b_lower = self._compute_hill_inflection(nBabs_lo, K_b_lower)
2668            inflection_b_upper = self._compute_hill_inflection(nBabs_hi, K_b_upper)
2669        
2670            data['inflection_a_median'] = inflection_a_mean
2671            data['inflection_a_lower'] = inflection_a_lower
2672            data['inflection_a_upper'] = inflection_a_upper
2673            data['inflection_b_median'] = inflection_b_mean
2674            data['inflection_b_lower'] = inflection_b_lower
2675            data['inflection_b_upper'] = inflection_b_upper
2676
2677        # Initialize arrays for per-feature results
2678        classifications = []
2679        first_deriv_roots_mean_list = []
2680        second_deriv_roots_mean_list = []
2681        third_deriv_roots_mean_list = []
2682        # For negbinom: roots of dg/du=0 in u-space (g = log2(y) - log2(y_ntc))
2683        # For binomial: roots of dp/du=0 in u-space (same as dy/dx=0 roots, converted to u)
2684        first_deriv_roots_log2fc_mean_list = []
2685        second_deriv_roots_log2fc_mean_list = []
2686        third_deriv_roots_log2fc_mean_list = []
2687        n_first_deriv_roots = []
2688        n_second_deriv_roots = []
2689        n_third_deriv_roots = []
2690        # For negbinom: log2(y_max / y_min)
2691        # For binomial: y_max - y_min (delta_p)
2692        full_log2fc_mean_list = []
2693        full_log2fc_lower_list = []
2694        full_log2fc_upper_list = []
2695        observed_log2fc_list = []
2696        observed_log2fc_lower_list = []
2697        observed_log2fc_upper_list = []
2698
2699        # Multinomial: skip per-feature derived columns (classification, log2fc, derivative roots).
2700        # These assume scalar alpha/beta and a scalar dose-response curve; they are not
2701        # meaningful when alpha and beta are per-category vectors.
2702        # All core parameters (A, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, alpha_cat{k}, etc.) and FDR columns
2703        # are already written to `data` above; derived columns will simply be absent.
2704        if is_multinomial:
2705            return
2706
2707        # Timing accumulators for the per-feature loop
2708        _n_sig = int(np.sum((q_active_a < fdr_threshold) | (q_active_b < fdr_threshold)))
2709        if verbose:
2710            _S_val = Vmax_a_full.shape[0] if Vmax_a_full.ndim > 1 else 1
2711            print(f"  [loop1] {n_features} features  "
2712                  f"{_n_sig} FDR-significant  "
2713                  f"{_S_val} posterior samples")
2714            _loop1_t = {'x_roots': 0.0, 'u_roots': 0.0, 'classify': 0.0,
2715                        'full_lfc_mean': 0.0, 'full_lfc_ci': 0.0,
2716                        'obs_lfc_mean': 0.0, 'obs_lfc_ci': 0.0}
2717            _loop1_start = time.time()
2718
2719        # Process each feature
2720        _iter = tqdm(range(n_features), desc="  [loop1]", disable=not verbose)
2721        for i in _iter:
2722            # Compute FDR activity flag once, used throughout this iteration
2723            _is_flat_i = (q_active_a[i] >= fdr_threshold) and (q_active_b[i] >= fdr_threshold)
2724
2725            # Get median parameters for this feature
2726            alpha_i = alpha_median[i]
2727            beta_i = beta_median[i]
2728            Vmax_a_i = Vmax_a_median[i]
2729            Vmax_b_i = Vmax_b_median[i]
2730            K_a_i = K_a_median[i]
2731            K_b_i = K_b_median[i]
2732            n_a_i = float(n_a_used[i])
2733            n_b_i = float(n_b_used[i])
2734            A_i = A_median[i]
2735
2736            # Observed-extrema arg-locations (used later for CI candidate points)
2737            x_minloc = np.nan
2738            x_maxloc = np.nan
2739
2740            if verbose: _ti = time.time()
2741
2742            # Find derivative roots for mean parameters (x-space)
2743            first_roots_mean = []
2744            second_roots_mean = []
2745            third_roots_mean = []
2746
2747            if compute_derivative_roots and x_range is not None and not _is_flat_i:
2748                # First derivative roots (where dy/dx = 0)
2749                def first_deriv_func(x):
2750                    return self._additive_hill_first_derivative(
2751                        x, alpha_i, Vmax_a_i, K_a_i, n_a_i,
2752                        beta_i, Vmax_b_i, K_b_i, n_b_i
2753                    )
2754                first_roots_mean = self._find_roots_empirical_loose(first_deriv_func, x_range)
2755
2756                # Second derivative roots (inflection points of combined function)
2757                def second_deriv_func(x):
2758                    return self._additive_hill_second_derivative(
2759                        x, alpha_i, Vmax_a_i, K_a_i, n_a_i,
2760                        beta_i, Vmax_b_i, K_b_i, n_b_i
2761                    )
2762                second_roots_mean = self._find_roots_empirical_loose(second_deriv_func, x_range)
2763
2764                # Third derivative roots (where d³y/dx³ = 0)
2765                def third_deriv_func(x):
2766                    return self._additive_hill_third_derivative(
2767                        x, alpha_i, Vmax_a_i, K_a_i, n_a_i,
2768                        beta_i, Vmax_b_i, K_b_i, n_b_i
2769                    )
2770                third_roots_mean = self._find_roots_empirical_loose(third_deriv_func, x_range)
2771
2772            if verbose: _loop1_t['x_roots'] += time.time() - _ti; _ti = time.time()
2773
2774            # --- roots in log2FC x-space (u-space) ---
2775            # Only computed when compute_log2fc_params AND compute_derivative_roots AND FDR-significant.
2776            # For negbinom: dg/du=0, d2g/du2=0, d3g/du3=0 where g = log2(y) - log2(y_ntc)
2777            # For binomial: dp/du=0, etc.
2778            u_roots_g1 = []
2779            u_roots_g2 = []
2780            u_roots_g3 = []
2781
2782            if (compute_log2fc_params and compute_derivative_roots and not _is_flat_i
2783                    and (x_ntc is not None) and np.isfinite(x_ntc) and (x_ntc > 0)
2784                    and (x_obs_min is not None) and (x_obs_max is not None)):
2785
2786                eps = 1e-10
2787                log2_xntc = np.log2(max(float(x_ntc), eps))
2788
2789                # Build u-range for root finding (used for both binomial and negbinom)
2790                u_range_local = self._build_u_range_from_observed_x(
2791                    x_obs_min=x_obs_min,
2792                    x_obs_max=x_obs_max,
2793                    x_ntc=x_ntc,
2794                    n_grid=6000,
2795                    pad_u=0.25
2796                )
2797
2798                # WIDEN using EC50s so we don't miss roots outside observed x-range
2799                u_ec50 = []
2800                if np.isfinite(K_a_i) and K_a_i > 0:
2801                    u_ec50.append(np.log2(max(float(K_a_i), eps)) - log2_xntc)
2802                if np.isfinite(K_b_i) and K_b_i > 0:
2803                    u_ec50.append(np.log2(max(float(K_b_i), eps)) - log2_xntc)
2804
2805                if len(u_ec50) > 0:
2806                    umin = min(float(np.nanmin(u_range_local)), float(np.min(u_ec50))) - 1.0
2807                    umax = max(float(np.nanmax(u_range_local)), float(np.max(u_ec50))) + 1.0
2808                    u_range_local = np.linspace(umin, umax, 6000)
2809
2810                if is_binomial:
2811                    # For binomial (delta_p = S - S_ntc):
2812                    # dp/du = S' * x * ln(2) → roots when S' = 0
2813                    # d²p/du² ∝ S' + x*S'' → roots when S' + x*S'' = 0
2814                    # d³p/du³ ∝ S' + 3x*S'' + x²*S''' → roots when S' + 3x*S'' + x²*S''' = 0
2815
2816                    def p1_num_u(u):
2817                        # dp/du = 0 when S' = 0
2818                        x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp = self._S_derivs_at_u(
2819                            u,
2820                            A=A_i, alpha=alpha_i, Vmax_a=Vmax_a_i, K_a=K_a_i, n_a=n_a_i,
2821                            beta=beta_i, Vmax_b=Vmax_b_i, K_b=K_b_i, n_b=n_b_i,
2822                            x_ntc=x_ntc
2823                        )
2824                        return Sp
2825
2826                    def p2_num_u(u):
2827                        # d²p/du² = 0 when S' + x*S'' = 0
2828                        x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp = self._S_derivs_at_u(
2829                            u,
2830                            A=A_i, alpha=alpha_i, Vmax_a=Vmax_a_i, K_a=K_a_i, n_a=n_a_i,
2831                            beta=beta_i, Vmax_b=Vmax_b_i, K_b=K_b_i, n_b=n_b_i,
2832                            x_ntc=x_ntc
2833                        )
2834                        return Sp + x * Spp
2835
2836                    def p3_num_u(u):
2837                        # d³p/du³ = 0 when S' + 3x*S'' + x²*S''' = 0
2838                        x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp = self._S_derivs_at_u(
2839                            u,
2840                            A=A_i, alpha=alpha_i, Vmax_a=Vmax_a_i, K_a=K_a_i, n_a=n_a_i,
2841                            beta=beta_i, Vmax_b=Vmax_b_i, K_b=K_b_i, n_b=n_b_i,
2842                            x_ntc=x_ntc
2843                        )
2844                        return Sp + 3.0 * x * Spp + (x ** 2) * Sppp
2845
2846                    u_roots_g1 = self._find_roots_on_grid(p1_num_u, u_range_local, include_tangent=True)
2847                    u_roots_g2 = self._find_roots_on_grid(p2_num_u, u_range_local, include_tangent=True)
2848                    u_roots_g3 = self._find_roots_on_grid(p3_num_u, u_range_local, include_tangent=True)
2849                else:
2850                    # For negbinom: find roots of dg/du = 0 directly (involves log2 transformation)
2851                    # g = log2(S) - log2(S_ntc)
2852                    # dg/du = x * S' / S → roots when S' = 0
2853                    # d²g/du² has numerator: S*(S' + x*S'') - x*S'^2
2854                    # d³g/du³ has numerator: S²*(S' + 3x*S'' + x²*S''') - 3S*x*S'*(S' + x*S'') + 2x²*S'^3
2855
2856                    def g1_num_u(u):
2857                        # root of g'(u) is root of Sp (since x>0 and ln2>0)
2858                        x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp = self._S_derivs_at_u(
2859                            u,
2860                            A=A_i, alpha=alpha_i, Vmax_a=Vmax_a_i, K_a=K_a_i, n_a=n_a_i,
2861                            beta=beta_i, Vmax_b=Vmax_b_i, K_b=K_b_i, n_b=n_b_i,
2862                            x_ntc=x_ntc
2863                        )
2864                        return Sp
2865
2866                    def g2_num_u(u):
2867                        # numerator of g''(u):  N2 = S*(Sp + x*Spp) - x*Sp^2
2868                        x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp = self._S_derivs_at_u(
2869                            u,
2870                            A=A_i, alpha=alpha_i, Vmax_a=Vmax_a_i, K_a=K_a_i, n_a=n_a_i,
2871                            beta=beta_i, Vmax_b=Vmax_b_i, K_b=K_b_i, n_b=n_b_i,
2872                            x_ntc=x_ntc
2873                        )
2874                        return S * (Sp + x * Spp) - x * (Sp ** 2)
2875
2876                    def g3_num_u(u):
2877                        # numerator of g'''(u):

3226                )

3229                    beta_i, Vmax_b_i, K_b_i, n_b_i
3230                )
3231

3233                x3 = x_ntc ** 3

3263                    #                      + x³*S'''/S - 3x³*(S'/S)*(S''/S) + 2x³*(S'/S)³]
3264                    S_ratio = S_prime / y_at_ntc      # S'/S
3265                    S2_ratio = S_double_prime / y_at_ntc  # S''/S
3266                    S3_ratio = S_triple_prime / y_at_ntc  # S'''/S
3267
3268                    t1 = x_ntc * S_ratio              # x*S'/S
3269                    t2 = 3 * x2 * S2_ratio            # 3x²*S''/S
3270                    t3 = -3 * x2 * S_ratio ** 2       # -3x²*(S'/S)²
3271                    t4 = x3 * S3_ratio                # x³*S'''/S
3272                    t5 = -3 * x3 * S_ratio * S2_ratio # -3x³*(S'/S)*(S''/S)
3273                    t6 = 2 * x3 * S_ratio ** 3        # 2x³*(S'/S)³
3274                    d3g_du3 = ln2_sq * (t1 + t2 + t3 + t4 + t5 + t6)
3275
3276                    return dg_du, d2g_du2, d3g_du3
3277
3278            for i in range(n_features):
3279                is_flat_i = (q_active_a[i] >= fdr_threshold) and (q_active_b[i] >= fdr_threshold)
3280                
3281                if is_flat_i:
3282                    y_ntc_i = y_ntc[i] if y_ntc is not None else np.nan
3283                    # if n==0 for both, Hill(x_ntc)=0.5*Vmax
3284                    H_a = 0.5 * Vmax_a_median[i]
3285                    H_b = 0.5 * Vmax_b_median[i]
3286                    y_at_ntc = A_median[i] + alpha_median[i] * H_a + beta_median[i] * H_b
3287                    if (y_at_ntc > epsilon) and (y_ntc_i > epsilon):
3288                        log2fc_at_0[i] = np.log2(y_at_ntc) - np.log2(y_ntc_i)
3289                    else:
3290                        log2fc_at_0[i] = np.nan
3291                    # For binomial: compute delta_p = p(x_ntc) - p_ntc
3292                    if is_binomial and np.isfinite(y_ntc_i):
3293                        delta_p_at_0[i] = y_at_ntc - y_ntc_i
3294                    # Derivatives at u0 are zero for flat genes (only stored if compute_derivative_roots)
3295                    if compute_derivative_roots:
3296                        dg_du_at_0[i] = 0.0
3297                        d2g_du2_at_0[i] = 0.0
3298                        d3g_du3_at_0[i] = 0.0
3299                        dg_du_at_0_lower[i] = 0.0
3300                        dg_du_at_0_upper[i] = 0.0
3301                        d2g_du2_at_0_lower[i] = 0.0
3302                        d2g_du2_at_0_upper[i] = 0.0
3303                        d3g_du3_at_0_lower[i] = 0.0
3304                        d3g_du3_at_0_upper[i] = 0.0
3305                    continue
3306
3307                # Get median parameters for this feature
3308                alpha_i = alpha_median[i]
3309                beta_i = beta_median[i]
3310                Vmax_a_i = Vmax_a_median[i]
3311                Vmax_b_i = Vmax_b_median[i]
3312                K_a_i = K_a_median[i]
3313                K_b_i = K_b_median[i]
3314                n_a_i = float(n_a_used[i])
3315                n_b_i = float(n_b_used[i])
3316                A_i = A_median[i]
3317                y_ntc_i = y_ntc[i] if y_ntc is not None else 1.0
3318
3319                # Compute y(x_ntc) and log2fc_at_u0 for all significant genes (cheap)
3320                H_a_at_ntc = self._hill_value(x_ntc, Vmax_a_i, K_a_i, n_a_i)
3321                H_b_at_ntc = self._hill_value(x_ntc, Vmax_b_i, K_b_i, n_b_i)
3322                y_at_ntc = A_i + alpha_i * H_a_at_ntc + beta_i * H_b_at_ntc
3323
3324                if is_binomial and np.isfinite(y_ntc_i):
3325                    delta_p_at_0[i] = y_at_ntc - y_ntc_i
3326
3327                if y_at_ntc > epsilon and y_ntc_i > epsilon:
3328                    log2fc_at_0[i] = np.log2(y_at_ntc) - np.log2(y_ntc_i)
3329
3330                    # Derivatives at u0: only computed when compute_derivative_roots=True
3331                    if compute_derivative_roots:
3332                        dg_du, d2g_du2, d3g_du3 = _compute_derivs_at_u0(
3333                            alpha_i, beta_i, Vmax_a_i, Vmax_b_i, K_a_i, K_b_i, n_a_i, n_b_i, A_i, y_ntc_i
3334                        )
3335                        dg_du_at_0[i] = dg_du
3336                        d2g_du2_at_0[i] = d2g_du2
3337                        d3g_du3_at_0[i] = d3g_du3
3338
3339                        # CI from all posterior samples (no cap)
3340                        if Vmax_a_full.ndim > 1:
3341                            S = Vmax_a_full.shape[0]
3342                            sample_dg_du = []
3343                            sample_d2g_du2 = []
3344                            sample_d3g_du3 = []
3345
3346                            for s in range(S):
3347                                alpha_s = float(alpha_full[s, i] if alpha_full.ndim > 1 else alpha_full[i])
3348                                beta_s  = float(beta_full[s, i]  if beta_full.ndim > 1 else beta_full[i])
3349                                Vmax_a_s = Vmax_a_full[s, i]
3350                                Vmax_b_s = Vmax_b_full[s, i]
3351                                K_a_s = K_a_full[s, i]
3352                                K_b_s = K_b_full[s, i]
3353                                n_a_s = float(n_a_full[s, i])
3354                                n_b_s = float(n_b_full[s, i])
3355                                if q_active_a[i] >= fdr_threshold:
3356                                    alpha_s = 0.0
3357                                if q_active_b[i] >= fdr_threshold:
3358                                    beta_s = 0.0
3359                                A_s = A_full[s, i] if A_full.ndim > 1 else A_full[i]
3360
3361                                dg, d2g, d3g = _compute_derivs_at_u0(
3362                                    alpha_s, beta_s, Vmax_a_s, Vmax_b_s, K_a_s, K_b_s, n_a_s, n_b_s, A_s, y_ntc_i
3363                                )
3364                                if not np.isnan(dg):
3365                                    sample_dg_du.append(dg)
3366                                if not np.isnan(d2g):
3367                                    sample_d2g_du2.append(d2g)
3368                                if not np.isnan(d3g):
3369                                    sample_d3g_du3.append(d3g)
3370
3371                            if sample_dg_du:
3372                                dg_du_at_0_lower[i] = np.quantile(sample_dg_du, 0.025)
3373                                dg_du_at_0_upper[i] = np.quantile(sample_dg_du, 0.975)
3374                            if sample_d2g_du2:
3375                                d2g_du2_at_0_lower[i] = np.quantile(sample_d2g_du2, 0.025)
3376                                d2g_du2_at_0_upper[i] = np.quantile(sample_d2g_du2, 0.975)
3377                            if sample_d3g_du3:
3378                                d3g_du3_at_0_lower[i] = np.quantile(sample_d3g_du3, 0.025)
3379                                d3g_du3_at_0_upper[i] = np.quantile(sample_d3g_du3, 0.975)
3380                        else:
3381                            # No posterior samples, use mean as lower/upper
3382                            dg_du_at_0_lower[i] = dg_du
3383                            dg_du_at_0_upper[i] = dg_du
3384                            d2g_du2_at_0_lower[i] = d2g_du2
3385                            d2g_du2_at_0_upper[i] = d2g_du2
3386                            d3g_du3_at_0_lower[i] = d3g_du3
3387                            d3g_du3_at_0_upper[i] = d3g_du3
3388
3389            if verbose:
3390                print(f"  [loop2] total: {time.time() - _t_loop2_start:.1f}s")
3391
3392            # log2fc_at_u0 is always added (cheap, per-gene scalar) when compute_log2fc_params=True
3393            data['log2fc_at_u0'] = log2fc_at_0
3394            if is_binomial:
3395                data['delta_p_at_u0'] = delta_p_at_0
3396
3397            # Derivative columns only added when compute_derivative_roots=True
3398            if compute_derivative_roots:
3399                if is_binomial:
3400                    data['dp_du_at_u0'] = dg_du_at_0
3401                    data['dp_du_at_u0_lower'] = dg_du_at_0_lower
3402                    data['dp_du_at_u0_upper'] = dg_du_at_0_upper
3403                    data['d2p_du2_at_u0'] = d2g_du2_at_0
3404                    data['d2p_du2_at_u0_lower'] = d2g_du2_at_0_lower
3405                    data['d2p_du2_at_u0_upper'] = d2g_du2_at_0_upper
3406                    data['d3p_du3_at_u0'] = d3g_du3_at_0
3407                    data['d3p_du3_at_u0_lower'] = d3g_du3_at_0_lower
3408                    data['d3p_du3_at_u0_upper'] = d3g_du3_at_0_upper
3409                else:
3410                    data['dg_du_at_u0'] = dg_du_at_0
3411                    data['dg_du_at_u0_lower'] = dg_du_at_0_lower
3412                    data['dg_du_at_u0_upper'] = dg_du_at_0_upper
3413                    data['d2g_du2_at_u0'] = d2g_du2_at_0
3414                    data['d2g_du2_at_u0_lower'] = d2g_du2_at_0_lower
3415                    data['d2g_du2_at_u0_upper'] = d2g_du2_at_0_upper
3416                    data['d3g_du3_at_u0'] = d3g_du3_at_0
3417                    data['d3g_du3_at_u0_lower'] = d3g_du3_at_0_lower
3418                    data['d3g_du3_at_u0_upper'] = d3g_du3_at_0_upper
3419
3420            # EC50 in log2FC space: log2(K) - log2(x_ntc)
3421            data['EC50_a_log2fc'] = np.log2(np.maximum(K_a_median, epsilon)) - log2_x_ntc
3422            data['EC50_b_log2fc'] = np.log2(np.maximum(K_b_median, epsilon)) - log2_x_ntc
3423
3424            # Inflection points in log2FC space
3425            if compute_inflection:
3426                def _log2fc_transform(arr):
3427                    out = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3428                    ok = np.isfinite(arr) & (arr > epsilon)
3429                    out[ok] = np.log2(arr[ok]) - log2_x_ntc
3430                    return out
3431
3432                data['inflection_a_log2fc_median'] = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_a_median', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3433                data['inflection_a_log2fc_lower']  = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_a_lower', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3434                data['inflection_a_log2fc_upper']  = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_a_upper', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3435
3436                data['inflection_b_log2fc_median'] = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_b_median', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3437                data['inflection_b_log2fc_lower']  = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_b_lower', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3438                data['inflection_b_log2fc_upper']  = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_b_upper', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3439                            
3440            # A (baseline) in transformed y-space
3441            # For negbinom: A_log2fc = log2(A) - log2(y_ntc)
3442            # For binomial: A_delta_p = A - y_ntc
3443            if is_binomial:
3444                A_delta_p = A_median - y_ntc
3445                data['A_delta_p'] = A_delta_p
3446            else:
3447                A_log2fc = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3448                valid_A = (A_median > epsilon) & (y_ntc > epsilon)
3449                if np.any(valid_A):
3450                    A_log2fc[valid_A] = np.log2(A_median[valid_A]) - np.log2(y_ntc[valid_A])
3451                data['A_log2fc'] = A_log2fc
3452
3453        return data
3454
3455    def _add_single_hill_params(
3456        self, data, posterior, n_features,
3457        compute_inflection: bool = True,
3458        compute_derivative_roots: bool = True,
3459        x_range: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
3460        x_obs_min: Optional[float] = None,
3461        x_obs_max: Optional[float] = None,
3462        compute_log2fc_params: bool = False,
3463        compute_lfc_ci: bool = True,
3464        x_ntc=None,
3465        y_ntc=None,
3466        fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
3467        verbose: bool = False,
3468    ):
3469        """
3470        Add single Hill parameters to data dict.
3471
3472        Single Hill model: y = A + alpha * Vmax * x^n / (K^n + x^n)
3473
3474        Parameters stored (with _mean, _lower, _upper suffixes):
3475        - Vmax_a: Hill amplitude (maximum effect)
3476        - K_a: Half-max concentration (EC50/IC50)
3477        - n_a: Hill coefficient (cooperativity, sign determines direction)
3478        - alpha: Weight/scale factor
3479        - A: Baseline offset
3480
3481        Also computes:
3482        - inflection_a: Inflection point (exists when |n| > 1)
3483        - full_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over theoretical range
3484        - observed_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over observed x range
3485        - Derivative roots (first, second, third) where dy/dx=0, d²y/dx²=0, d³y/dx³=0
3486        - Log2FC transforms if x_ntc and y_ntc are provided
3487        """
3488        # --- shared extraction helpers ---
3489        def extract_param(name):
3490            param = posterior[name]
3491            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
3492                param = param.cpu().numpy()
3493            # squeeze [S,1,T] -> [S,T]
3494            if param.ndim == 3 and param.shape[1] == 1:
3495                param = param.squeeze(1)
3496            # average over extra dims if needed (e.g. multinomial categories)
3497            if param.ndim > 2:
3498                param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
3499
3500            if param.ndim == 2:  # [S, T]
3501                mean = np.median(param, axis=0)
3502                lo = np.quantile(param, 0.025, axis=0)
3503                hi = np.quantile(param, 0.975, axis=0)
3504            else:                # [T] point
3505                mean = lo = hi = param
3506            return mean, lo, hi
3507
3508        def extract_param_full(name):
3509            param = posterior[name]
3510            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
3511                param = param.cpu().numpy()
3512            if param.ndim == 3 and param.shape[1] == 1:
3513                param = param.squeeze(1)
3514            if param.ndim > 2:
3515                param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
3516            return param  # [S,T] or [T]
3517
3518        def extract_param_abs(name):
3519            param = posterior[name]
3520            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
3521                param = param.cpu().numpy()
3522            if param.ndim == 3 and param.shape[1] == 1:
3523                param = param.squeeze(1)
3524            if param.ndim > 2:
3525                param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
3526
3527            param_abs = np.abs(param)
3528            if param_abs.ndim == 2:
3529                mean = np.median(param_abs, axis=0)
3530                lo = np.quantile(param_abs, 0.025, axis=0)
3531                hi = np.quantile(param_abs, 0.975, axis=0)
3532            else:
3533                mean = lo = hi = param_abs
3534            return mean, lo, hi
3535
3536        def _broadcast(arr):
3537            arr = np.atleast_1d(arr)
3538            if arr.size == 1:
3539                return np.full(n_features, arr.item())
3540            return arr
3541    
3542        # --- core params ---
3543        Vmax_mean, Vmax_lo, Vmax_hi = extract_param('Vmax_a')
3544        K_mean,    K_lo,    K_hi    = extract_param('K_a')
3545        n_mean,    n_lo,    n_hi    = extract_param('n_a')
3546
3547        # Use raw n means; FDR thresholding controls activity.
3548        n_used = n_mean
3549    
3550        Vmax_full = extract_param_full('Vmax_a')
3551        K_full    = extract_param_full('K_a')
3552        n_full    = extract_param_full('n_a')
3553    
3554        if 'alpha' in posterior:
3555            alpha_mean, alpha_lo, alpha_hi = extract_param('alpha')
3556            alpha_full = extract_param_full('alpha')
3557            alpha_mean = _broadcast(alpha_mean); alpha_lo = _broadcast(alpha_lo); alpha_hi = _broadcast(alpha_hi)
3558            if alpha_full.ndim == 1:
3559                alpha_full = alpha_full.reshape(-1, 1)
3560            if alpha_full.shape[-1] == 1:
3561                alpha_full = np.broadcast_to(alpha_full, (alpha_full.shape[0], n_features)).copy()
3562        else:
3563            alpha_mean = np.ones(n_features); alpha_lo = np.ones(n_features); alpha_hi = np.ones(n_features)
3564            alpha_full = np.ones((1, n_features))
3565    
3566        if 'A' in posterior:
3567            A_mean, A_lo, A_hi = extract_param('A')
3568            A_full = extract_param_full('A')
3569            A_mean = _broadcast(A_mean); A_lo = _broadcast(A_lo); A_hi = _broadcast(A_hi)
3570            if A_full.ndim == 1:
3571                A_full = A_full.reshape(-1, 1)
3572            if A_full.shape[-1] == 1:
3573                A_full = np.broadcast_to(A_full, (A_full.shape[0], n_features)).copy()
3574        else:
3575            A_mean = np.zeros(n_features); A_lo = np.zeros(n_features); A_hi = np.zeros(n_features)
3576            A_full = np.zeros((1, n_features))
3577
3578        
3579        data['Vmax_a_median'] = Vmax_mean
3580        data['Vmax_a_lower'] = Vmax_lo
3581        data['Vmax_a_upper'] = Vmax_hi
3582        data['K_a_median'] = K_mean
3583        data['K_a_lower'] = K_lo
3584        data['K_a_upper'] = K_hi
3585        data['n_a_median'] = n_mean
3586        data['n_a_lower'] = n_lo
3587        data['n_a_upper'] = n_hi
3588        data['alpha_median'] = alpha_mean
3589        data['alpha_lower'] = alpha_lo
3590        data['alpha_upper'] = alpha_hi
3591        data['A_median'] = A_mean
3592        data['A_lower'] = A_lo
3593        data['A_upper'] = A_hi
3594
3595        # Multinomial: export per-category A, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, alpha for simulation.
3596        # These parallel the per-category alpha/beta columns already in _add_additive_hill_params.
3597        if distribution == 'multinomial':
3598            def _extract_single_cat_param(name):
3599                """Return raw numpy [S, T, K-1] (or [S, T, K] for A) for a per-category parameter."""
3600                if name not in posterior:
3601                    return None
3602                p = posterior[name]
3603                if isinstance(p, torch.Tensor):
3604                    p = p.cpu().numpy()
3605                if p.ndim == 4 and p.shape[1] == 1:
3606                    p = p.squeeze(1)
3607                if p.ndim == 3 and p.shape[1] == n_features:
3608                    return p
3609                return None
3610
3611            # A: shape [S, T, K] — export K-1 fitted categories and residual
3612            A_raw_sh = _extract_single_cat_param('A')
3613            if A_raw_sh is not None:
3614                K_dim = A_raw_sh.shape[2]
3615                AK = A_raw_sh[:, :, -1]
3616                data['A_K_median'] = np.median(AK, axis=0)
3617                data['A_K_lower'] = np.quantile(AK, 0.025, axis=0)
3618                data['A_K_upper'] = np.quantile(AK, 0.975, axis=0)
3619                for k in range(K_dim - 1):
3620                    ck = A_raw_sh[:, :, k]
3621                    data[f'A_cat{k}_median'] = np.median(ck, axis=0)
3622                    data[f'A_cat{k}_lower'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.025, axis=0)
3623                    data[f'A_cat{k}_upper'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.975, axis=0)
3624
3625            # Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, alpha: shape [S, T, K-1]
3626            for hill_param in ['Vmax_a', 'K_a', 'n_a', 'alpha']:
3627                cat_arr = _extract_single_cat_param(hill_param)
3628                if cat_arr is not None:
3629                    n_cats = cat_arr.shape[2]
3630                    for k in range(n_cats):
3631                        ck = cat_arr[:, :, k]
3632                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_median'] = np.median(ck, axis=0)
3633                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_lower'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.025, axis=0)
3634                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_upper'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.975, axis=0)
3635
3636        # Compute product-based FDR for single_hill: P(alpha * Vmax / A > epsilon)
3637        _ACTIVITY_EPSILON = 0.01
3638        if alpha_full.ndim >= 2 and Vmax_full.ndim >= 2 and A_full.ndim >= 2:
3639            _ratio = alpha_full * Vmax_full / np.maximum(A_full, 1e-12)
3640            p_active = (_ratio > _ACTIVITY_EPSILON).mean(axis=0)
3641        else:
3642            p_active = alpha_mean.copy()
3643        p_active = np.asarray(p_active, dtype=float).ravel()
3644        _lfdr = 1.0 - p_active
3645        _ord = np.argsort(_lfdr)
3646        _cumfdr = np.cumsum(_lfdr[_ord]) / (np.arange(n_features, dtype=float) + 1.0)
3647        _qsorted = np.minimum.accumulate(_cumfdr[::-1])[::-1]
3648        q_active = np.empty(n_features, dtype=float); q_active[_ord] = _qsorted
3649        q_active = np.where(p_active < 1e-9, 1.0, q_active)
3650
3651        # --- inflection of the Hill component ---
3652        if compute_inflection:
3653            n_abs_mean, n_abs_lo, n_abs_hi = extract_param_abs('n_a')
3654            
3655            infl_mean = self._compute_hill_inflection(n_abs_mean, K_mean)
3656            infl_lo   = self._compute_hill_inflection(n_abs_lo,   K_lo)
3657            infl_hi   = self._compute_hill_inflection(n_abs_hi,   K_hi)
3658            
3659            # (optional) store |n| summaries too
3660            data['n_a_abs_median'] = n_abs_mean
3661            data['n_a_abs_lower'] = n_abs_lo
3662            data['n_a_abs_upper'] = n_abs_hi
3663            data['inflection_a_median'] = infl_mean
3664            data['inflection_a_lower'] = infl_lo
3665            data['inflection_a_upper'] = infl_hi
3666    
3667        # --- full log2FC range for y = A + alpha*Hill ---
3668        if compute_log2fc_params:
3669            _S_val = Vmax_full.shape[0] if Vmax_full.ndim == 2 else 1
3670            if verbose:
3671                _n_sig = int(np.sum(q_active < fdr_threshold))
3672                print(f"  [single_hill] {n_features} features  {_n_sig} FDR-sig  {_S_val} samples")
3673            _t_sh = time.time()
3674            eps = 1e-10
3675
3676            # mean version using n_used, with correct n==0 limits (Hill == 0.5*V everywhere)
3677            n_u = np.asarray(n_used, dtype=float)
3678
3679            hill0 = np.where(
3680                np.abs(n_u) < 1e-15,
3681                0.5 * Vmax_mean,
3682                np.where(n_u < 0, Vmax_mean, 0.0)
3683            )
3684            hillinf = np.where(
3685                np.abs(n_u) < 1e-15,
3686                0.5 * Vmax_mean,
3687                np.where(n_u < 0, 0.0, Vmax_mean)
3688            )
3689
3690            y0 = np.maximum(A_mean + alpha_mean * hill0, eps)
3691            yinf = np.maximum(A_mean + alpha_mean * hillinf, eps)
3692
3693            fdr_inactive = q_active >= fdr_threshold
3694            log2fc_vals = np.log2(np.maximum(y0, yinf) / np.minimum(y0, yinf))
3695            data['full_log2fc_median'] = np.where(fdr_inactive, 0.0, log2fc_vals)
3696
3697            # CI from posterior samples (coherent; use all available samples)
3698            if Vmax_full.ndim == 2 and compute_lfc_ci:
3699                S = Vmax_full.shape[0]
3700                lo = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3701                hi = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3702
3703                for i in range(n_features):
3704                    vals = []
3705                    for s in range(S):
3706                        V_s = float(Vmax_full[s, i])
3707                        K_s = float(K_full[s, i])
3708                        a_s = float(alpha_full[s, i]) if alpha_full.ndim == 2 else float(alpha_full[i])
3709                        A_s = float(A_full[s, i]) if A_full.ndim == 2 else float(A_full[i])
3710                        n_s = float(n_full[s, i])
3711                        # Gate inactive component via FDR (zero alpha, not n)
3712                        if q_active[i] >= fdr_threshold:
3713                            a_s = 0.0
3714        
3715                        # boundaries for single hill
3716                        if abs(n_s) < 1e-15:
3717                            # constant hill = 0.5*V everywhere -> no boundary range
3718                            y0_s = max(A_s + a_s * 0.5 * V_s, eps)
3719                            yinf_s = y0_s
3720                        else:
3721                            h0 = V_s if n_s < 0 else 0.0
3722                            hinf = 0.0 if n_s < 0 else V_s
3723                            y0_s = max(A_s + a_s * h0, eps)
3724                            yinf_s = max(A_s + a_s * hinf, eps)
3725        
3726                        vals.append(np.log2(max(y0_s, yinf_s) / min(y0_s, yinf_s)))
3727
