2308        Add additive Hill parameters from individual parameter architecture (Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, etc.).
2309
2310        Includes:
2311        - Basic parameters with mean and 95% CI
2312        - Function classification based on dependency masks
2313        - Derivative roots (where dy/dx=0 and d²y/dx²=0)
2314        - full_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over theoretical range (in log2 space)
2315        - observed_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over observed x range (in log2 space)
2316        - Log2FC versions of parameters relative to NTC (if compute_log2fc_params=True)
2317
2318        For binomial distributions:
2319        - Uses delta_p (y_max - y_min) instead of log2fc (log2(y_max/y_min))
2320        - Derivative roots are found in y-space (dy/dx=0), then converted to u-space
2321        """
2322
2323        # Check distribution type for delta_p vs log2fc handling
2324        distribution = data.get('distribution', 'negbinom')
2325        is_binomial = (distribution == 'binomial')
2326
2327        def extract_param(name):
2328            """Helper to extract parameter with consistent handling of samples vs point estimates."""
2329            param = posterior[name]
2330            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
2331                param = param.cpu().numpy()
2332
2333            # Handle different dimensionalities
2334            # Common shapes:
2335            # - [n_samples, n_features]: standard 2D
2336            # - [n_samples, 1, n_features]: has cis gene dimension (size 1) to squeeze
2337            # - [n_samples, n_features, n_categories]: multinomial, average over categories
2338            if param.ndim >= 2:
2339                if param.ndim == 3:
2340                    # Check if middle dimension is size 1 (cis gene dim to squeeze)
2341                    if param.shape[1] == 1:
2342                        param = param.squeeze(1)  # [n_samples, 1, n_features] -> [n_samples, n_features]
2343                    else:
2344                        # Otherwise it's [n_samples, n_features, n_categories] - average over categories
2345                        param = param.mean(axis=2)
2346                elif param.ndim > 3:
2347                    # Higher dimensions: squeeze size-1 dims, then average remaining extras
2348                    # First try to squeeze the cis gene dimension (axis 1) if size 1
2349                    if param.shape[1] == 1:
2350                        param = param.squeeze(1)
2351                    # Average over any remaining dimensions beyond 2
2352                    if param.ndim > 2:
2353                        param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
2354
2355                mean_val = np.median(param, axis=0)
2356                lower_val = np.quantile(param, 0.025, axis=0)
2357                upper_val = np.quantile(param, 0.975, axis=0)
2358            else:
2359                # Point estimate: [n_features]
2360                mean_val = param
2361                lower_val = param
2362                upper_val = param
2363
2364            return mean_val, lower_val, upper_val
2365
2366        def extract_param_full(name):
2367            """Extract full posterior samples for per-sample computations."""
2368            param = posterior[name]
2369            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
2370                param = param.cpu().numpy()
2371            # Handle [n_samples, 1, n_features] -> [n_samples, n_features]
2372            if param.ndim == 3 and param.shape[1] == 1:
2373                param = param.squeeze(1)
2374            elif param.ndim > 2:
2375                # For other 3D+ cases, average over extra dimensions
2376                if param.shape[1] == 1:
2377                    param = param.squeeze(1)
2378                if param.ndim > 2:
2379                    param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
2380            return param  # [n_samples, n_features] or [n_features]
2381
2382        def extract_param_abs(name):
2383            """
2384            Posterior summaries for abs(parameter). This is needed for inflection because it depends on |n|.
2385            Returns mean, lower(2.5%), upper(97.5%) of |param|.
2386            """
2387            param = posterior[name]
2388            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
2389                param = param.cpu().numpy()
2390        
2391            # Match extract_param logic:
2392            if param.ndim == 3 and param.shape[1] == 1:
2393                param = param.squeeze(1)
2394            elif param.ndim > 2:
2395                if param.shape[1] == 1:
2396                    param = param.squeeze(1)
2397                if param.ndim > 2:
2398                    param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
2399        
2400            param_abs = np.abs(param)
2401
2402            if param_abs.ndim >= 2:
2403                mean_val = np.median(param_abs, axis=0)
2404                lower_val = np.quantile(param_abs, 0.025, axis=0)
2405                upper_val = np.quantile(param_abs, 0.975, axis=0)
2406            else:
2407                mean_val = lower_val = upper_val = param_abs
2408
2409            return mean_val, lower_val, upper_val
2410
2411        # Component A (first Hill function)
2412        Vmax_a_median, Vmax_a_lower, Vmax_a_upper = extract_param('Vmax_a')
2413        K_a_median, K_a_lower, K_a_upper = extract_param('K_a')  # EC50
2414        n_a_median, n_a_lower, n_a_upper = extract_param('n_a')  # Hill coefficient
2415
2416        data['Vmax_a_median'] = Vmax_a_median
2417        data['Vmax_a_lower'] = Vmax_a_lower
2418        data['Vmax_a_upper'] = Vmax_a_upper
2419        data['EC50_a_median'] = K_a_median
2420        data['EC50_a_lower'] = K_a_lower
2421        data['EC50_a_upper'] = K_a_upper
2422        data['n_a_median'] = n_a_median
2423        data['n_a_lower'] = n_a_lower
2424        data['n_a_upper'] = n_a_upper
2425
2426        # Component B (second Hill function)
2427        Vmax_b_median, Vmax_b_lower, Vmax_b_upper = extract_param('Vmax_b')
2428        K_b_median, K_b_lower, K_b_upper = extract_param('K_b')  # EC50
2429        n_b_median, n_b_lower, n_b_upper = extract_param('n_b')  # Hill coefficient
2430
2431        data['Vmax_b_median'] = Vmax_b_median
2432        data['Vmax_b_lower'] = Vmax_b_lower
2433        data['Vmax_b_upper'] = Vmax_b_upper
2434        data['EC50_b_median'] = K_b_median
2435        data['EC50_b_lower'] = K_b_lower
2436        data['EC50_b_upper'] = K_b_upper
2437        data['n_b_median'] = n_b_median
2438        data['n_b_lower'] = n_b_lower
2439        data['n_b_upper'] = n_b_upper
2440
2441        # Use raw posterior medians for n; component activity is determined by FDR
2442        # (q_active_a / q_active_b, computed below) rather than CI-based n-zeroing.
2443        n_a_used = n_a_median
2444        n_b_used = n_b_median
2445
2446        # Pi_y (sparsity weight) - optional
2447        if 'pi_y' in posterior:
2448            pi_y_median, pi_y_lower, pi_y_upper = extract_param('pi_y')
2449            data['pi_y_median'] = pi_y_median
2450            data['pi_y_lower'] = pi_y_lower
2451            data['pi_y_upper'] = pi_y_upper
2452
2453        # Alpha and beta (component weights)
2454        # Default to 1.0 if not present (no sparsity)
2455        # Note: alpha/beta may be scalars (shared across features) or per-feature
2456        def _broadcast_to_features(arr, n_features):
2457            """Broadcast scalar or size-1 array to n_features length."""
2458            arr = np.atleast_1d(arr)
2459            if arr.size == 1:
2460                return np.full(n_features, arr.flat[0])
2461            return arr
2462
2463        if 'alpha' in posterior:
2464            alpha_median, alpha_lower, alpha_upper = extract_param('alpha')
2465            alpha_full = extract_param_full('alpha')
2466            # Broadcast if scalar
2467            alpha_median = _broadcast_to_features(alpha_median, n_features)
2468            alpha_lower = _broadcast_to_features(alpha_lower, n_features)
2469            alpha_upper = _broadcast_to_features(alpha_upper, n_features)
2470            if alpha_full.ndim == 1:
2471                # (n_features,) point estimate → (1, n_features)
2472                alpha_full = alpha_full[np.newaxis, :]
2473            elif alpha_full.shape[-1] == 1:
2474                # (n_samples, 1) scalar → (n_samples, n_features)
2475                alpha_full = np.broadcast_to(alpha_full, (alpha_full.shape[0], n_features)).copy()
2476        else:
2477            alpha_median = np.ones(n_features)
2478            alpha_lower = np.ones(n_features)
2479            alpha_upper = np.ones(n_features)
2480            alpha_full = np.ones((1, n_features))
2481
2482        if 'beta' in posterior:
2483            beta_median, beta_lower, beta_upper = extract_param('beta')
2484            beta_full = extract_param_full('beta')
2485            # Broadcast if scalar
2486            beta_median = _broadcast_to_features(beta_median, n_features)
2487            beta_lower = _broadcast_to_features(beta_lower, n_features)
2488            beta_upper = _broadcast_to_features(beta_upper, n_features)
2489            if beta_full.ndim == 1:
2490                # (n_features,) point estimate → (1, n_features)
2491                beta_full = beta_full[np.newaxis, :]
2492            elif beta_full.shape[-1] == 1:
2493                # (n_samples, 1) scalar → (n_samples, n_features)
2494                beta_full = np.broadcast_to(beta_full, (beta_full.shape[0], n_features)).copy()
2495        else:
2496            beta_median = np.ones(n_features)
2497            beta_lower = np.ones(n_features)
2498            beta_upper = np.ones(n_features)
2499            beta_full = np.ones((1, n_features))
2500
2501        data['alpha_median'] = alpha_median
2502        data['alpha_lower'] = alpha_lower
2503        data['alpha_upper'] = alpha_upper
2504        data['beta_median'] = beta_median
2505        data['beta_lower'] = beta_lower
2506        data['beta_upper'] = beta_upper
2507
2508        # Also save K_a and K_b explicitly (same as EC50 but clearer naming for function recreation)
2509        data['K_a_median'] = K_a_median
2510        data['K_a_lower'] = K_a_lower
2511        data['K_a_upper'] = K_a_upper
2512        data['K_b_median'] = K_b_median
2513        data['K_b_lower'] = K_b_lower
2514        data['K_b_upper'] = K_b_upper
2515
2516        # Get A (baseline) - required to recreate the fitted function
2517        if 'A' in posterior:
2518            A_median, A_lower, A_upper = extract_param('A')
2519            A_full = extract_param_full('A')
2520            # Broadcast if scalar
2521            A_median = _broadcast_to_features(A_median, n_features)
2522            A_lower = _broadcast_to_features(A_lower, n_features)
2523            A_upper = _broadcast_to_features(A_upper, n_features)
2524            if A_full.ndim == 1 or A_full.shape[-1] == 1:
2525                A_full = np.broadcast_to(A_full.reshape(-1, 1), (A_full.shape[0] if A_full.ndim > 1 else 1, n_features)).copy()
2526        else:
2527            A_median = np.zeros(n_features)
2528            A_lower = np.zeros(n_features)
2529            A_upper = np.zeros(n_features)
2530            A_full = np.zeros((1, n_features))
2531
2532        # Save A (baseline) to data dict
2533        data['A_median'] = A_median
2534        data['A_lower'] = A_lower
2535        data['A_upper'] = A_upper
2536
2537        # Multinomial: add per-category alpha/beta columns and A_K (Kth residual baseline)
2538        # For multinomial, alpha/beta have shape [S, T, K-1] after model sampling.
2539        # extract_param averages over category dim, so we add per-category summaries here.
2540        is_multinomial = (distribution == 'multinomial')
2541        if is_multinomial:
2542            def _extract_cat_param(name):
2543                """Return raw numpy [S, T, K-1] for a per-category parameter."""
2544                if name not in posterior:
2545                    return None
2546                p = posterior[name]
2547                if isinstance(p, torch.Tensor):
2548                    p = p.cpu().numpy()
2549                # Shape [S, 1, T, K-1] → [S, T, K-1] (squeeze cis-gene dim if present)
2550                if p.ndim == 4 and p.shape[1] == 1:
2551                    p = p.squeeze(1)
2552                # Only return if genuinely [S, T, K-1]
2553                if p.ndim == 3 and p.shape[1] == n_features:
2554                    return p
2555                return None
2556
2557            for param_name, prefix in [('alpha', 'alpha'), ('beta', 'beta')]:
2558                cat_arr = _extract_cat_param(param_name)
2559                if cat_arr is not None:
2560                    n_cats = cat_arr.shape[2]
2561                    for k in range(n_cats):
2562                        ck = cat_arr[:, :, k]  # [S, T]
2563                        data[f'{prefix}_cat{k}_median'] = np.median(ck, axis=0)
2564                        data[f'{prefix}_cat{k}_lower'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.025, axis=0)
2565                        data[f'{prefix}_cat{k}_upper'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.975, axis=0)
2566
2567            # A_K: the implicit Kth (residual) category baseline from Dirichlet A, shape [S, T, K].
2568            # Modality.__init__ ensures column K_max-1 is always a real category (by swapping
2569            # the last real category there for features with K_actual < K_max), so [:, :, -1]
2570            # is always the correct residual baseline.
2571            # Also export all K per-category A values and per-category Hill params so that
2572            # simulation can reconstruct the full per-category dose-response curves.
2573            if 'A' in posterior:
2574                A_raw = posterior['A']
2575                if isinstance(A_raw, torch.Tensor):
2576                    A_raw = A_raw.cpu().numpy()
2577                if A_raw.ndim == 4 and A_raw.shape[1] == 1:
2578                    A_raw = A_raw.squeeze(1)
2579                if A_raw.ndim == 3 and A_raw.shape[1] == n_features:
2580                    AK = A_raw[:, :, -1]  # [S, T] — residual always at K_max-1
2581                    data['A_K_median'] = np.median(AK, axis=0)
2582                    data['A_K_lower'] = np.quantile(AK, 0.025, axis=0)
2583                    data['A_K_upper'] = np.quantile(AK, 0.975, axis=0)
2584                    # Per-category A for k=0..K-2 (K-1 fitted, last is residual A_K above)
2585                    K_dim = A_raw.shape[2]
2586                    for k in range(K_dim - 1):
2587                        ck = A_raw[:, :, k]  # [S, T]
2588                        data[f'A_cat{k}_median'] = np.median(ck, axis=0)
2589                        data[f'A_cat{k}_lower'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.025, axis=0)
2590                        data[f'A_cat{k}_upper'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.975, axis=0)
2591
2592            # Per-category Hill parameters for simulation (Vmax, K, n for a- and b-components)
2593            for hill_param in ['Vmax_a', 'K_a', 'n_a', 'Vmax_b', 'K_b', 'n_b']:
2594                cat_arr = _extract_cat_param(hill_param)
2595                if cat_arr is not None:
2596                    n_cats = cat_arr.shape[2]
2597                    for k in range(n_cats):
2598                        ck = cat_arr[:, :, k]  # [S, T]
2599                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_median'] = np.median(ck, axis=0)
2600                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_lower'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.025, axis=0)
2601                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_upper'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.975, axis=0)
2602
2603        # Get full posterior samples (needed for FDR and per-sample CI computations)
2604        Vmax_a_full = extract_param_full('Vmax_a')
2605        K_a_full = extract_param_full('K_a')
2606        n_a_full = extract_param_full('n_a')
2607        Vmax_b_full = extract_param_full('Vmax_b')
2608        K_b_full = extract_param_full('K_b')
2609        n_b_full = extract_param_full('n_b')
2610
2611        # Compute product-based activity probabilities: P(alpha * Vmax_a / A > epsilon)
2612        # These avoid the alpha–Vmax non-identifiability by using the well-constrained product.
2613        _ACTIVITY_EPSILON = 0.01
2614        if (alpha_full.ndim >= 2 and Vmax_a_full.ndim >= 2 and A_full.ndim >= 2):
2615            _ratio_a = alpha_full * Vmax_a_full / np.maximum(A_full, 1e-12)
2616            p_active_a = (_ratio_a > _ACTIVITY_EPSILON).mean(axis=0)
2617        else:
2618            p_active_a = alpha_median.copy()  # fallback to median[alpha]
2619        if (beta_full.ndim >= 2 and Vmax_b_full.ndim >= 2 and A_full.ndim >= 2):
2620            _ratio_b = beta_full * Vmax_b_full / np.maximum(A_full, 1e-12)
2621            p_active_b = (_ratio_b > _ACTIVITY_EPSILON).mean(axis=0)
2622        else:
2623            p_active_b = beta_median.copy()  # fallback to median[beta]
2624        p_active_a = np.asarray(p_active_a, dtype=float).ravel()
2625        p_active_b = np.asarray(p_active_b, dtype=float).ravel()
2626
2627        # Convert p_active to Bayesian q-values (pooled over both components).
2628        # dep_mask uses q < fdr_threshold so the criterion is globally calibrated.
2629        _lfdr_all = np.concatenate([1.0 - p_active_a, 1.0 - p_active_b])
2630        _n_all = len(_lfdr_all)
2631        _ord = np.argsort(_lfdr_all)
2632        _cumfdr = np.cumsum(_lfdr_all[_ord]) / (np.arange(_n_all, dtype=float) + 1.0)
2633        _qsorted = np.minimum.accumulate(_cumfdr[::-1])[::-1]
2634        _qall = np.empty(_n_all, dtype=float); _qall[_ord] = _qsorted
2635        # Floor: tests with p_active ≈ 0 get q = 1 regardless of pool dilution.
2636        _p_active_all = np.concatenate([p_active_a, p_active_b])
2637        _qall = np.where(_p_active_all < 1e-9, 1.0, _qall)
2638        q_active_a = _qall[:n_features]
2639        q_active_b = _qall[n_features:]
2640
2641        # Compute inflection points for individual Hill components
2642        if compute_inflection:
2643            # Use raw n means (FDR controls activity, not CI-based n-zeroing)
2644            nA = np.asarray(n_a_used, dtype=float)
2645            nB = np.asarray(n_b_used, dtype=float)
2646
2647            # For CI, we should use |n| bounds. A conservative choice:
2648            #   nabs_lower = min(|n_lo|, |n_hi|)  (lower bound on magnitude)
2649            #   nabs_upper = max(|n_lo|, |n_hi|)
2650            nAabs_lo = np.minimum(np.abs(n_a_lower), np.abs(n_a_upper))
2651            nAabs_hi = np.maximum(np.abs(n_a_lower), np.abs(n_a_upper))
2652            nBabs_lo = np.minimum(np.abs(n_b_lower), np.abs(n_b_upper))
2653            nBabs_hi = np.maximum(np.abs(n_b_lower), np.abs(n_b_upper))
2654
2655            # FDR-inactive components: zero inflection magnitude bounds
2656            _fdr_inactive_a = q_active_a >= fdr_threshold
2657            _fdr_inactive_b = q_active_b >= fdr_threshold
2658            nAabs_lo[_fdr_inactive_a] = 0.0
2659            nAabs_hi[_fdr_inactive_a] = 0.0
2660            nBabs_lo[_fdr_inactive_b] = 0.0
2661            nBabs_hi[_fdr_inactive_b] = 0.0
2662        
2663            inflection_a_mean = self._compute_hill_inflection(nA,      K_a_median)
2664            inflection_a_lower = self._compute_hill_inflection(nAabs_lo, K_a_lower)  # magnitude-lower
2665            inflection_a_upper = self._compute_hill_inflection(nAabs_hi, K_a_upper)  # magnitude-upper
2666
2667            inflection_b_mean = self._compute_hill_inflection(nB,      K_b_median)
2668            inflection_b_lower = self._compute_hill_inflection(nBabs_lo, K_b_lower)
2669            inflection_b_upper = self._compute_hill_inflection(nBabs_hi, K_b_upper)
2670        
2671            data['inflection_a_median'] = inflection_a_mean
2672            data['inflection_a_lower'] = inflection_a_lower
2673            data['inflection_a_upper'] = inflection_a_upper
2674            data['inflection_b_median'] = inflection_b_mean
2675            data['inflection_b_lower'] = inflection_b_lower
2676            data['inflection_b_upper'] = inflection_b_upper
2677
2678        # Initialize arrays for per-feature results
2679        classifications = []
2680        first_deriv_roots_mean_list = []
2681        second_deriv_roots_mean_list = []
2682        third_deriv_roots_mean_list = []
2683        # For negbinom: roots of dg/du=0 in u-space (g = log2(y) - log2(y_ntc))
2684        # For binomial: roots of dp/du=0 in u-space (same as dy/dx=0 roots, converted to u)
2685        first_deriv_roots_log2fc_mean_list = []
2686        second_deriv_roots_log2fc_mean_list = []
2687        third_deriv_roots_log2fc_mean_list = []
2688        n_first_deriv_roots = []
2689        n_second_deriv_roots = []
2690        n_third_deriv_roots = []
2691        # For negbinom: log2(y_max / y_min)
2692        # For binomial: y_max - y_min (delta_p)
2693        full_log2fc_mean_list = []
2694        full_log2fc_lower_list = []
2695        full_log2fc_upper_list = []
2696        observed_log2fc_list = []
2697        observed_log2fc_lower_list = []
2698        observed_log2fc_upper_list = []
2699
2700        # Multinomial: skip per-feature derived columns (classification, log2fc, derivative roots).
2701        # These assume scalar alpha/beta and a scalar dose-response curve; they are not
2702        # meaningful when alpha and beta are per-category vectors.
2703        # All core parameters (A, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, alpha_cat{k}, etc.) and FDR columns
2704        # are already written to `data` above; derived columns will simply be absent.
2705        if is_multinomial:
2706            return
2707
2708        # Timing accumulators for the per-feature loop
2709        _n_sig = int(np.sum((q_active_a < fdr_threshold) | (q_active_b < fdr_threshold)))
2710        if verbose:
2711            _S_val = Vmax_a_full.shape[0] if Vmax_a_full.ndim > 1 else 1
2712            print(f"  [loop1] {n_features} features  "
2713                  f"{_n_sig} FDR-significant  "
2714                  f"{_S_val} posterior samples")
2715            _loop1_t = {'x_roots': 0.0, 'u_roots': 0.0, 'classify': 0.0,
2716                        'full_lfc_mean': 0.0, 'full_lfc_ci': 0.0,
2717                        'obs_lfc_mean': 0.0, 'obs_lfc_ci': 0.0}
2718            _loop1_start = time.time()
2719
2720        # Process each feature
2721        _iter = tqdm(range(n_features), desc="  [loop1]", disable=not verbose)
2722        for i in _iter:
2723            # Compute FDR activity flag once, used throughout this iteration
2724            _is_flat_i = (q_active_a[i] >= fdr_threshold) and (q_active_b[i] >= fdr_threshold)
2725
2726            # Get median parameters for this feature
2727            alpha_i = alpha_median[i]
2728            beta_i = beta_median[i]
2729            Vmax_a_i = Vmax_a_median[i]
2730            Vmax_b_i = Vmax_b_median[i]
2731            K_a_i = K_a_median[i]
2732            K_b_i = K_b_median[i]
2733            n_a_i = float(n_a_used[i])
2734            n_b_i = float(n_b_used[i])
2735            A_i = A_median[i]
2736
2737            # Observed-extrema arg-locations (used later for CI candidate points)
2738            x_minloc = np.nan
2739            x_maxloc = np.nan
2740
2741            if verbose: _ti = time.time()
2742
2743            # Find derivative roots for mean parameters (x-space)
2744            first_roots_mean = []
2745            second_roots_mean = []
2746            third_roots_mean = []
2747
2748            if compute_derivative_roots and x_range is not None and not _is_flat_i:
2749                # First derivative roots (where dy/dx = 0)
2750                def first_deriv_func(x):
2751                    return self._additive_hill_first_derivative(
2752                        x, alpha_i, Vmax_a_i, K_a_i, n_a_i,
2753                        beta_i, Vmax_b_i, K_b_i, n_b_i
2754                    )
2755                first_roots_mean = self._find_roots_empirical_loose(first_deriv_func, x_range)
2756
2757                # Second derivative roots (inflection points of combined function)
2758                def second_deriv_func(x):
2759                    return self._additive_hill_second_derivative(
2760                        x, alpha_i, Vmax_a_i, K_a_i, n_a_i,
2761                        beta_i, Vmax_b_i, K_b_i, n_b_i
2762                    )
2763                second_roots_mean = self._find_roots_empirical_loose(second_deriv_func, x_range)
2764
2765                # Third derivative roots (where d³y/dx³ = 0)
2766                def third_deriv_func(x):
2767                    return self._additive_hill_third_derivative(
2768                        x, alpha_i, Vmax_a_i, K_a_i, n_a_i,
2769                        beta_i, Vmax_b_i, K_b_i, n_b_i
2770                    )
2771                third_roots_mean = self._find_roots_empirical_loose(third_deriv_func, x_range)
2772
2773            if verbose: _loop1_t['x_roots'] += time.time() - _ti; _ti = time.time()
2774
2775            # --- roots in log2FC x-space (u-space) ---
2776            # Only computed when compute_log2fc_params AND compute_derivative_roots AND FDR-significant.
2777            # For negbinom: dg/du=0, d2g/du2=0, d3g/du3=0 where g = log2(y) - log2(y_ntc)
2778            # For binomial: dp/du=0, etc.
2779            u_roots_g1 = []
2780            u_roots_g2 = []
2781            u_roots_g3 = []
2782
2783            if (compute_log2fc_params and compute_derivative_roots and not _is_flat_i
2784                    and (x_ntc is not None) and np.isfinite(x_ntc) and (x_ntc > 0)
2785                    and (x_obs_min is not None) and (x_obs_max is not None)):
2786
2787                eps = 1e-10
2788                log2_xntc = np.log2(max(float(x_ntc), eps))
2789
2790                # Build u-range for root finding (used for both binomial and negbinom)
2791                u_range_local = self._build_u_range_from_observed_x(
2792                    x_obs_min=x_obs_min,
2793                    x_obs_max=x_obs_max,
2794                    x_ntc=x_ntc,
2795                    n_grid=6000,
2796                    pad_u=0.25
2797                )
2798
2799                # WIDEN using EC50s so we don't miss roots outside observed x-range
2800                u_ec50 = []
2801                if np.isfinite(K_a_i) and K_a_i > 0:
2802                    u_ec50.append(np.log2(max(float(K_a_i), eps)) - log2_xntc)
2803                if np.isfinite(K_b_i) and K_b_i > 0:
2804                    u_ec50.append(np.log2(max(float(K_b_i), eps)) - log2_xntc)
2805
2806                if len(u_ec50) > 0:
2807                    umin = min(float(np.nanmin(u_range_local)), float(np.min(u_ec50))) - 1.0
2808                    umax = max(float(np.nanmax(u_range_local)), float(np.max(u_ec50))) + 1.0
2809                    u_range_local = np.linspace(umin, umax, 6000)
2810
2811                if is_binomial:
2812                    # For binomial (delta_p = S - S_ntc):
2813                    # dp/du = S' * x * ln(2) → roots when S' = 0
2814                    # d²p/du² ∝ S' + x*S'' → roots when S' + x*S'' = 0
2815                    # d³p/du³ ∝ S' + 3x*S'' + x²*S''' → roots when S' + 3x*S'' + x²*S''' = 0
2816
2817                    def p1_num_u(u):
2818                        # dp/du = 0 when S' = 0
2819                        x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp = self._S_derivs_at_u(
2820                            u,
2821                            A=A_i, alpha=alpha_i, Vmax_a=Vmax_a_i, K_a=K_a_i, n_a=n_a_i,
2822                            beta=beta_i, Vmax_b=Vmax_b_i, K_b=K_b_i, n_b=n_b_i,
2823                            x_ntc=x_ntc
2824                        )
2825                        return Sp
2826
2827                    def p2_num_u(u):
2828                        # d²p/du² = 0 when S' + x*S'' = 0
2829                        x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp = self._S_derivs_at_u(
2830                            u,
2831                            A=A_i, alpha=alpha_i, Vmax_a=Vmax_a_i, K_a=K_a_i, n_a=n_a_i,
2832                            beta=beta_i, Vmax_b=Vmax_b_i, K_b=K_b_i, n_b=n_b_i,
2833                            x_ntc=x_ntc
2834                        )
2835                        return Sp + x * Spp
2836
2837                    def p3_num_u(u):
2838                        # d³p/du³ = 0 when S' + 3x*S'' + x²*S''' = 0
2839                        x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp = self._S_derivs_at_u(
2840                            u,
2841                            A=A_i, alpha=alpha_i, Vmax_a=Vmax_a_i, K_a=K_a_i, n_a=n_a_i,
2842                            beta=beta_i, Vmax_b=Vmax_b_i, K_b=K_b_i, n_b=n_b_i,
2843                            x_ntc=x_ntc
2844                        )
2845                        return Sp + 3.0 * x * Spp + (x ** 2) * Sppp
2846
2847                    u_roots_g1 = self._find_roots_on_grid(p1_num_u, u_range_local, include_tangent=True)
2848                    u_roots_g2 = self._find_roots_on_grid(p2_num_u, u_range_local, include_tangent=True)
2849                    u_roots_g3 = self._find_roots_on_grid(p3_num_u, u_range_local, include_tangent=True)
2850                else:
2851                    # For negbinom: find roots of dg/du = 0 directly (involves log2 transformation)
2852                    # g = log2(S) - log2(S_ntc)
2853                    # dg/du = x * S' / S → roots when S' = 0
2854                    # d²g/du² has numerator: S*(S' + x*S'') - x*S'^2
2855                    # d³g/du³ has numerator: S²*(S' + 3x*S'' + x²*S''') - 3S*x*S'*(S' + x*S'') + 2x²*S'^3
2856
2857                    def g1_num_u(u):
2858                        # root of g'(u) is root of Sp (since x>0 and ln2>0)
2859                        x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp = self._S_derivs_at_u(
2860                            u,
2861                            A=A_i, alpha=alpha_i, Vmax_a=Vmax_a_i, K_a=K_a_i, n_a=n_a_i,
2862                            beta=beta_i, Vmax_b=Vmax_b_i, K_b=K_b_i, n_b=n_b_i,
2863                            x_ntc=x_ntc
2864                        )
2865                        return Sp
2866
2867                    def g2_num_u(u):
2868                        # numerator of g''(u):  N2 = S*(Sp + x*Spp) - x*Sp^2
2869                        x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp = self._S_derivs_at_u(
2870                            u,
2871                            A=A_i, alpha=alpha_i, Vmax_a=Vmax_a_i, K_a=K_a_i, n_a=n_a_i,
2872                            beta=beta_i, Vmax_b=Vmax_b_i, K_b=K_b_i, n_b=n_b_i,
2873                            x_ntc=x_ntc
2874                        )
2875                        return S * (Sp + x * Spp) - x * (Sp ** 2)
2876
2877                    def g3_num_u(u):
2878                        # numerator of g'''(u):
2879                        # N3 = S^2*(Sp + 3x*Spp + x^2*Sppp) - 3S*(x*Sp*(Sp + x*Spp)) + 2*x^2*Sp^3
2880                        x, S, Sp, Spp, Sppp = self._S_derivs_at_u(
2881                            u,
2882                            A=A_i, alpha=alpha_i, Vmax_a=Vmax_a_i, K_a=K_a_i, n_a=n_a_i,
2883                            beta=beta_i, Vmax_b=Vmax_b_i, K_b=K_b_i, n_b=n_b_i,
2884                            x_ntc=x_ntc
2885                        )
2886                        t1 = (Sp + 3.0 * x * Spp + (x ** 2) * Sppp)
2887                        t2 = (x * Sp * (Sp + x * Spp))
2888                        t3 = ((x ** 2) * (Sp ** 3))
2889                        return (S ** 2) * t1 - 3.0 * S * t2 + 2.0 * t3
2890
2891                    u_roots_g1 = self._find_roots_on_grid(g1_num_u, u_range_local, include_tangent=True)
2892                    u_roots_g2 = self._find_roots_on_grid(g2_num_u, u_range_local, include_tangent=True)
2893                    u_roots_g3 = self._find_roots_on_grid(g3_num_u, u_range_local, include_tangent=True)
2894
2895            else:
2896                u_roots_g1 = []
2897                u_roots_g2 = []
2898                u_roots_g3 = []
2899            
2900            # store alongside x-roots (recommended)
2901            # These are genuinely dg/du roots in u-units:
2902            # (use NaN when empty to match your other columns)
2903            u1_str = ";".join([f"{v:.4f}" for v in u_roots_g1]) if u_roots_g1 else np.nan
2904            u2_str = ";".join([f"{v:.4f}" for v in u_roots_g2]) if u_roots_g2 else np.nan
2905            u3_str = ";".join([f"{v:.4f}" for v in u_roots_g3]) if u_roots_g3 else np.nan
2906            
2907            # append per-feature strings (make lists outside the loop like you do for x-roots)
2908            first_deriv_roots_log2fc_mean_list.append(u1_str)
2909            second_deriv_roots_log2fc_mean_list.append(u2_str)
2910            third_deriv_roots_log2fc_mean_list.append(u3_str)
2911
2912            first_deriv_roots_mean_list.append(first_roots_mean)
2913            second_deriv_roots_mean_list.append(second_roots_mean)
2914            third_deriv_roots_mean_list.append(third_roots_mean)
2915            n_first_deriv_roots.append(len(first_roots_mean))
2916            n_second_deriv_roots.append(len(second_roots_mean))
2917            n_third_deriv_roots.append(len(third_roots_mean))
2918
2919            if verbose: _loop1_t['u_roots'] += time.time() - _ti; _ti = time.time()
2920
2921            # Classify function
2922            classification = self._classify_additive_hill(
2923                alpha_i, alpha_lower[i], alpha_upper[i],
2924                beta_i, beta_lower[i], beta_upper[i],
2925                n_a_i, n_a_lower[i], n_a_upper[i],
2926                n_b_i, n_b_lower[i], n_b_upper[i],
2927                first_roots_mean, second_roots_mean,
2928                x_range if x_range is not None else np.array([1.0]),
2929                Vmax_a_i, K_a_i, Vmax_b_i, K_b_i,
2930                x_ntc=x_ntc,
2931                p_active_a=float(q_active_a[i]),
2932                p_active_b=float(q_active_b[i]),
2933                fdr_threshold=fdr_threshold
2934            )
2935
2936            classifications.append(classification)
2937
2938            if verbose: _loop1_t['classify'] += time.time() - _ti; _ti = time.time()
2939
2940            # Compute full and observed dynamic ranges — only when compute_log2fc_params=True.
2941            # For negbinom: log2(y_max / y_min); for binomial: y_max - y_min (delta_p).
2942            if compute_log2fc_params:
2943                if _is_flat_i:
2944                    full_log2fc_i = 0.0
2945                elif is_binomial:
2946                    full_log2fc_i = self._full_delta_p_from_extrema_and_boundaries(
2947                        A_i, alpha_i, Vmax_a_i, K_a_i, n_a_i,
2948                        beta_i, Vmax_b_i, K_b_i, n_b_i,
2949                        x_range if x_range is not None else np.linspace(1e-3, 1e3, 6000)
2950                    )
2951                else:
2952                    full_log2fc_i = self._full_log2fc_from_extrema_and_boundaries(
2953                        A_i, alpha_i, Vmax_a_i, K_a_i, n_a_i,
2954                        beta_i, Vmax_b_i, K_b_i, n_b_i,
2955                        x_range if x_range is not None else np.linspace(1e-3, 1e3, 6000)
2956                    )
2957                full_log2fc_mean_list.append(full_log2fc_i)
2958
2959                if verbose: _loop1_t['full_lfc_mean'] += time.time() - _ti; _ti = time.time()
2960
2961                # Observed dynamic range over observed x range
2962                if x_obs_min is not None and x_obs_max is not None:
2963                    if is_binomial:
2964                        obs_log2fc_i, (x_minloc, x_maxloc) = self._compute_observed_delta_p_fitted(
2965                            A_i, alpha_i, Vmax_a_i, beta_i, Vmax_b_i,
2966                            K_a_i, n_a_i, K_b_i, n_b_i,
2967                            x_obs_min, x_obs_max,
2968                            return_argextrema=True
2969                        )
2970                    else:
2971                        obs_log2fc_i, (x_minloc, x_maxloc) = self._compute_observed_log2fc_fitted(
2972                            A_i, alpha_i, Vmax_a_i, beta_i, Vmax_b_i,
2973                            K_a_i, n_a_i, K_b_i, n_b_i,
2974                            x_obs_min, x_obs_max,
2975                            return_argextrema=True
2976                        )
2977                    observed_log2fc_list.append(obs_log2fc_i)
2978                else:
2979                    observed_log2fc_list.append(np.nan)
2980
2981                if verbose: _loop1_t['obs_lfc_mean'] += time.time() - _ti; _ti = time.time()
2982
2983                # CI for observed dynamic range from all posterior samples
2984                if (x_obs_min is not None) and (x_obs_max is not None) and (Vmax_a_full.ndim > 1) and compute_lfc_ci:
2985                    S = Vmax_a_full.shape[0]
2986
2987                    x0 = float(max(x_obs_min, 1e-10))
2988                    x1 = float(max(x_obs_max, 1e-10))
2989                    x_candidates_obs = [r for r in first_roots_mean if (x0 <= r <= x1)]
2990                    for xx in (x_minloc, x_maxloc):
2991                        if np.isfinite(xx) and (x0 <= xx <= x1):
2992                            x_candidates_obs.append(float(xx))
2993                    x_candidates_obs = self._dedup_roots_log2(x_candidates_obs, tol_log2=1e-3)
2994
2995                    if _is_flat_i:
2996                        observed_log2fc_lower_list.append(0.0)
2997                        observed_log2fc_upper_list.append(0.0)
2998                    else:
2999                        vals = []
3000                        for s in range(S):
3001                            sa = s % alpha_full.shape[0] if alpha_full.ndim > 1 else None
3002                            sb = s % beta_full.shape[0]  if beta_full.ndim > 1 else None
3003                            sA = s % A_full.shape[0]     if A_full.ndim > 1 else None
3004                            alpha_s = float(alpha_full[sa, i]) if alpha_full.ndim > 1 else float(alpha_full[i])
3005                            beta_s  = float(beta_full[sb, i])  if beta_full.ndim > 1 else float(beta_full[i])
3006                            A_s     = float(A_full[sA, i])     if A_full.ndim > 1 else float(A_full[i])
3007                            Vmax_a_s = float(Vmax_a_full[s, i])
3008                            Vmax_b_s = float(Vmax_b_full[s, i])
3009                            K_a_s    = float(K_a_full[s, i])
3010                            K_b_s    = float(K_b_full[s, i])
3011                            n_a_s = float(n_a_full[s, i])
3012                            n_b_s = float(n_b_full[s, i])
3013                            if q_active_a[i] >= fdr_threshold:
3014                                alpha_s = 0.0
3015                            if q_active_b[i] >= fdr_threshold:
3016                                beta_s = 0.0
3017
3018                            if is_binomial:
3019                                v = self._observed_delta_p_candidates_no_roots(
3020                                    A_s, alpha_s, Vmax_a_s, K_a_s, n_a_s,
3021                                    beta_s, Vmax_b_s, K_b_s, n_b_s,
3022                                    x_obs_min=x0, x_obs_max=x1,
3023                                    x_candidates=x_candidates_obs
3024                                )
3025                            else:
3026                                v = self._observed_log2fc_candidates_no_roots(
3027                                    A_s, alpha_s, Vmax_a_s, K_a_s, n_a_s,
3028                                    beta_s, Vmax_b_s, K_b_s, n_b_s,
3029                                    x_obs_min=x0, x_obs_max=x1,
3030                                    x_candidates=x_candidates_obs
3031                                )
3032                            if np.isfinite(v):
3033                                vals.append(v)
3034
3035                        if vals:
3036                            observed_log2fc_lower_list.append(np.quantile(vals, 0.025))
3037                            observed_log2fc_upper_list.append(np.quantile(vals, 0.975))
3038                        else:
3039                            observed_log2fc_lower_list.append(np.nan)
3040                            observed_log2fc_upper_list.append(np.nan)
3041                else:
3042                    # no posterior samples or no x-range -> fall back to mean
3043                    observed_log2fc_lower_list.append(obs_log2fc_i if 'obs_log2fc_i' in dir() else np.nan)
3044                    observed_log2fc_upper_list.append(obs_log2fc_i if 'obs_log2fc_i' in dir() else np.nan)
3045
3046                if verbose: _loop1_t['obs_lfc_ci'] += time.time() - _ti; _ti = time.time()
3047
3048                # CI for full dynamic range from all posterior samples
3049                if Vmax_a_full.ndim > 1 and compute_lfc_ci:
3050                    S = Vmax_a_full.shape[0]
3051                    x_candidates = first_roots_mean
