3427                def _log2fc_transform(arr):
3428                    out = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3429                    ok = np.isfinite(arr) & (arr > epsilon)
3430                    out[ok] = np.log2(arr[ok]) - log2_x_ntc
3431                    return out
3432
3433                data['inflection_a_log2fc_median'] = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_a_median', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3434                data['inflection_a_log2fc_lower']  = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_a_lower', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3435                data['inflection_a_log2fc_upper']  = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_a_upper', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3436
3437                data['inflection_b_log2fc_median'] = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_b_median', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3438                data['inflection_b_log2fc_lower']  = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_b_lower', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3439                data['inflection_b_log2fc_upper']  = _log2fc_transform(data.get('inflection_b_upper', np.full(n_features, np.nan)))
3440                            
3441            # A (baseline) in transformed y-space
3442            # For negbinom: A_log2fc = log2(A) - log2(y_ntc)
3443            # For binomial: A_delta_p = A - y_ntc
3444            if is_binomial:
3445                A_delta_p = A_median - y_ntc
3446                data['A_delta_p'] = A_delta_p
3447            else:
3448                A_log2fc = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3449                valid_A = (A_median > epsilon) & (y_ntc > epsilon)
3450                if np.any(valid_A):
3451                    A_log2fc[valid_A] = np.log2(A_median[valid_A]) - np.log2(y_ntc[valid_A])
3452                data['A_log2fc'] = A_log2fc
3453
3454        return data
3455
3456    def _add_single_hill_params(
3457        self, data, posterior, n_features,
3458        compute_inflection: bool = True,
3459        compute_derivative_roots: bool = True,
3460        x_range: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
3461        x_obs_min: Optional[float] = None,
3462        x_obs_max: Optional[float] = None,
3463        compute_log2fc_params: bool = False,
3464        compute_lfc_ci: bool = True,
3465        x_ntc=None,
3466        y_ntc=None,
3467        fdr_threshold: float = 0.05,
3468        verbose: bool = False,
3469    ):
3470        """
3471        Add single Hill parameters to data dict.
3472
3473        Single Hill model: y = A + alpha * Vmax * x^n / (K^n + x^n)
3474
3475        Parameters stored (with _mean, _lower, _upper suffixes):
3476        - Vmax_a: Hill amplitude (maximum effect)
3477        - K_a: Half-max concentration (EC50/IC50)
3478        - n_a: Hill coefficient (cooperativity, sign determines direction)
3479        - alpha: Weight/scale factor
3480        - A: Baseline offset
3481
3482        Also computes:
3483        - inflection_a: Inflection point (exists when |n| > 1)
3484        - full_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over theoretical range
3485        - observed_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over observed x range
3486        - Derivative roots (first, second, third) where dy/dx=0, d²y/dx²=0, d³y/dx³=0
3487        - Log2FC transforms if x_ntc and y_ntc are provided
3488        """
3489        # --- shared extraction helpers ---
3490        def extract_param(name):
3491            param = posterior[name]
3492            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
3493                param = param.cpu().numpy()
3494            # squeeze [S,1,T] -> [S,T]
3495            if param.ndim == 3 and param.shape[1] == 1:
3496                param = param.squeeze(1)
3497            # average over extra dims if needed (e.g. multinomial categories)
3498            if param.ndim > 2:
3499                param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
3500
3501            if param.ndim == 2:  # [S, T]
3502                mean = np.median(param, axis=0)
3503                lo = np.quantile(param, 0.025, axis=0)
3504                hi = np.quantile(param, 0.975, axis=0)
3505            else:                # [T] point
3506                mean = lo = hi = param
3507            return mean, lo, hi
3508
3509        def extract_param_full(name):
3510            param = posterior[name]
3511            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
3512                param = param.cpu().numpy()
3513            if param.ndim == 3 and param.shape[1] == 1:
3514                param = param.squeeze(1)
3515            if param.ndim > 2:
3516                param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
3517            return param  # [S,T] or [T]
3518
3519        def extract_param_abs(name):
3520            param = posterior[name]
3521            if isinstance(param, torch.Tensor):
3522                param = param.cpu().numpy()
3523            if param.ndim == 3 and param.shape[1] == 1:
3524                param = param.squeeze(1)
3525            if param.ndim > 2:
3526                param = param.mean(axis=tuple(range(2, param.ndim)))
3527
3528            param_abs = np.abs(param)
3529            if param_abs.ndim == 2:
3530                mean = np.median(param_abs, axis=0)
3531                lo = np.quantile(param_abs, 0.025, axis=0)
3532                hi = np.quantile(param_abs, 0.975, axis=0)
3533            else:
3534                mean = lo = hi = param_abs
3535            return mean, lo, hi
3536
3537        def _broadcast(arr):
3538            arr = np.atleast_1d(arr)
3539            if arr.size == 1:
3540                return np.full(n_features, arr.item())
3541            return arr
3542    
3543        # --- core params ---
3544        Vmax_mean, Vmax_lo, Vmax_hi = extract_param('Vmax_a')
3545        K_mean,    K_lo,    K_hi    = extract_param('K_a')
3546        n_mean,    n_lo,    n_hi    = extract_param('n_a')
3547
3548        # Use raw n means; FDR thresholding controls activity.
3549        n_used = n_mean
3550    
3551        Vmax_full = extract_param_full('Vmax_a')
3552        K_full    = extract_param_full('K_a')
3553        n_full    = extract_param_full('n_a')
3554    
3555        if 'alpha' in posterior:
3556            alpha_mean, alpha_lo, alpha_hi = extract_param('alpha')
3557            alpha_full = extract_param_full('alpha')
3558            alpha_mean = _broadcast(alpha_mean); alpha_lo = _broadcast(alpha_lo); alpha_hi = _broadcast(alpha_hi)
3559            if alpha_full.ndim == 1:
3560                alpha_full = alpha_full.reshape(-1, 1)
3561            if alpha_full.shape[-1] == 1:
3562                alpha_full = np.broadcast_to(alpha_full, (alpha_full.shape[0], n_features)).copy()
3563        else:
3564            alpha_mean = np.ones(n_features); alpha_lo = np.ones(n_features); alpha_hi = np.ones(n_features)
3565            alpha_full = np.ones((1, n_features))
3566    
3567        if 'A' in posterior:
3568            A_mean, A_lo, A_hi = extract_param('A')
3569            A_full = extract_param_full('A')
3570            A_mean = _broadcast(A_mean); A_lo = _broadcast(A_lo); A_hi = _broadcast(A_hi)
3571            if A_full.ndim == 1:
3572                A_full = A_full.reshape(-1, 1)
3573            if A_full.shape[-1] == 1:
3574                A_full = np.broadcast_to(A_full, (A_full.shape[0], n_features)).copy()
3575        else:
3576            A_mean = np.zeros(n_features); A_lo = np.zeros(n_features); A_hi = np.zeros(n_features)
3577            A_full = np.zeros((1, n_features))
3578
3579        
3580        data['Vmax_a_median'] = Vmax_mean
3581        data['Vmax_a_lower'] = Vmax_lo
3582        data['Vmax_a_upper'] = Vmax_hi
3583        data['K_a_median'] = K_mean
3584        data['K_a_lower'] = K_lo
3585        data['K_a_upper'] = K_hi
3586        data['n_a_median'] = n_mean
3587        data['n_a_lower'] = n_lo
3588        data['n_a_upper'] = n_hi
3589        data['alpha_median'] = alpha_mean
3590        data['alpha_lower'] = alpha_lo
3591        data['alpha_upper'] = alpha_hi
3592        data['A_median'] = A_mean
3593        data['A_lower'] = A_lo
3594        data['A_upper'] = A_hi
3595
3596        # Multinomial: export per-category A, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, alpha for simulation.
3597        # These parallel the per-category alpha/beta columns already in _add_additive_hill_params.
3598        if distribution == 'multinomial':
3599            def _extract_single_cat_param(name):
3600                """Return raw numpy [S, T, K-1] (or [S, T, K] for A) for a per-category parameter."""
3601                if name not in posterior:
3602                    return None
3603                p = posterior[name]
3604                if isinstance(p, torch.Tensor):
3605                    p = p.cpu().numpy()
3606                if p.ndim == 4 and p.shape[1] == 1:
3607                    p = p.squeeze(1)
3608                if p.ndim == 3 and p.shape[1] == n_features:
3609                    return p
3610                return None
3611
3612            # A: shape [S, T, K] — export K-1 fitted categories and residual
3613            A_raw_sh = _extract_single_cat_param('A')
3614            if A_raw_sh is not None:
3615                K_dim = A_raw_sh.shape[2]
3616                AK = A_raw_sh[:, :, -1]
3617                data['A_K_median'] = np.median(AK, axis=0)
3618                data['A_K_lower'] = np.quantile(AK, 0.025, axis=0)
3619                data['A_K_upper'] = np.quantile(AK, 0.975, axis=0)
3620                for k in range(K_dim - 1):
3621                    ck = A_raw_sh[:, :, k]
3622                    data[f'A_cat{k}_median'] = np.median(ck, axis=0)
3623                    data[f'A_cat{k}_lower'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.025, axis=0)
3624                    data[f'A_cat{k}_upper'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.975, axis=0)
3625
3626            # Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, alpha: shape [S, T, K-1]
3627            for hill_param in ['Vmax_a', 'K_a', 'n_a', 'alpha']:
3628                cat_arr = _extract_single_cat_param(hill_param)
3629                if cat_arr is not None:
3630                    n_cats = cat_arr.shape[2]
3631                    for k in range(n_cats):
3632                        ck = cat_arr[:, :, k]
3633                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_median'] = np.median(ck, axis=0)
3634                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_lower'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.025, axis=0)
3635                        data[f'{hill_param}_cat{k}_upper'] = np.quantile(ck, 0.975, axis=0)
3636
3637        # Compute product-based FDR for single_hill: P(alpha * Vmax / A > epsilon)
3638        _ACTIVITY_EPSILON = 0.01
3639        if alpha_full.ndim >= 2 and Vmax_full.ndim >= 2 and A_full.ndim >= 2:
3640            _ratio = alpha_full * Vmax_full / np.maximum(A_full, 1e-12)
3641            p_active = (_ratio > _ACTIVITY_EPSILON).mean(axis=0)
3642        else:
3643            p_active = alpha_mean.copy()
3644        p_active = np.asarray(p_active, dtype=float).ravel()
3645        _lfdr = 1.0 - p_active
3646        _ord = np.argsort(_lfdr)
3647        _cumfdr = np.cumsum(_lfdr[_ord]) / (np.arange(n_features, dtype=float) + 1.0)
3648        _qsorted = np.minimum.accumulate(_cumfdr[::-1])[::-1]
3649        q_active = np.empty(n_features, dtype=float); q_active[_ord] = _qsorted
3650        q_active = np.where(p_active < 1e-9, 1.0, q_active)
3651
3652        # --- inflection of the Hill component ---
3653        if compute_inflection:
3654            n_abs_mean, n_abs_lo, n_abs_hi = extract_param_abs('n_a')
3655            
3656            infl_mean = self._compute_hill_inflection(n_abs_mean, K_mean)
3657            infl_lo   = self._compute_hill_inflection(n_abs_lo,   K_lo)
3658            infl_hi   = self._compute_hill_inflection(n_abs_hi,   K_hi)
3659            
3660            # (optional) store |n| summaries too
3661            data['n_a_abs_median'] = n_abs_mean
3662            data['n_a_abs_lower'] = n_abs_lo
3663            data['n_a_abs_upper'] = n_abs_hi
3664            data['inflection_a_median'] = infl_mean
3665            data['inflection_a_lower'] = infl_lo
3666            data['inflection_a_upper'] = infl_hi
3667    
3668        # --- full log2FC range for y = A + alpha*Hill ---
3669        if compute_log2fc_params:
3670            _S_val = Vmax_full.shape[0] if Vmax_full.ndim == 2 else 1
3671            if verbose:
3672                _n_sig = int(np.sum(q_active < fdr_threshold))
3673                print(f"  [single_hill] {n_features} features  {_n_sig} FDR-sig  {_S_val} samples")
3674            _t_sh = time.time()
3675            eps = 1e-10
3676
3677            # mean version using n_used, with correct n==0 limits (Hill == 0.5*V everywhere)
3678            n_u = np.asarray(n_used, dtype=float)
3679
3680            hill0 = np.where(
3681                np.abs(n_u) < 1e-15,
3682                0.5 * Vmax_mean,
3683                np.where(n_u < 0, Vmax_mean, 0.0)
3684            )
3685            hillinf = np.where(
3686                np.abs(n_u) < 1e-15,
3687                0.5 * Vmax_mean,
3688                np.where(n_u < 0, 0.0, Vmax_mean)
3689            )
3690
3691            y0 = np.maximum(A_mean + alpha_mean * hill0, eps)
3692            yinf = np.maximum(A_mean + alpha_mean * hillinf, eps)
3693
3694            fdr_inactive = q_active >= fdr_threshold
3695            log2fc_vals = np.log2(np.maximum(y0, yinf) / np.minimum(y0, yinf))
3696            data['full_log2fc_median'] = np.where(fdr_inactive, 0.0, log2fc_vals)
3697
3698            # CI from posterior samples (coherent; use all available samples)
3699            if Vmax_full.ndim == 2 and compute_lfc_ci:
3700                S = Vmax_full.shape[0]
3701                lo = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3702                hi = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3703
3704                for i in range(n_features):
3705                    vals = []
3706                    for s in range(S):
3707                        V_s = float(Vmax_full[s, i])
3708                        K_s = float(K_full[s, i])
3709                        a_s = float(alpha_full[s, i]) if alpha_full.ndim == 2 else float(alpha_full[i])
3710                        A_s = float(A_full[s, i]) if A_full.ndim == 2 else float(A_full[i])
3711                        n_s = float(n_full[s, i])
3712                        # Gate inactive component via FDR (zero alpha, not n)
3713                        if q_active[i] >= fdr_threshold:
3714                            a_s = 0.0
3715        
3716                        # boundaries for single hill
3717                        if abs(n_s) < 1e-15:
3718                            # constant hill = 0.5*V everywhere -> no boundary range
3719                            y0_s = max(A_s + a_s * 0.5 * V_s, eps)
3720                            yinf_s = y0_s
3721                        else:
3722                            h0 = V_s if n_s < 0 else 0.0
3723                            hinf = 0.0 if n_s < 0 else V_s
3724                            y0_s = max(A_s + a_s * h0, eps)
3725                            yinf_s = max(A_s + a_s * hinf, eps)
3726        
3727                        vals.append(np.log2(max(y0_s, yinf_s) / min(y0_s, yinf_s)))
3728        
3729                    if vals:
3730                        lo[i] = np.quantile(vals, 0.025)
3731                        hi[i] = np.quantile(vals, 0.975)
3732        
3733                data['full_log2fc_lower'] = lo
3734                data['full_log2fc_upper'] = hi
3735            else:
3736                data['full_log2fc_lower'] = data['full_log2fc_median']
3737                data['full_log2fc_upper'] = data['full_log2fc_median']
3738
3739            if verbose:
3740                print(f"    full_log2fc (median + CI):  {time.time() - _t_sh:.1f}s")
3741                _t_sh = time.time()
3742
3743        # --- observed log2FC over observed x-range (gated by compute_log2fc_params) ---
3744        if compute_log2fc_params:
3745            if (x_obs_min is not None) and (x_obs_max is not None) and np.isfinite(x_obs_min) and np.isfinite(x_obs_max):
3746                obs = []
3747                for i in range(n_features):
3748                    obs.append(
3749                        self._compute_observed_log2fc_fitted(
3750                            A_mean[i], alpha_mean[i], Vmax_mean[i], 0.0, 0.0,
3751                            K_mean[i], n_used[i], 1.0, 1.0,
3752                            float(x_obs_min), float(x_obs_max)
3753                        )
3754                    )
3755                data['observed_log2fc'] = obs
3756
3757            if (x_obs_min is not None) and (x_obs_max is not None) and (Vmax_full.ndim == 2) and compute_lfc_ci:
3758                eps = 1e-10
3759                x0 = float(max(x_obs_min, eps))
3760                x1 = float(max(x_obs_max, eps))
3761
3762                lo = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3763                hi = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3764
3765                S = Vmax_full.shape[0]
3766
3767                for i in range(n_features):
3768                    if q_active[i] >= fdr_threshold:
3769                        lo[i] = 0.0
3770                        hi[i] = 0.0
3771                        continue
3772
3773                    vals = []
3774                    for s in range(S):
3775                        V_s = float(Vmax_full[s, i])
3776                        K_s = float(K_full[s, i])
3777                        a_s = float(alpha_full[s, i])
3778                        A_s = float(A_full[s, i])
3779                        n_s = float(n_full[s, i])
3780
3781                        def y_at(x):
3782                            H = self._hill_value(x, V_s, K_s, n_s)
3783                            return A_s + a_s * H
3784
3785                        y0 = max(y_at(x0), eps)
3786                        y1 = max(y_at(x1), eps)
3787                        vals.append(np.log2(max(y0, y1) / min(y0, y1)))
3788
3789                    lo[i] = np.quantile(vals, 0.025)
3790                    hi[i] = np.quantile(vals, 0.975)
3791
3792                data['observed_log2fc_lower'] = lo
3793                data['observed_log2fc_upper'] = hi
3794            else:
3795                data['observed_log2fc_lower'] = data.get('observed_log2fc', np.full(n_features, np.nan))
3796                data['observed_log2fc_upper'] = data.get('observed_log2fc', np.full(n_features, np.nan))
3797
3798            if verbose:
3799                print(f"    observed_log2fc (mean + CI): {time.time() - _t_sh:.1f}s")
3800
3801        # --- derivative roots over x_range ---
3802        if compute_derivative_roots and (x_range is not None):
3803            first_roots = []
3804            second_roots = []
3805            third_roots = []
3806            n_first = []
3807            n_second = []
3808            n_third = []
3809    
3810            for i in range(n_features):
3811                if q_active[i] >= fdr_threshold:
3812                    # FDR-inactive: skip expensive root-finding, emit empty roots
3813                    first_roots.append([]); second_roots.append([]); third_roots.append([])
3814                    n_first.append(0); n_second.append(0); n_third.append(0)
3815                    continue
3816                r1, r2, r3 = self._single_hill_derivative_roots(
3817                    alpha=float(alpha_mean[i]),
3818                    Vmax=float(Vmax_mean[i]),
3819                    K=float(K_mean[i]),
3820                    n=float(n_used[i]),
3821                    x_range=x_range,
3822                    compute_third=True
3823                )
3824                first_roots.append(r1); second_roots.append(r2); third_roots.append(r3)
3825                n_first.append(len(r1)); n_second.append(len(r2)); n_third.append(len(r3))
3826    
3827            data['n_first_deriv_roots'] = n_first
3828            data['n_second_deriv_roots'] = n_second
3829            data['n_third_deriv_roots'] = n_third
3830            data['first_deriv_roots_median'] = [';'.join([f'{r:.4f}' for r in rr]) if rr else np.nan for rr in first_roots]
3831            data['second_deriv_roots_median'] = [';'.join([f'{r:.4f}' for r in rr]) if rr else np.nan for rr in second_roots]
3832            data['third_deriv_roots_median']  = [';'.join([f'{r:.4f}' for r in rr]) if rr else np.nan for rr in third_roots]
3833
3834        # --- log2FC transforms ---
3835        if compute_log2fc_params and (x_ntc is not None) and (y_ntc is not None):
3836            eps = 1e-10
3837            log2_x_ntc = np.log2(max(float(x_ntc), eps))
3838            data['K_a_log2fc'] = np.log2(np.maximum(K_mean, eps)) - log2_x_ntc
3839    
3840            if compute_inflection:
3841                eps = 1e-10
3842                infl_mean = data.get('inflection_a_median', np.full(n_features, np.nan))
3843                infl_lo   = data.get('inflection_a_lower', np.full(n_features, np.nan))
3844                infl_hi   = data.get('inflection_a_upper', np.full(n_features, np.nan))
3845
3846                def _log2fc(arr):
3847                    out = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3848                    ok = np.isfinite(arr) & (arr > eps)
3849                    out[ok] = np.log2(arr[ok]) - log2_x_ntc
3850                    return out
3851
3852                data['inflection_a_log2fc_median'] = _log2fc(infl_mean)
3853                data['inflection_a_log2fc_lower']  = _log2fc(infl_lo)
3854                data['inflection_a_log2fc_upper']  = _log2fc(infl_hi)
3855
3856    
3857            y_ntc_arr = np.asarray(y_ntc, dtype=float)
3858            outA = np.full(n_features, np.nan)
3859            okA = (A_mean > eps) & (y_ntc_arr > eps)
3860            outA[okA] = np.log2(A_mean[okA]) - np.log2(y_ntc_arr[okA])
3861            data['A_log2fc'] = outA
3862
3863    
3864            # Also roots in log2FC x-space, if present:
3865            if compute_derivative_roots and (x_range is not None) and ('first_deriv_roots_median' in data):
3866                first_log = []
3867                second_log = []
3868                third_log = []
3869                for i in range(n_features):
3870                    # Parse from stored strings to avoid recomputing
3871                    def _parse(s):
3872                        """Parse root string, handling np.nan and empty strings."""
3873                        if s is None or (isinstance(s, float) and np.isnan(s)):
3874                            return []
3875                        if isinstance(s, str) and s.strip() == '':
3876                            return []
3877                        return [float(x) for x in str(s).split(';') if x != '']
3878
3879                    r1 = _parse(data['first_deriv_roots_median'][i])
3880                    r2 = _parse(data['second_deriv_roots_median'][i])
3881                    r3 = _parse(data['third_deriv_roots_median'][i])
3882
3883                    # Use np.nan for empty roots (consistent with additive_hill)
3884                    first_log.append(';'.join([f'{(np.log2(max(r, eps)) - log2_x_ntc):.4f}' for r in r1]) if r1 else np.nan)
3885                    second_log.append(';'.join([f'{(np.log2(max(r, eps)) - log2_x_ntc):.4f}' for r in r2]) if r2 else np.nan)
3886                    third_log.append(';'.join([f'{(np.log2(max(r, eps)) - log2_x_ntc):.4f}' for r in r3]) if r3 else np.nan)
3887                data['first_deriv_roots_log2fc_median'] = first_log
3888                data['second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median'] = second_log
3889                data['third_deriv_roots_log2fc_median'] = third_log
3890    
3891        return data
3892
3893    def _add_polynomial_params(
3894        self,
3895        data,
3896        posterior,
3897        n_features,
3898        compute_derivative_roots: bool = True,
3899        compute_log2fc_params: bool = False,
3900        x_range: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
3901        x_obs_min: Optional[float] = None,
3902        x_obs_max: Optional[float] = None,
3903        verbose: bool = False,
3904    ):
3905        """
3906        Add polynomial parameters to data dict.
3907
3908        IMPORTANT: The polynomial operates in different spaces depending on distribution:
3909        - negbinom: log2(y) = log2(A) + alpha * poly(log2(x))  [log2 space for x]
3910        - normal/studentt: y = A + alpha * poly(x)  [linear space]
3911        - binomial: logit(p) = logit(A) + alpha * poly(x)  [linear x, logit y]
3912
3913        For negbinom, the polynomial coefficients multiply powers of log2(x), so:
3914        - x_range should be in LINEAR x-space (this method converts internally)
3915        - Derivative roots are found in log2(x) space, then converted back
3916        - full_log2fc represents the range of log2(y) values
3917
3918        For normal/studentt/binomial, coefficients multiply powers of linear x.
3919
3920        Parameters stored (with _mean, _lower, _upper suffixes):
3921        - coef_{i}: Coefficient for the i-th power term
3922        - For negbinom: coef_i multiplies log2(x)^i
3923        - For others: coef_i multiplies x^i
3924
3925        Also computes:
3926        - full_log2fc: Dynamic range in appropriate space
3927        - observed_log2fc: Same as full_log2fc for polynomial
3928        - Derivative roots in the native polynomial space
3929        - Log2FC transforms of roots if x_ntc is available
3930        """
3931        coefs = posterior['poly_coefs']  # [S, T, d+1] or [T, d+1]
3932        if isinstance(coefs, torch.Tensor):
3933            coefs = coefs.cpu().numpy()
3934    
3935        degree = coefs.shape[-1] - 1
3936    
3937        if coefs.ndim == 3:
3938            # summary per coefficient
3939            for i in range(degree + 1):
3940                data[f'coef_{i}_median'] = np.median(coefs[:, :, i], axis=0)
3941                data[f'coef_{i}_lower']  = np.quantile(coefs[:, :, i], 0.025, axis=0)
3942                data[f'coef_{i}_upper']  = np.quantile(coefs[:, :, i], 0.975, axis=0)
3943            coefs_mean = np.median(coefs, axis=0)  # [T, d+1] — used for function evaluation
3944        else:
3945            for i in range(degree + 1):
3946                data[f'coef_{i}_median'] = coefs[:, i]
3947                data[f'coef_{i}_lower']  = coefs[:, i]
3948                data[f'coef_{i}_upper']  = coefs[:, i]
3949            coefs_mean = coefs  # [T, d+1]
3950    
3951        # Determine if polynomial is in log2 space (negbinom) or linear space (others)
3952        distribution = data.get('distribution', 'negbinom')
3953        is_log2_space = (distribution == 'negbinom')
3954
3955        # full_log2fc and observed_log2fc: evaluate over observed x-range
3956        # For negbinom: poly(log2(x)), evaluate on log2 grid
3957        # For others: poly(x), evaluate on linear grid
3958        if verbose:
3959            print(f"  [polynomial] {n_features} features  "
3960                  f"compute_derivative_roots={compute_derivative_roots}  "
3961                  f"compute_log2fc_params={compute_log2fc_params}")
3962        _t_poly = time.time()
3963        if compute_log2fc_params:
3964            if (x_obs_min is not None) and (x_obs_max is not None) and np.isfinite(x_obs_min) and np.isfinite(x_obs_max):
3965                x_min = float(x_obs_min)
3966                x_max = float(x_obs_max)
3967            else:
3968                # fallback: if no x info, pick a generic range
3969                x_min, x_max = 1.0, 2.0
3970
3971            eps = 1e-10
3972            n_eval = 1000
3973
3974            if is_log2_space:
3975                # For negbinom: polynomial is poly(log2(x))
3976                # Create grid in log2 space, evaluate polynomial there
3977                log2_min = np.log2(max(x_min, eps))
3978                log2_max = np.log2(max(x_max, eps))
3979                u_eval = np.linspace(log2_min, log2_max, n_eval)  # u = log2(x)
3980            else:
3981                # For normal/studentt/binomial: polynomial is poly(x)
3982                x_eval = np.linspace(x_min, x_max, n_eval)
3983
3984            full_mean = []
3985            observed_log2fc = []
3986            for t in range(n_features):
3987                if is_log2_space:
3988                    # poly(log2(x)) gives log2(y) - log2(A) (scaled by alpha)
3989                    # The polynomial output IS the log2FC contribution
3990                    poly_vals = self._poly_eval(u_eval, coefs_mean[t, :])
3991                    # Dynamic range is max - min of poly values (already in log2 space)
3992                    poly_range = np.nanmax(poly_vals) - np.nanmin(poly_vals)
3993                    full_mean.append(abs(poly_range) if np.isfinite(poly_range) else np.nan)
3994                    observed_log2fc.append(abs(poly_range) if np.isfinite(poly_range) else np.nan)
3995                else:
3996                    # poly(x) gives y directly (for normal/studentt) or logit contribution (binomial)
3997                    y_eval = self._poly_eval(x_eval, coefs_mean[t, :])
3998                    y_min_val = np.nanmin(y_eval)
3999                    y_max_val = np.nanmax(y_eval)
4000
4001                    # Log2 ratio only valid if both values are positive
4002                    if y_min_val > eps and y_max_val > eps:
4003                        full_mean.append(np.log2(y_max_val / y_min_val))
4004                        observed_log2fc.append(np.log2(y_max_val / y_min_val))
4005                    else:
4006                        # Fall back to NaN if y values are non-positive
4007                        full_mean.append(np.nan)
4008                        observed_log2fc.append(np.nan)
4009
4010            data['full_log2fc_median'] = full_mean
4011            data['full_log2fc_lower'] = full_mean
4012            data['full_log2fc_upper'] = full_mean
4013            data['observed_log2fc'] = observed_log2fc
4014            data['observed_log2fc_lower'] = observed_log2fc
4015            data['observed_log2fc_upper'] = observed_log2fc
4016
4017        # derivative roots over x_range
4018        # For negbinom: find roots in log2(x) space, convert back to linear x
4019        # For others: find roots in linear x space directly
4020        if compute_derivative_roots and (x_range is not None):
4021            first_roots = []
4022            second_roots = []
4023            third_roots = []
4024            n_first = []
4025            n_second = []
4026            n_third = []
4027
4028            eps = 1e-10
4029
4030            if is_log2_space:
4031                # Convert x_range to log2 space for root finding
4032                x_range_positive = x_range[x_range > eps]
4033                if len(x_range_positive) > 0:
4034                    u_range = np.log2(x_range_positive)
4035                else:
4036                    u_range = np.linspace(-5, 5, 1000)  # fallback
4037
4038            for t in range(n_features):
4039                if is_log2_space:
4040                    # Find roots in u = log2(x) space
4041                    r1_u, r2_u, r3_u = self._poly_derivative_roots(coefs_mean[t, :], u_range, compute_third=True)
4042                    # Convert roots back to linear x space: x = 2^u
4043                    r1 = [2**u for u in r1_u] if r1_u else []
4044                    r2 = [2**u for u in r2_u] if r2_u else []
4045                    r3 = [2**u for u in r3_u] if r3_u else []
4046                else:
4047                    # Find roots directly in linear x space
4048                    r1, r2, r3 = self._poly_derivative_roots(coefs_mean[t, :], x_range, compute_third=True)
4049
4050                first_roots.append(r1)
4051                second_roots.append(r2)
4052                third_roots.append(r3)
4053                n_first.append(len(r1))
4054                n_second.append(len(r2))
4055                n_third.append(len(r3))
4056
4057            data['n_first_deriv_roots'] = n_first
4058            data['n_second_deriv_roots'] = n_second
4059            data['n_third_deriv_roots'] = n_third
4060            # Roots are now in linear x space for all distributions
4061            data['first_deriv_roots_median'] = [';'.join([f'{r:.4f}' for r in rr]) if rr else np.nan for rr in first_roots]
4062            data['second_deriv_roots_median'] = [';'.join([f'{r:.4f}' for r in rr]) if rr else np.nan for rr in second_roots]
4063            data['third_deriv_roots_median'] = [';'.join([f'{r:.4f}' for r in rr]) if rr else np.nan for rr in third_roots]
4064
4065            # u-space root conversion: only when compute_log2fc_params is also True
4066            if compute_log2fc_params and 'x_ntc' in data and data['x_ntc'] is not None and np.isfinite(data['x_ntc']):
4067                log2_x_ntc = np.log2(max(float(data['x_ntc']), eps))
4068
4069                def _to_log2fc_str(root_str):
4070                    """Convert x-space root string to log2FC space (u = log2(x) - log2(x_ntc))."""
4071                    if root_str is None or (isinstance(root_str, float) and np.isnan(root_str)):
4072                        return np.nan
4073                    if isinstance(root_str, str) and root_str.strip() == '':
4074                        return np.nan
4075                    roots = [float(r) for r in str(root_str).split(';')]
4076                    u = [np.log2(max(r, eps)) - log2_x_ntc for r in roots]
4077                    return ';'.join([f'{val:.4f}' for val in u]) if u else np.nan
4078
4079                data['first_deriv_roots_log2fc_median'] = [_to_log2fc_str(s) for s in data['first_deriv_roots_median']]
4080                data['second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median'] = [_to_log2fc_str(s) for s in data['second_deriv_roots_median']]
4081                data['third_deriv_roots_log2fc_median'] = [_to_log2fc_str(s) for s in data['third_deriv_roots_median']]
4082
4083        if verbose:
4084            print(f"  [polynomial] total: {time.time() - _t_poly:.1f}s")
4085
4086        return data
4087
4088
4089    def _compute_hill_inflection(self, n, K, epsilon=1e-12):
4090        """
4091        Inflection point of Hill: Vmax * x^n / (K^n + x^n) (+ A)
4092    
4093        Exists iff |n| > 1.
4094    
4095        x_inflection = K * ((|n| - 1)/(|n| + 1))^(1/|n|)
4096        """
4097        n = np.asarray(n, dtype=float)
4098        K = np.asarray(K, dtype=float)
4099    
4100        nabs = np.abs(n)
4101        out = np.full(np.broadcast(n, K).shape, np.nan, dtype=float)
4102    
4103        valid = (nabs > 1) & np.isfinite(nabs) & np.isfinite(K) & (K > epsilon)
4104        if np.any(valid):
4105            ratio = (nabs[valid] - 1.0) / (nabs[valid] + 1.0)   # in (0,1)
4106            out[valid] = K[valid] * (ratio ** (1.0 / nabs[valid]))
4107        return out
4108
4109    # ========================================================================
4110    # Derivative and Root Finding Methods (for Additive Hill)
4111    # ========================================================================
4112
4113    def _exp_clip(self, z):
4114        # double precision exp overflow ~ 709; underflow ~ -745 is safe to clip
4115        return np.exp(np.clip(z, -745.0, 709.0))
4116    
4117    def _hill_first_derivative(self, x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-12):
4118        """
4119        d/dx [V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)] = (K^n * V * n * x^(n-1)) / (K^n + x^n)^2
4120        Stable for tiny x and/or negative n.
4121        """
4122        n = float(n)
4123        if abs(n) < 1e-15:
4124            return np.zeros_like(np.asarray(x, dtype=float))
4125
4126        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
4127        K = float(K); Vmax = float(Vmax); n = float(n)
4128    
4129        x_safe = np.maximum(x, epsilon)
4130        K_safe = max(K, epsilon)
4131    
4132        logx = np.log(x_safe)
4133        logK = np.log(K_safe)
4134    
4135        K_n   = self._exp_clip(n * logK)
4136        x_n   = self._exp_clip(n * logx)
4137        x_nm1 = self._exp_clip((n - 1.0) * logx)
4138    
4139        denom = (K_n + x_n) ** 2
4140        with np.errstate(over='ignore', under='ignore', invalid='ignore', divide='ignore'):
4141            out = (K_n * Vmax * n * x_nm1) / denom
4142    
4143        return np.where(np.isfinite(out), out, np.nan)
4144    
4145    def _hill_second_derivative(self, x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-12):
4146        """
4147        d²/dx² [V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)]
4148        = -(K^n * V * n * x^(n-2) * ((n+1)*x^n - K^n*(n-1))) / (K^n + x^n)^3
4149        Stable for tiny x and/or negative n.
4150        """
4151        n = float(n)
4152        if abs(n) < 1e-15:
4153            return np.zeros_like(np.asarray(x, dtype=float))
4154
4155        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
4156        K = float(K); Vmax = float(Vmax); n = float(n)
4157    
4158        x_safe = np.maximum(x, epsilon)
4159        K_safe = max(K, epsilon)
4160    
4161        logx = np.log(x_safe)
4162        logK = np.log(K_safe)
4163    
4164        K_n   = self._exp_clip(n * logK)
4165        x_n   = self._exp_clip(n * logx)
4166        x_nm2 = self._exp_clip((n - 2.0) * logx)
4167    
4168        denom = (K_n + x_n) ** 3
4169        inner = (n + 1.0) * x_n - K_n * (n - 1.0)
4170    
4171        with np.errstate(over='ignore', under='ignore', invalid='ignore', divide='ignore'):
4172            out = -(K_n * Vmax * n * x_nm2 * inner) / denom
4173    
4174        return np.where(np.isfinite(out), out, np.nan)
4175
4176    def _additive_hill_first_derivative(self, x, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
4177                                         beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b, epsilon=1e-12):
4178        """
4179        First derivative of additive Hill: dy/dx = alpha * dHill_a/dx + beta * dHill_b/dx
4180        """
4181        d_a = self._hill_first_derivative(x, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, epsilon)
4182        d_b = self._hill_first_derivative(x, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b, epsilon)
4183        return alpha * d_a + beta * d_b
4184
4185    def _additive_hill_second_derivative(self, x, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
4186                                          beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b, epsilon=1e-6):
4187        """
4188        Second derivative of additive Hill: d²y/dx² = alpha * d²Hill_a/dx² + beta * d²Hill_b/dx²
4189        """
4190        d2_a = self._hill_second_derivative(x, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, epsilon)
4191        d2_b = self._hill_second_derivative(x, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b, epsilon)
4192        return alpha * d2_a + beta * d2_b
4193
4194    def _hill_third_derivative(self, x, Vmax, K, n, epsilon=1e-12):
4195        """
4196        Numerically-stable third derivative of:
4197            f(x) = V * x^n / (K^n + x^n)
4198    
4199        Uses log-space exponentiation to avoid overflow/underflow.
4200        Returns NaN where the expression is numerically non-finite.
4201        """
4202        n = float(n)
4203        if abs(n) < 1e-15:
4204            return np.zeros_like(np.asarray(x, dtype=float))
4205
4206        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
4207        K = float(K)
4208        Vmax = float(Vmax)
4209        n = float(n)
4210    
4211        # Keep positivity, but use a *much smaller* epsilon so you don't flatten a wide region near 0.
4212        x_safe = np.maximum(x, epsilon)
4213        K_safe = max(K, epsilon)
4214    
4215        logx = np.log(x_safe)
4216        logK = np.log(K_safe)
4217    
4218        # helper: exp with clipping to avoid overflow
4219        # double precision exp overflows around ~709
4220        def exp_clip(z):
4221            return np.exp(np.clip(z, -745.0, 709.0))
4222    
4223        # powers in log-space
4224        x_n   = exp_clip(n * logx)
4225        x_2n  = exp_clip((2.0 * n) * logx)
4226        x_nm3 = exp_clip((n - 3.0) * logx)
4227    
4228        K_n   = exp_clip(n * logK)
4229        K_2n  = exp_clip((2.0 * n) * logK)
4230    
4231        denom = (K_n + x_n) ** 4
4232    
4233        term1 = (n**2 + 3.0*n + 2.0) * x_2n
4234        term2 = 4.0 * K_n * (1.0 - n**2) * x_n
4235        term3 = K_2n * (n**2 - 3.0*n + 2.0)
4236    
4237        numer = K_n * Vmax * n * x_nm3 * (term1 + term2 + term3)
4238    
4239        with np.errstate(over='ignore', under='ignore', invalid='ignore', divide='ignore'):
4240            out = numer / denom
4241    
4242        # Do NOT turn inf into 0; that creates fake roots.
4243        out = np.where(np.isfinite(out), out, np.nan)
4244        return out
4245
4246    def _additive_hill_third_derivative(self, x, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a,
4247                                         beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b, epsilon=1e-12):
4248        """
4249        Third derivative of additive Hill: d³y/dx³ = alpha * d³Hill_a/dx³ + beta * d³Hill_b/dx³
4250        """
4251        d3_a = self._hill_third_derivative(x, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, epsilon)
4252        d3_b = self._hill_third_derivative(x, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b, epsilon)
4253        return alpha * d3_a + beta * d3_b
4254
4255    def _dedup_roots_log2(self, roots, tol_log2=1e-3):
4256        """
4257        Deduplicate roots by proximity in log2(x).
4258        tol_log2=1e-3 means ~0.1% multiplicative tolerance.
4259        """
4260        if not roots:
4261            return []
4262        roots = np.array([r for r in roots if np.isfinite(r) and r > 0], dtype=float)
4263        if roots.size == 0:
4264            return []
4265        roots.sort()
4266        out = [roots[0]]
4267        last = roots[0]
4268        for r in roots[1:]:
4269            if abs(np.log2(r) - np.log2(last)) > tol_log2:
4270                out.append(r)
4271                last = r
4272        return out
4273        
4274    def _find_roots_empirical( 
4275        self, 
4276        func, 
4277        x_range: np.ndarray, 
4278        tol_log2_dedup: float = 1e-3, 
4279        # baseline “zero” settings 
4280        zero_atol: float = 1e-12, 
4281        zero_rtol: float = 1e-9, 
4282        # new: noise floor multiplier (helps for flat curves) 
4283        noise_mult: float = 5.0, 
4284        # new: require endpoints to exceed thr_hi (hysteresis) 
4285        hysteresis: float = 2.0, 
4286        # new: validate found root by probing around it in log2 space 
4287        validate: bool = True, 
4288        validate_dlog2: float = 2e-3, # ~0.14% multiplicative 
4289    ): 
4290        y_vals = np.asarray(func(x_range), dtype=float) 
4291        x_vals = np.asarray(x_range, dtype=float) 
4292        
4293        finite = np.isfinite(y_vals) & np.isfinite(x_vals) 
4294        if finite.sum() < 2: 
4295            return [] 
4296        
4297        y = y_vals[finite] 
4298        x = x_vals[finite] 
4299        
4300        # global scale 
4301        scale = np.nanmax(np.abs(y)) 
4302        if not np.isfinite(scale) or scale == 0.0: 
4303            return [] 
4304        
4305        # estimate a numerical noise floor from local variation 
4306        # (MAD of first differences is a decent proxy for “flat + jitter”) 
4307        dy = np.diff(y) 
4308        dy = dy[np.isfinite(dy)] 
4309        if dy.size > 0:
4310            mad = np.median(np.abs(dy - np.median(dy))) 
4311            noise = 1.4826 * mad 
4312        else: 
4313            noise = 0.0 
4314        
4315        thr = max(zero_atol, zero_rtol * scale, noise_mult * noise)
4316        thr_hi = hysteresis * thr 
4317        
4318        # If everything is within the deadband, treat as “no roots” 
4319        if np.all(np.abs(y) <= thr): 
4320            return [] 
4321        
4322        # deadband snap
4323        y0 = y.copy() 
4324        y0[np.abs(y0) <= thr] = 0.0 
4325        s = np.sign(y0) 
4326        
4327        roots = [] 
4328        
4329        # helper for validation 
4330        def _ok_root(r): 
4331            if not validate: 
4332                return True 
4333            if (not np.isfinite(r)) or (r <= 0): 
4334                return False 
4335            
4336            # probe multiplicatively around r: r * 2^(±dlog2) 
4337            rL = r * (2.0 ** (-validate_dlog2)) 
4338            rR = r * (2.0 ** ( validate_dlog2)) 
4339            
4340            try: 
4341                f0 = float(np.asarray(func(np.array([r]))).ravel()[0]) 
4342                fL = float(np.asarray(func(np.array([rL]))).ravel()[0]) 
4343                fR = float(np.asarray(func(np.array([rR]))).ravel()[0]) 
4344            except Exception: 
4345                return False 
4346            
4347            if not (np.isfinite(f0) and np.isfinite(fL) and np.isfinite(fR)): 
4348                return False 
4349            
4350            # require a *real* crossing: opposite signs on the two sides, 
4351            # and at least one side has magnitude above the stronger threshold 
4352            if fL == 0.0 or fR == 0.0: 
4353                return False 
4354            if (fL * fR) >= 0.0: 
4355                return False 
4356            if (abs(fL) < thr_hi) and (abs(fR) < thr_hi): 
4357                return False 
4358            
4359            # avoid “flat root” where everything is ~0
4360            if abs(f0) < thr and (abs(fL) < thr_hi) and (abs(fR) < thr_hi):
4361                return False 
4362            
4363            return True
4364
4365        for i in range(len(s) - 1): 
4366            # skip if either endpoint is inside the deadband (prevents “zero-touch” roots) 
4367            if s[i] == 0 or s[i + 1] == 0: 
4368                continue 
4369            
4370            # hysteresis: insist endpoints are not just barely outside thr 
4371            if (abs(y[i]) < thr_hi) or (abs(y[i + 1]) < thr_hi): 
4372                continue 
4373            
4374            if s[i] != s[i + 1]: 
4375                xL = float(x[i]) 
4376                xR = float(x[i + 1]) 
4377                
4378                try: 
4379                    root = brentq(lambda z: float(np.asarray(func(np.array([z]))).ravel()[0]), xL, xR) 
4380                except Exception: 
4381                    # fallback linear interpolation 
4382                    yL = float(y[i]) 
4383                    yR = float(y[i + 1]) 
4384                    t = abs(yL) / (abs(yL) + abs(yR)) 
4385                    root = float(xL + t * (xR - xL)) 
4386                    
4387                if _ok_root(root): 
4388                    roots.append(float(root)) 
4389                
4390        return self._dedup_roots_log2(roots, tol_log2=tol_log2_dedup)
4391
4392    def _find_roots_empirical_loose(
4393        self,
4394        func,
4395        x_range: np.ndarray,
4396        tol_log2_dedup: float = 1e-3,
4397        zero_atol: float = 1e-12,
4398        zero_rtol: float = 1e-9,
4399        include_near_zero_minima: bool = True,   # capture “touching” roots
4400    ):
4401        """
4402        Permissive empirical root finder:
4403          - finds sign-change roots (brentq)
4404          - optionally also returns local minima of |f| that are very close to zero
4405            (captures tangent roots where sign doesn't flip)
4406        """
4407        x = np.asarray(x_range, dtype=float)
4408        y = np.asarray(func(x), dtype=float)
4409    
4410        finite = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
4411        if finite.sum() < 3:
4412            return []
4413    
4414        x = x[finite]
4415        y = y[finite]
4416    
4417        scale = np.nanmax(np.abs(y))
4418        if not np.isfinite(scale) or scale == 0.0:
4419            return []
4420    
4421        thr = max(zero_atol, zero_rtol * scale)
4422    
4423        # ---------- 1) sign-change roots (DO NOT skip near-zero endpoints) ----------
4424        # snap tiny values to 0 only for sign bookkeeping
4425        y_snap = y.copy()
4426        y_snap[np.abs(y_snap) <= thr] = 0.0
4427        s = np.sign(y_snap)
4428    
4429        roots = []
4430    
4431        # to avoid missing crossings through long near-zero stretches, hop between
4432        # the nearest non-zero sign points.
4433        nz = np.where(s != 0)[0]
4434        if nz.size >= 2:
4435            for a, b in zip(nz[:-1], nz[1:]):
4436                if s[a] == s[b]:
4437                    continue
4438                xL, xR = float(x[a]), float(x[b])
4439                try:
4440                    root = brentq(lambda z: float(np.asarray(func(np.array([z]))).ravel()[0]), xL, xR)
4441                except Exception:
4442                    # fallback: linear interpolation
4443                    yL = float(y[a]); yR = float(y[b])
4444                    t = abs(yL) / (abs(yL) + abs(yR))
4445                    root = xL + t * (xR - xL)
4446                if np.isfinite(root) and root > 0:
4447                    roots.append(float(root))
4448    
4449        # ---------- 2) tangent “touching” roots (local minima of |y| near 0) ----------
4450        if include_near_zero_minima and y.size >= 3:
4451            ay = np.abs(y)
4452            # local minima indices of |y|
4453            mins = np.where((ay[1:-1] <= ay[:-2]) & (ay[1:-1] <= ay[2:]))[0] + 1
4454            for i in mins:
4455                if ay[i] <= thr:
4456                    roots.append(float(x[i]))
4457    
4458        return self._dedup_roots_log2(roots, tol_log2=tol_log2_dedup)
4459
4460    
4461    def _classify_additive_hill(self, alpha, alpha_lower, alpha_upper,
4462                                 beta, beta_lower, beta_upper,
4463                                 n_a, n_a_lower, n_a_upper,
4464                                 n_b, n_b_lower, n_b_upper,
4465                                 first_deriv_roots: List[float],
4466                                 second_deriv_roots: List[float],
4467                                 x_range: np.ndarray,
4468                                 Vmax_a, K_a, Vmax_b, K_b,
4469                                 x_ntc: float = None,
4470                                 p_active_a: float = None,
4471                                 p_active_b: float = None,
4472                                 fdr_threshold: float = 0.05) -> str:
4473        """
4474        Classify additive Hill function into categories based on dependency masks.
4475
4476        Classification Logic:
4477        - dep_mask_a: Component A is active — Bayesian q-value < fdr_threshold (default 0.05)
4478          where q-value is derived from P(alpha*Vmax_a/A > epsilon) pooled over both components.
4479          Note: p_active_a is actually the q-value passed from _add_additive_hill_params_individual.
4480        - dep_mask_b: Component B is active — q-value < fdr_threshold
4481          Falls back to CI-based check if p_active_a/p_active_b not provided.
4482        - dep_mask: Either component is active
4483
4484        Categories:
4485        - 'single_positive': Only one component active, with positive n (increasing)
4486            Formula: (~(dep_mask_a & dep_mask_b) & dep_mask) & (n >= 0 for active component)
4487        - 'single_negative': Only one component active, with negative n (decreasing)
4488            Formula: (~(dep_mask_a & dep_mask_b) & dep_mask) & (n <= 0 for active component)
4489        - 'additive_positive': Both components active, both with positive n
4490            Formula: (dep_mask_a & dep_mask_b) & (n_a >= 0) & (n_b >= 0)
4491        - 'additive_negative': Both components active, both with negative n
4492            Formula: (dep_mask_a & dep_mask_b) & (n_a <= 0) & (n_b <= 0)
4493        - 'non_monotonic_min': Both active, opposite signs, local minimum at nearest extremum to x_ntc
4494            (where S'=0, checked via S'' > 0 at that point)
4495        - 'non_monotonic_max': Both active, opposite signs, local maximum at nearest extremum to x_ntc
4496            (where S'=0, checked via S'' < 0 at that point)
4497        """
4498        # Define dependency masks using Bayesian q-value < fdr_threshold when available
4499        # (p_active_a/b are actually q-values passed from _add_additive_hill_params_individual),
4500        # falling back to CI-based check otherwise.
4501        if p_active_a is not None:
4502            dep_mask_a = p_active_a < fdr_threshold
4503        else:
4504            alpha_active = not (alpha_lower <= 0 <= alpha_upper)
4505            n_a_active   = not (n_a_lower   <= 0 <= n_a_upper)
4506            dep_mask_a   = alpha_active and n_a_active
4507
4508        if p_active_b is not None:
4509            dep_mask_b = p_active_b < fdr_threshold
4510        else:
4511            beta_active = not (beta_lower <= 0 <= beta_upper)
4512            n_b_active  = not (n_b_lower  <= 0 <= n_b_upper)
4513            dep_mask_b  = beta_active and n_b_active
4514        dep_mask = dep_mask_a or dep_mask_b  # At least one component active
4515
4516        # Check if both components are active
4517        both_active = dep_mask_a and dep_mask_b
4518        single_active = dep_mask and not both_active
4519
4520        # Determine signs of Hill coefficients for active components
4521        # Use mean values for classification
4522        if single_active:
4523            # Only one component is active
4524            if dep_mask_a:
4525                # Only component A is active
4526                if n_a >= 0:
4527                    return 'single_positive'
4528                else:
4529                    return 'single_negative'
4530            else:
4531                # Only component B is active
4532                if n_b >= 0:
4533                    return 'single_positive'
4534                else:
4535                    return 'single_negative'
4536
4537        if both_active:
4538            # Both components are active - check if same or opposite signs
4539            same_sign = (n_a * n_b) >= 0  # Both positive or both negative
4540
4541            if same_sign:
4542                # Additive: both increasing or both decreasing
4543                if n_a >= 0 and n_b >= 0:
4544                    return 'additive_positive'
4545                else:
4546                    return 'additive_negative'
4547            else:
4548                # Non-monotonic: opposite signs of n
4549                # Determine min vs max based on second derivative at the extremum
4550                # (where first derivative = 0)
4551                # S''(x_extremum) > 0 → concave up → local minimum
4552                # S''(x_extremum) < 0 → concave down → local maximum
4553                #
4554                # If multiple extrema, pick the one closest to x_ntc (u=0)
4555
4556                if len(first_deriv_roots) > 0:
4557                    # Find the extremum closest to x_ntc
4558                    if x_ntc is not None and x_ntc > 0:
4559                        # Find root closest to x_ntc
4560                        distances = [abs(np.log2(r) - np.log2(x_ntc)) for r in first_deriv_roots if r > 0]
4561                        if distances:
4562                            closest_idx = np.argmin(distances)
4563                            x_extremum = first_deriv_roots[closest_idx]
4564                        else:
4565                            x_extremum = first_deriv_roots[0]
4566                    else:
4567                        x_extremum = first_deriv_roots[0]
4568
4569                    # Check curvature at the extremum
4570                    d2_extremum = self._additive_hill_second_derivative(
4571                        x_extremum, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b
4572                    )
4573                    if d2_extremum > 0:
4574                        return 'non_monotonic_min'  # Concave up at extremum → local min
4575                    else:
4576                        return 'non_monotonic_max'  # Concave down at extremum → local max
4577
4578                return 'non_monotonic'  # Generic non-monotonic fallback (no roots found)
4579
4580        # No active components or indeterminate
4581        return 'flat'
4582
4583    def _compute_full_log2fc_additive(self, A, alpha, Vmax_a, beta, Vmax_b,
4584                                       x_range: np.ndarray,
4585                                       K_a, n_a, K_b, n_b,
4586                                       classification: str,
4587                                       first_deriv_roots: List[float] = None) -> float:
4588        """
4589        Compute full log2FC for additive Hill based on classification.
4590
4591        Returns log2(y_max / y_min) - the dynamic range in log2 space.
4592
4593        Hill function limits depend on sign of n:
4594        - n > 0: Hill(0) = 0, Hill(∞) = Vmax
4595        - n < 0: Hill(0) = Vmax, Hill(∞) = 0
4596        """
4597        epsilon = 1e-12
4598
4599        # Compute boundary values based on signs of n
4600        # At x→0: Hill = Vmax if n<0, else 0
4601        # At x→∞: Hill = 0 if n<0, else Vmax
4602        hill_a_at_0 = Vmax_a if n_a < 0 else 0
4603        hill_a_at_inf = 0 if n_a < 0 else Vmax_a
4604        hill_b_at_0 = Vmax_b if n_b < 0 else 0
4605        hill_b_at_inf = 0 if n_b < 0 else Vmax_b
4606
4607        y_at_0 = A + alpha * hill_a_at_0 + beta * hill_b_at_0
4608        y_at_inf = A + alpha * hill_a_at_inf + beta * hill_b_at_inf
4609
4610        # Ensure positive values for log
4611        y_at_0 = max(y_at_0, epsilon)
4612        y_at_inf = max(y_at_inf, epsilon)
4613
4614        if classification in ['monotonic_positive', 'monotonic_negative',
4615                               'single_positive', 'single_negative',
4616                               'additive_positive', 'additive_negative',
4617                               'single_hill_a', 'single_hill_b']:
4618            # For monotonic, log2FC is log2(y_max / y_min)
4619            y_max = max(y_at_0, y_at_inf)
4620            y_min = min(y_at_0, y_at_inf)
4621            return np.log2(max(y_max, epsilon) / max(y_min, epsilon))
4622
4623        # For non-monotonic, find interior extrema
4624        if first_deriv_roots is None:
4625            def first_deriv(x):
4626                return self._additive_hill_first_derivative(
4627                    x, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b
4628                )
4629            first_deriv_roots = self._find_roots_empirical(first_deriv, x_range)
4630
4631        if len(first_deriv_roots) == 0:
4632            # No interior extremum, use boundary difference
4633            y_max = max(y_at_0, y_at_inf)
4634            y_min = min(y_at_0, y_at_inf)
4635            return np.log2(max(y_max, epsilon) / max(y_min, epsilon))
4636
4637        # Evaluate y at the extrema
4638        def hill_func(x):
4639            x_safe = max(x, epsilon)
4640            K_a_safe = max(K_a, epsilon)
4641            K_b_safe = max(K_b, epsilon)
4642
4643            # Handle potential numerical issues with negative n
4644            if n_a >= 0:
4645                H_a = Vmax_a * (x_safe ** n_a) / (K_a_safe ** n_a + x_safe ** n_a + epsilon)
4646            else:
4647                # For n < 0: x^n = 1/x^|n|, need careful handling
4648                x_n_a = x_safe ** n_a
4649                K_n_a = K_a_safe ** n_a
4650                H_a = Vmax_a * x_n_a / (K_n_a + x_n_a + epsilon)
4651
4652            if n_b >= 0:
4653                H_b = Vmax_b * (x_safe ** n_b) / (K_b_safe ** n_b + x_safe ** n_b + epsilon)
4654            else:
4655                x_n_b = x_safe ** n_b
4656                K_n_b = K_b_safe ** n_b
4657                H_b = Vmax_b * x_n_b / (K_n_b + x_n_b + epsilon)
4658
4659            return A + alpha * H_a + beta * H_b
4660
4661        y_extrema = [hill_func(r) for r in first_deriv_roots]
4662
4663        # Find the largest range (total dynamic range) in log2 space
4664        all_y = [y_at_0, y_at_inf] + y_extrema
4665        y_max = max(all_y)
4666        y_min = min(all_y)
4667        return np.log2(max(y_max, epsilon) / max(y_min, epsilon))
4668
4669    def _compute_observed_log2fc_fitted(
4670        self, A, alpha, Vmax_a, beta, Vmax_b,
4671        K_a, n_a, K_b, n_b,
4672        x_obs_min: float, x_obs_max: float,
4673        return_argextrema: bool = False
4674    ):
4675        eps = 1e-10
4676    
4677        n_points = 1000
4678        log2_min = np.log2(max(x_obs_min, eps))
4679        log2_max = np.log2(max(x_obs_max, eps))
4680        x_eval = 2.0 ** np.linspace(log2_min, log2_max, n_points)
4681    
4682        K_a_safe = max(K_a, eps)
4683        K_b_safe = max(K_b, eps)
4684    
4685        # Hill A/B in log-space
4686        x_n_a = self._exp_clip(n_a * np.log(x_eval))
4687        K_n_a = self._exp_clip(n_a * np.log(K_a_safe))
4688        H_a = Vmax_a * x_n_a / (K_n_a + x_n_a)
4689    
4690        x_n_b = self._exp_clip(n_b * np.log(x_eval))
4691        K_n_b = self._exp_clip(n_b * np.log(K_b_safe))
4692        H_b = Vmax_b * x_n_b / (K_n_b + x_n_b)
4693    
4694        y_vals = A + alpha * H_a + beta * H_b
4695    
4696        # IMPORTANT: don't overwrite invalids with A (that can create fake extrema)
4697        y_vals = np.asarray(y_vals, dtype=float)
4698        y_vals[~np.isfinite(y_vals)] = np.nan
4699    
4700        if np.all(np.isnan(y_vals)):
4701            if return_argextrema:
4702                return np.nan, (np.nan, np.nan)
4703            return np.nan
4704    
4705        # positivity for log-ratio
4706        y_clip = np.maximum(y_vals, eps)
4707    
4708        imax = int(np.nanargmax(y_clip))
4709        imin = int(np.nanargmin(y_clip))
4710        y_max = float(y_clip[imax])
4711        y_min = float(y_clip[imin])
4712    
4713        out = float(np.log2(y_max / y_min))
4714        if return_argextrema:
4715            return out, (float(x_eval[imin]), float(x_eval[imax]))
4716        return out
4717
4718    def _compute_observed_delta_p_fitted(
4719        self, A, alpha, Vmax_a, beta, Vmax_b,
4720        K_a, n_a, K_b, n_b,
4721        x_obs_min: float, x_obs_max: float,
4722        return_argextrema: bool = False
4723    ):
4724        """
4725        Compute observed delta_p (y_max - y_min) over the observed x range.
4726        For binomial distributions where delta_p = p - p_ntc.
4727        """
4728        eps = 1e-10
4729
4730        n_points = 1000
4731        log2_min = np.log2(max(x_obs_min, eps))
4732        log2_max = np.log2(max(x_obs_max, eps))
4733        x_eval = 2.0 ** np.linspace(log2_min, log2_max, n_points)
4734
4735        K_a_safe = max(K_a, eps)
4736        K_b_safe = max(K_b, eps)
4737
4738        # Hill A/B in log-space
4739        x_n_a = self._exp_clip(n_a * np.log(x_eval))
4740        K_n_a = self._exp_clip(n_a * np.log(K_a_safe))
4741        H_a = Vmax_a * x_n_a / (K_n_a + x_n_a)
4742
4743        x_n_b = self._exp_clip(n_b * np.log(x_eval))
4744        K_n_b = self._exp_clip(n_b * np.log(K_b_safe))
4745        H_b = Vmax_b * x_n_b / (K_n_b + x_n_b)
4746
4747        y_vals = A + alpha * H_a + beta * H_b
4748
4749        # IMPORTANT: don't overwrite invalids with A (that can create fake extrema)
4750        y_vals = np.asarray(y_vals, dtype=float)
4751        y_vals[~np.isfinite(y_vals)] = np.nan
4752
4753        if np.all(np.isnan(y_vals)):
4754            if return_argextrema:
4755                return np.nan, (np.nan, np.nan)
4756            return np.nan
4757
4758        # For delta_p, we use the raw values (no positivity constraint needed)
4759        imax = int(np.nanargmax(y_vals))
4760        imin = int(np.nanargmin(y_vals))
4761        y_max = float(y_vals[imax])
4762        y_min = float(y_vals[imin])
4763
4764        out = float(y_max - y_min)
4765        if return_argextrema:
4766            return out, (float(x_eval[imin]), float(x_eval[imax]))
4767        return out
4768

4772
4773    @staticmethod
4774    def _parse_semicolon_roots(val):
4775        """Parse a semicolon-separated root string (e.g. '0.8;2.1') into a sorted list of floats."""
4776        if val is None:
4777            return []
4778        if isinstance(val, float) and np.isnan(val):
4779            return []
4780        s = str(val).strip()
4781        if s == "" or s.lower() == "nan":
4782            return []
4783        out = []
4784        for tok in s.split(";"):
4785            tok = tok.strip()
4786            if not tok:
4787                continue
4788            try:
4789                x = float(tok)
4790            except ValueError:
4791                continue
4792            if np.isfinite(x):
4793                out.append(x)
4794        return sorted(set(out))
4795
4796    def classify_second_deriv_roots(
4797        self,
4798        df: "pd.DataFrame",
4799        root_col: str = "second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median",
4800        tol_f: float = 1e-10,
4801        tol_f3: float = 1e-12,
4802    ) -> "pd.DataFrame":
4803        """
4804        Classify second-derivative roots as local maxima or minima of |g'(u)|.
4805
4806        At each root u* where g''(u*) = 0, the first derivative g'(u) is either at a
4807        local maximum or minimum of its absolute value:
4808          - sign(g') * g'''  > 0  →  local_min_abs  (|g'| decreasing through u*)
4809          - sign(g') * g'''  < 0  →  local_max_abs  (|g'| increasing through u*)
4810          - g' ≈ 0                →  local_min_abs  (|g'| can't go below 0)
4811
4812        Only supported for additive_hill function type.  Rows with missing parameters
4813        or no roots are skipped.
4814
4815        Parameters
4816        ----------
4817        df : pd.DataFrame
4818            Summary DataFrame returned by ``save_trans_summary`` (with
4819            ``compute_derivative_roots=True``).  Required columns:
4820            ``feature``, ``x_ntc``, ``A_median``, ``alpha_median``, ``beta_median``,
4821            ``Vmax_a_median``, ``K_a_median``, ``n_a_median``, ``Vmax_b_median``,
4822            ``K_b_median``, ``n_b_median``, and the root column specified by
4823            ``root_col``.
4824        root_col : str
4825            Column in *df* containing the semicolon-separated root strings to
4826            evaluate (default: ``"second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median"``).
4827        tol_f : float
4828            Absolute tolerance below which g'(u) is treated as zero (default 1e-10).
4829        tol_f3 : float
4830            Absolute tolerance below which g'''(u) is treated as zero (default 1e-12).
4831
4832        Returns
4833        -------
4834        pd.DataFrame
4835            One row per (feature, root) with columns:
4836            - ``feature``: feature name
4837            - ``u_root``: the root value in log2FC space
4838            - ``dg_du``: first derivative g'(u) at the root
4839            - ``d3g_du3``: third derivative g'''(u) at the root
4840            - ``abs_dg_du``: absolute value of g'(u)
4841            - ``extremum_type_abs``: ``"local_min_abs"``, ``"local_max_abs"``,
4842              or ``"ambiguous"``
4843            - ``classification``: the feature's classification column from *df*
4844              (passed through unchanged, NaN if absent)
4845
4846        Examples
4847        --------
4848        >>> df = model.save_trans_summary(compute_derivative_roots=True)
4849        >>> df_roots = model.classify_second_deriv_roots(df)
4850        >>> # Keep only clear local maxima of rate of change
4851        >>> peaks = df_roots[df_roots["extremum_type_abs"] == "local_max_abs"]
4852        """
4853        required_params = ["x_ntc", "A_median", "alpha_median", "beta_median",
4854                           "Vmax_a_median", "K_a_median", "n_a_median",
4855                           "Vmax_b_median", "K_b_median", "n_b_median"]
4856        missing = [c for c in ["feature", root_col] + required_params if c not in df.columns]
4857        if missing:
4858            raise ValueError(
4859                f"classify_second_deriv_roots: DataFrame is missing required columns: {missing}. "
4860                "Ensure save_trans_summary was called with compute_derivative_roots=True and "
4861                "function_type='additive_hill'."
4862            )
4863
4864        rows = []
4865        for _, r in df.iterrows():
4866            roots_u = self._parse_semicolon_roots(r.get(root_col, ""))
4867            if not roots_u:
4868                continue
4869
4870            try:
4871                x_ntc  = float(r["x_ntc"])
4872                A      = float(r["A_median"])
4873                alpha  = float(r["alpha_median"])
4874                beta   = float(r["beta_median"])
4875                Vmax_a = float(r["Vmax_a_median"])
4876                K_a    = float(r["K_a_median"])
4877                n_a    = float(r["n_a_median"])
4878                Vmax_b = float(r["Vmax_b_median"])
4879                K_b    = float(r["K_b_median"])
4880                n_b    = float(r["n_b_median"])
4881            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
4882                continue
4883
4884            u_arr = np.array(roots_u, dtype=float)
4885            g1, _g2, g3 = self._g_derivs_at_u(
4886                u_arr, A, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b, x_ntc
4887            )
4888
4889            feat = r["feature"]
4890            classif = r.get("classification", None)
4891            for u, dg_du, d3g_du3 in zip(roots_u, g1, g3):
4892                rows.append({
4893                    "feature":        feat,
4894                    "u_root":         u,
4895                    "dg_du":          dg_du,
4896                    "d3g_du3":        d3g_du3,
4897                    "classification": classif,
4898                })
4899
4900        if not rows:
4901            return pd.DataFrame(columns=["feature", "u_root", "dg_du", "d3g_du3",
4902                                         "abs_dg_du", "extremum_type_abs", "classification"])
4903
4904        df_roots = pd.DataFrame(rows)
4905        df_roots = (df_roots
4906                    .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
4907                    .dropna(subset=["u_root", "dg_du", "d3g_du3"])
4908                    .reset_index(drop=True))
4909
4910        f  = df_roots["dg_du"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
4911        f3 = df_roots["d3g_du3"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
4912
4913        sgn_f = np.zeros_like(f)
4914        sgn_f[f >  tol_f] =  1.0
4915        sgn_f[f < -tol_f] = -1.0
4916
4917        curv_abs = sgn_f * f3
4918
4919        ext_type = np.full(len(df_roots), "ambiguous", dtype=object)
4920        # |g'| ~ 0 → can only be a minimum of |g'|
4921        ext_type[np.abs(f) <= tol_f] = "local_min_abs"
4922        mask = np.abs(f) > tol_f
4923        ext_type[mask & (curv_abs >  tol_f3)] = "local_min_abs"
4924        ext_type[mask & (curv_abs < -tol_f3)] = "local_max_abs"
4925
4926        df_roots["extremum_type_abs"] = ext_type
4927        df_roots["abs_dg_du"]         = np.abs(f)
4928
4929        return df_roots

def save_ntc_summary( self, output_dir: Optional[str] = None, modality_name: Optional[str] = None): 
1009    def save_ntc_summary(
1010        self,
1011        output_dir: Optional[str] = None,
1012        modality_name: Optional[str] = None
1013    ):
1014        """
1015        Save NTC fit parameters as feature-wise CSV.
1016
1017        Creates: ntc_feature_summary_{modality}.csv
1018
1019        Columns:
1020        - feature: Feature name
1021        - modality: Modality name
1022        - distribution: Distribution type
1023        - group_{i}_alpha_y_median: Median alpha_y for group i (point estimate from fit_ntc)
1024        - group_{i}_alpha_y_lower: 2.5% quantile for group i
1025        - group_{i}_alpha_y_upper: 97.5% quantile for group i
1026
1027        Parameters
1028        ----------
1029        output_dir : str, optional
1030            Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label)
1031        modality_name : str, optional
1032            Modality to export (default: primary modality)
1033        """
1034        if output_dir is None:
1035            output_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
1036
1037        if modality_name is None:
1038            modality_name = self.model.primary_modality
1039
1040        # Get modality
1041        modality = self.model.get_modality(modality_name)
1042
1043        # Check if technical fit has been run for this modality
1044        if not hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit') or modality.alpha_y_prefit is None:
1045            raise ValueError(f"NTC fit not found for modality '{modality_name}'. Run fit_ntc() first.")
1046
1047        # Get alpha_y for this modality (prefer distribution-specific versions)
1048        if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_mult') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_mult is not None:
1049            alpha_y = modality.alpha_y_prefit_mult  # [C, T] point estimate
1050        elif hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None:
1051            alpha_y = modality.alpha_y_prefit_add  # [C, T] point estimate
1052        else:
1053            alpha_y = modality.alpha_y_prefit  # [C, T] point estimate
1054
1055        # Convert to numpy if tensor
1056        if isinstance(alpha_y, torch.Tensor):
1057            alpha_y = alpha_y.cpu().numpy()
1058
1059        # For multinomial, alpha_y is [C, T, K]; for all others, [C, T].
1060        # If an old-format tensor with a leading samples dim (S) was stored, collapse it.
1061        if modality.distribution == 'multinomial':
1062            if alpha_y.ndim == 4:  # [S, C, T, K] — collapse S
1063                alpha_y = alpha_y.mean(axis=0)
1064            # alpha_y is now [C, T, K]
1065        else:
1066            if alpha_y.ndim == 3:  # [S, C, T] — collapse S
1067                alpha_y = alpha_y.mean(axis=0)
1068            # alpha_y is now [C, T]
1069
1070        # Get feature names - prefer modality.feature_names (what users see)
1071        if modality.feature_names is not None:
1072            feature_names = modality.feature_names
1073        else:
1074            feature_names = modality.feature_meta.index.tolist()
1075        n_features = len(feature_names)
1076        n_groups = alpha_y.shape[0]  # [C, T] → C groups
1077
1078        alpha_median = alpha_y  # [C, T] — point estimate stored as median at fit time
1079        alpha_lower = alpha_y  # no uncertainty (point estimate)
1080        alpha_upper = alpha_y
1081
1082        # Extract mu_ntc and o_y medians from posterior_samples_ntc ([S, T] → [T])
1083        def _extract_scalar_posterior(ps, key):
1084            v = ps.get(key)
1085            if v is None:
1086                return None
1087            if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor):
1088                v = v.cpu().numpy()
1089            if v.ndim == 1:
1090                return v
1091            return np.median(v, axis=0).flatten()  # collapse samples + any extra dims → [T]
1092
1093        ps = getattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc', None) or {}
1094        mu_ntc_vals = _extract_scalar_posterior(ps, 'mu_ntc')
1095        o_y_vals    = _extract_scalar_posterior(ps, 'o_y')
1096
1097        # Build DataFrame
1098        cis_gene = getattr(self.model, 'cis_gene', None)
1099        is_primary = modality_name == self.model.primary_modality
1100        data = {'feature': feature_names}
1101        if is_primary and cis_gene is not None:
1102            data['is_cis_gene'] = [f == cis_gene for f in feature_names]
1103        data['modality'] = modality_name
1104        data['distribution'] = modality.distribution
1105
1106        # Add columns for each group.
1107        # For multinomial alpha_y is [C, T, K]: export one column per (group, category).
1108        # For all others alpha_y is [C, T]: one column per group.
1109        if modality.distribution == 'multinomial':
1110            K_alpha = alpha_median.shape[2]
1111            for g in range(n_groups):
1112                for k in range(K_alpha):
1113                    data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_cat{k}_median'] = alpha_median[g, :, k]
1114                    data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_cat{k}_lower'] = alpha_lower[g, :, k]
1115                    data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_cat{k}_upper'] = alpha_upper[g, :, k]
1116        else:
1117            for g in range(n_groups):
1118                data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_median'] = alpha_median[g, :]
1119                data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_lower'] = alpha_lower[g, :]
1120                data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_upper'] = alpha_upper[g, :]
1121
1122        if mu_ntc_vals is not None:
1123            data['mu_ntc'] = mu_ntc_vals
1124        if o_y_vals is not None:
1125            data['o_y'] = o_y_vals
1126
1127        df = pd.DataFrame(data)
1128
1129        # Append cis gene row if this is the primary modality and alpha_x_prefit is available
1130        alpha_x = getattr(self.model, 'alpha_x_prefit', None)
1131        cis_appended = False
1132        if is_primary and cis_gene is not None and alpha_x is not None:
1133            alpha_x_np = alpha_x.cpu().numpy() if isinstance(alpha_x, torch.Tensor) else np.asarray(alpha_x)
1134            cis_ps = getattr(self.model.get_modality('cis'), 'posterior_samples_ntc', None) or {}
1135            cis_mu = _extract_scalar_posterior(cis_ps, 'mu_ntc')
1136            cis_oy = _extract_scalar_posterior(cis_ps, 'o_x')  # stored as o_x in cis modality
1137            cis_row = {
1138                'feature': cis_gene,
1139                'is_cis_gene': True,
1140                'modality': modality_name,
1141                'distribution': modality.distribution,
1142            }
1143            for g in range(n_groups):
1144                val = float(alpha_x_np[g]) if g < len(alpha_x_np) else float('nan')
1145                cis_row[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_median'] = val
1146                cis_row[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_lower'] = val
1147                cis_row[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_upper'] = val
1148            if mu_ntc_vals is not None:
1149                cis_row['mu_ntc'] = float(cis_mu[0]) if cis_mu is not None else float('nan')
1150            if o_y_vals is not None:
1151                cis_row['o_y'] = float(cis_oy[0]) if cis_oy is not None else float('nan')
1152            df = pd.concat([df, pd.DataFrame([cis_row])], ignore_index=True)
1153            cis_appended = True
1154
1155        # Save
1156        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
1157        output_file = os.path.join(output_dir, f'ntc_feature_summary_{modality_name}.csv')
1158        df.to_csv(output_file, index=False)
1159
1160        print(f"[SAVE] Technical summary saved to {output_file}")
1161        print(f"       {len(df)} features × {n_groups} groups ({n_features} trans + cis gene)"
1162              if cis_appended
1163              else f"       {n_features} features × {n_groups} groups")
1164
1165        return df
