def save_cis_summary( self, output_dir: Optional[str] = None, include_cell_level: bool = True): 
1171    def save_cis_summary(
1172        self,
1173        output_dir: Optional[str] = None,
1174        include_cell_level: bool = True
1175    ):
1176        """
1177        Save cis fit parameters as guide-wise and cell-wise CSVs.
1178
1179        Creates:
1180        - cis_guide_summary.csv: Guide-level summary
1181        - cis_cell_summary.csv: Cell-level data (if include_cell_level=True)
1182
1183        Guide-level columns (single-guide mode):
1184        - guide: Guide name
1185        - target: Target gene
1186        - n_cells: Number of cells
1187        - x_true_mean: Mean x_true (averaged over cells in guide, then over posterior samples)
1188        - x_true_lower: 2.5% quantile
1189        - x_true_upper: 97.5% quantile
1190        - raw_counts_mean: Average raw counts
1191
1192        Guide-level columns (high MOI mode):
1193        - guide: Guide name
1194        - targets: Comma-separated target gene(s)
1195        - n_cells: Number of cells carrying this guide
1196        - x_eff_g_mean: Mean per-guide effective expression
1197        - x_eff_g_lower: 2.5% quantile
1198        - x_eff_g_upper: 97.5% quantile
1199        - sigma_eff_mean: Mean per-guide effect uncertainty
1200        - raw_counts_mean: Average raw counts for cells carrying this guide
1201
1202        Cell-level columns:
1203        - cell: Cell barcode
1204        - guide: Guide name (single-guide mode only)
1205        - target: Target classification (cis gene or 'ntc')
1206        - technical_group_code: Technical group (if available)
1207        - x_true_mean: Mean cell-level x_true
1208        - x_true_lower: 2.5% quantile
1209        - x_true_upper: 97.5% quantile
1210        - raw_counts: Raw counts for this cell
1211
1212        Parameters
1213        ----------
1214        output_dir : str, optional
1215            Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label)
1216        include_cell_level : bool
1217            Whether to save cell-level summary (default: True)
1218        """
1219        if output_dir is None:
1220            output_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
1221
1222        # Check if cis fit has been run
1223        if not hasattr(self.model, 'x_true') or self.model.x_true is None:
1224            raise ValueError("Cis fit not found. Run fit_cis() first.")
1225
1226        is_high_moi = getattr(self.model, 'is_high_moi', False)
1227
1228        # Get x_true samples — shape is [n_samples, n_cells] (cell-level)
1229        if hasattr(self.model, 'posterior_samples_cis') and 'x_true' in self.model.posterior_samples_cis:
1230            x_true_cell_samples = self.model.posterior_samples_cis['x_true']
1231            if isinstance(x_true_cell_samples, torch.Tensor):
1232                x_true_cell_samples = x_true_cell_samples.cpu().numpy()
1233        else:
1234            # Use point estimate
1235            x_true_pt = self.model.x_true
1236            if isinstance(x_true_pt, torch.Tensor):
1237                x_true_pt = x_true_pt.cpu().numpy()
1238            x_true_cell_samples = x_true_pt[np.newaxis, :]  # [1, n_cells]
1239
1240        # Get raw counts from cis modality
1241        cis_mod = self.model.get_modality('cis')
1242        cis_counts = cis_mod.counts[0, :]  # [n_cells]
1243
1244        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
1245
1246        # ── Guide-level summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────
1247        if is_high_moi:
1248            # In high MOI mode, guide-level parameters are x_eff_g and sigma_eff [G]
1249            cis_ps = self.model.posterior_samples_cis
1250
1251            x_eff_g_samples = cis_ps['x_eff_g']  # [n_samples, G]
1252            if isinstance(x_eff_g_samples, torch.Tensor):
1253                x_eff_g_samples = x_eff_g_samples.cpu().numpy()
1254
1255            sigma_eff_samples = cis_ps['sigma_eff']  # [n_samples, G]
1256            if isinstance(sigma_eff_samples, torch.Tensor):
1257                sigma_eff_samples = sigma_eff_samples.cpu().numpy()
1258
1259            guides = self.model.guide_meta['guide'].tolist()
1260            G = len(guides)
1261
1262            # Cells per guide from guide_assignment (N x G binary matrix)
1263            guide_assignment = self.model.guide_assignment  # numpy [N, G]
1264            n_cells_per_guide = guide_assignment.sum(axis=0).astype(int)  # [G]
1265
1266            # Average raw counts for cells carrying each guide
1267            raw_counts_mean = []
1268            for gi in range(G):
1269                cell_mask = guide_assignment[:, gi].astype(bool)
1270                if cell_mask.any():
1271                    raw_counts_mean.append(float(cis_counts[cell_mask].mean()))
1272                else:
1273                    raw_counts_mean.append(float('nan'))
1274
1275            # Targets: comma-separated list from guide_targets_dict
1276            gtd = getattr(self.model, 'guide_targets_dict', {})
1277            targets_col = [
1278                ','.join(gtd.get(g, ['unknown']))
1279                for g in guides
1280            ]
1281
1282            guide_df = pd.DataFrame({
1283                'guide': guides,
1284                'targets': targets_col,
1285                'n_cells': n_cells_per_guide,
1286                'x_eff_g_mean': x_eff_g_samples.mean(axis=0),
1287                'x_eff_g_lower': np.quantile(x_eff_g_samples, 0.025, axis=0),
1288                'x_eff_g_upper': np.quantile(x_eff_g_samples, 0.975, axis=0),
1289                'sigma_eff_mean': sigma_eff_samples.mean(axis=0),
1290                'raw_counts_mean': raw_counts_mean,
1291            })
1292
1293            guide_file = os.path.join(output_dir, 'cis_guide_summary.csv')
1294            guide_df.to_csv(guide_file, index=False)
1295            print(f"[SAVE] Cis guide summary saved to {guide_file}")
1296            print(f"       {G} guides (high MOI)")
1297
1298        else:
1299            # Get guide-level metadata
1300            guide_meta = self.model.meta.groupby('guide').agg({
1301                'target': 'first',
1302                'cell': 'count'
1303            }).rename(columns={'cell': 'n_cells'})
1304
1305            guides = guide_meta.index.tolist()
1306
1307            # Aggregate x_true from cell-level to guide-level (mean over cells per guide)
1308            # Use positional indices (iloc) because meta.index may be cell-name strings
1309            guide_to_cell_indices = {
1310                g: np.where(self.model.meta['guide'].values == g)[0].tolist()
1311                for g in guides
1312            }
1313
1314            # Build [n_samples, n_guides] by averaging cells within each guide
1315            n_samples = x_true_cell_samples.shape[0]
1316            n_guides = len(guides)
1317            x_true_guide_samples = np.zeros((n_samples, n_guides))
1318            for gi, g in enumerate(guides):
1319                cell_idx = guide_to_cell_indices[g]
1320                x_true_guide_samples[:, gi] = x_true_cell_samples[:, cell_idx].mean(axis=1)
1321
1322            # Compute mean and CI per guide
1323            x_true_mean = x_true_guide_samples.mean(axis=0)
1324            x_true_lower = np.quantile(x_true_guide_samples, 0.025, axis=0)
1325            x_true_upper = np.quantile(x_true_guide_samples, 0.975, axis=0)
1326
1327            # Compute average raw counts per guide
1328            guide_to_cells = self.model.meta.groupby('guide')['cell'].apply(list).to_dict()
1329            raw_counts_mean = []
1330            for guide in guides:
1331                guide_cells = guide_to_cells.get(guide, [])
1332                guide_cell_indices = [i for i, cell in enumerate(self.model.meta['cell']) if cell in guide_cells]
1333                if len(guide_cell_indices) > 0:
1334                    raw_counts_mean.append(cis_counts[guide_cell_indices].mean())
1335                else:
1336                    raw_counts_mean.append(np.nan)
1337
1338            guide_df = pd.DataFrame({
1339                'guide': guides,
1340                'target': guide_meta['target'].values,
1341                'n_cells': guide_meta['n_cells'].values,
1342                'x_true_mean': x_true_mean,
1343                'x_true_lower': x_true_lower,
1344                'x_true_upper': x_true_upper,
1345                'raw_counts_mean': raw_counts_mean
1346            })
1347
1348            guide_file = os.path.join(output_dir, 'cis_guide_summary.csv')
1349            guide_df.to_csv(guide_file, index=False)
1350            print(f"[SAVE] Cis guide summary saved to {guide_file}")
1351            print(f"       {len(guides)} guides")
1352
1353        # ── Cell-level summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────
1354        if include_cell_level:
1355            cell_data = {
1356                'cell': self.model.meta['cell'].values,
1357                'target': self.model.meta['target'].values,
1358            }
1359
1360            # In single-guide mode, include per-cell guide assignment
1361            if not is_high_moi:
1362                cell_data['guide'] = self.model.meta['guide'].values
1363
1364            # Add technical_group_code if available
1365            if 'technical_group_code' in self.model.meta.columns:
1366                cell_data['technical_group_code'] = self.model.meta['technical_group_code'].values
1367
1368            # Use cell-level x_true directly from posterior samples
1369            cell_data['x_true_mean'] = x_true_cell_samples.mean(axis=0)
1370            cell_data['x_true_lower'] = np.quantile(x_true_cell_samples, 0.025, axis=0)
1371            cell_data['x_true_upper'] = np.quantile(x_true_cell_samples, 0.975, axis=0)
1372            cell_data['raw_counts'] = cis_counts
1373
1374            cell_df = pd.DataFrame(cell_data)
1375
1376            cell_file = os.path.join(output_dir, 'cis_cell_summary.csv')
1377            cell_df.to_csv(cell_file, index=False)
1378            print(f"[SAVE] Cis cell summary saved to {cell_file}")
1379            print(f"       {len(cell_df)} cells")
1380
1381            return guide_df, cell_df
1382
1383        return guide_df

Save cis fit parameters as guide-wise and cell-wise CSVs.

Creates:

  • cis_guide_summary.csv: Guide-level summary
  • cis_cell_summary.csv: Cell-level data (if include_cell_level=True)

Guide-level columns (single-guide mode):

  • guide: Guide name
  • target: Target gene
  • n_cells: Number of cells
  • x_true_mean: Mean x_true (averaged over cells in guide, then over posterior samples)
  • x_true_lower: 2.5% quantile
  • x_true_upper: 97.5% quantile
  • raw_counts_mean: Average raw counts

Guide-level columns (high MOI mode):

  • guide: Guide name
  • targets: Comma-separated target gene(s)
  • n_cells: Number of cells carrying this guide
  • x_eff_g_mean: Mean per-guide effective expression
  • x_eff_g_lower: 2.5% quantile
  • x_eff_g_upper: 97.5% quantile
  • sigma_eff_mean: Mean per-guide effect uncertainty
  • raw_counts_mean: Average raw counts for cells carrying this guide

Cell-level columns:

  • cell: Cell barcode
  • guide: Guide name (single-guide mode only)
  • target: Target classification (cis gene or 'ntc')
  • technical_group_code: Technical group (if available)
  • x_true_mean: Mean cell-level x_true
  • x_true_lower: 2.5% quantile
  • x_true_upper: 97.5% quantile
  • raw_counts: Raw counts for this cell

Parameters

output_dir : str, optional Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label) include_cell_level : bool Whether to save cell-level summary (default: True)

def save_trans_summary( self, output_dir: Optional[str] = None, modality_name: Optional[str] = None, compute_inflection: bool = True, compute_derivative_roots: bool = True, compute_log2fc_params: bool = True, compute_lfc_ci: bool = True, x_ntc: Optional[float] = None, y_ntc=None, verbose: bool = True, max_features: Optional[int] = None): 
1415    def save_trans_summary(
1416        self,
1417        output_dir: Optional[str] = None,
1418        modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1419        compute_inflection: bool = True,
1420        compute_derivative_roots: bool = True,
1421        compute_log2fc_params: bool = True,
1422        compute_lfc_ci: bool = True,
1423        x_ntc: Optional[float] = None,
1424        y_ntc=None,
1425        verbose: bool = True,
1426        max_features: Optional[int] = None,
1427    ):
1428        """
1429        Save trans fit parameters as feature-wise CSV.
1430
1431        Creates: trans_feature_summary_{modality}.csv
1432
1433        Columns (depend on function_type and distribution):
1434        - feature: Feature name
1435        - modality: Modality name
1436        - distribution: Distribution type
1437        - function_type: Function type (additive_hill, single_hill, polynomial)
1438        - x_obs_min, x_obs_max: Observed x range (min/max of guide-level x_true)
1439
1440        For negbinom/normal/studentt distributions:
1441        - observed_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over observed x range from fitted function
1442        - full_log2fc_median/lower/upper: log2(y_max / y_min) over theoretical x range (0 to ∞)
1443
1444        For binomial distributions (e.g., splicing_sj):
1445        - observed_delta_p: y_max - y_min over observed x range (probability difference)
1446        - full_delta_p_median/lower/upper: y_max - y_min over theoretical x range
1447
1448        FDR columns (all function types):
1449        - fdr_alpha: Bayesian q-value for component A (positive Hill, or the single Hill
1450                     component in single_hill).  The minimum expected FDR among all called
1451                     sets that include this feature's component A.  Analogous to a
1452                     Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value: calling all features with
1453                     fdr_alpha <= q controls the expected false discovery rate at q.
1454                     For additive_hill, computed over the *pooled* family of 2*n_features
1455                     tests (alpha + beta), which accounts for the increased multiple-testing
1456                     burden relative to single_hill.
1457        - fdr_beta:  Bayesian q-value for component B (negative Hill).  NaN for
1458                     single_hill and polynomial.  Computed in the same pooled family as
1459                     fdr_alpha for additive_hill.
1460
1461        For additive_hill (all parameters needed to recreate: y = A + alpha*Vmax_a*Hill(x;K_a,n_a) + beta*Vmax_b*Hill(x;K_b,n_b)):
1462        - A_median, A_lower, A_upper: Baseline (intercept)
1463        - Vmax_a_median, Vmax_a_lower, Vmax_a_upper: Component A magnitude
1464        - K_a_median, K_a_lower, K_a_upper: Component A half-max (EC50)
1465        - EC50_a_median, EC50_a_lower, EC50_a_upper: Same as K_a (alias)
1466        - n_a_median, n_a_lower, n_a_upper: Component A Hill coefficient (cooperativity)
1467        - alpha_median, alpha_lower, alpha_upper: Component A weight
1468        - Vmax_b_median, Vmax_b_lower, Vmax_b_upper: Component B magnitude
1469        - K_b_median, K_b_lower, K_b_upper: Component B half-max (EC50)
1470        - EC50_b_median, EC50_b_lower, EC50_b_upper: Same as K_b (alias)
1471        - n_b_median, n_b_lower, n_b_upper: Component B Hill coefficient (cooperativity)
1472        - beta_median, beta_lower, beta_upper: Component B weight
1473        - pi_y_median, pi_y_lower, pi_y_upper: Sparsity weight (optional)
1474        - inflection_a_median, inflection_a_lower, inflection_a_upper: Component A inflection x
1475        - inflection_b_median, inflection_b_lower, inflection_b_upper: Component B inflection x
1476        - classification: Function shape classification based on dependency masks:
1477          - 'single_positive': Only one Hill component active, with positive n (increasing)
1478          - 'single_negative': Only one Hill component active, with negative n (decreasing)
1479          - 'additive_positive': Both components active, both with positive n
1480          - 'additive_negative': Both components active, both with negative n
1481          - 'non_monotonic_min': Both active, opposite signs, concave up at x=x_ntc (local min)
1482          - 'non_monotonic_max': Both active, opposite signs, concave down at x=x_ntc (local max)
1483          - 'flat': No active components
1484        - first_deriv_roots_median: Roots of first derivative (x values where dy/dx=0)
1485        - second_deriv_roots_median: Roots of second derivative (x values where d²y/dx²=0, inflections)
1486        - third_deriv_roots_median: Roots of third derivative (x values where d³y/dx³=0)
1487        - n_first_deriv_roots: Number of first derivative roots (0 for monotonic)
1488        - n_second_deriv_roots: Number of second derivative roots (inflection points)
1489        - n_third_deriv_roots: Number of third derivative roots
1490
1491        If compute_log2fc_params=True (log2FC relative to NTC):
1492        - x_ntc: NTC mean for cis gene (same for all trans genes)
1493        - y_ntc: NTC mean for each trans gene
1494        - log2fc_at_u0: log2FC value at u=0 (x = x_ntc), i.e., g(0) = log2(y(x_ntc)) - log2(y_ntc)
1495        - EC50_a_log2fc, EC50_b_log2fc: EC50 in log2FC x-space (log2(K) - log2(x_ntc))
1496        - inflection_a_log2fc_median, inflection_b_log2fc_median: Inflection points in log2FC x-space
1497
1498        For negbinom/normal/studentt (log2FC y-space):
1499        - dg_du_at_u0, dg_du_at_u0_lower, dg_du_at_u0_upper: First derivative of log2FC at u=0 with 95% CI
1500        - d2g_du2_at_u0, d2g_du2_at_u0_lower, d2g_du2_at_u0_upper: Second derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
1501        - d3g_du3_at_u0, d3g_du3_at_u0_lower, d3g_du3_at_u0_upper: Third derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
1502        - first_deriv_roots_log2fc_median: Roots of dg/du=0 in u-space (g = log2(y) - log2(y_ntc))
1503        - second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median: Roots of d²g/du²=0
1504        - third_deriv_roots_log2fc_median: Roots of d³g/du³=0
1505        - A_log2fc: Baseline in log2FC y-space (log2(A) - log2(y_ntc))
1506
1507        For binomial distributions (delta_p y-space):
1508        - delta_p_at_u0: Probability difference at u=0, i.e., p(x_ntc) - p_ntc
1509        - dp_du_at_u0, dp_du_at_u0_lower, dp_du_at_u0_upper: First derivative of delta_p at u=0 with 95% CI
1510        - d2p_du2_at_u0, d2p_du2_at_u0_lower, d2p_du2_at_u0_upper: Second derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
1511        - d3p_du3_at_u0, d3p_du3_at_u0_lower, d3p_du3_at_u0_upper: Third derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
1512        - first_deriv_roots_delta_p_median: Roots of dp/du=0 in u-space
1513        - second_deriv_roots_delta_p_median: Roots of d²p/du²=0
1514        - third_deriv_roots_delta_p_median: Roots of d³p/du³=0
1515        - A_delta_p: Baseline in delta_p space (A - y_ntc)
1516
1517        For single_hill:
1518        - B_median, B_lower, B_upper: Hill magnitude
1519        - K_median, K_lower, K_upper: Hill coefficient
1520        - xc_median, xc_lower, xc_upper: Half-max point (EC50 or IC50)
1521        - inflection_median, inflection_lower, inflection_upper: Inflection x
1522        - full_log2fc_median, full_log2fc_lower, full_log2fc_upper: Full dynamic range
1523
1524        For polynomial:
1525        - coef_{i}_median, coef_{i}_lower, coef_{i}_upper: Coefficient i
1526        - full_log2fc_median, full_log2fc_lower, full_log2fc_upper: Full dynamic range
1527
1528        Overdispersion and technical group effects (for simulation):
1529        - phi_y_median, phi_y_lower, phi_y_upper: NB overdispersion (phi_y = 1/o_y^2) from fit_trans
1530        - o_y_median, o_y_lower, o_y_upper: Posterior o_y (sqrt overdispersion) from fit_trans
1531        - o_y_ntc_median: Median o_y from fit_ntc (posterior_samples_ntc)
1532        - group_{g}_alpha_y_median: Technical group effect for group g (median, from fit_ntc)
1533
1534        Parameters
1535        ----------
1536        output_dir : str, optional
1537            Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label)
1538        modality_name : str, optional
1539            Modality to export (default: primary modality)
1540        compute_inflection : bool
1541            Whether to compute inflection points for Hill functions (default: True)
1542        compute_derivative_roots : bool
1543            Whether to compute roots of first and second derivatives (default: True).
1544            Roots are found empirically over the observed x_range.
1545        compute_log2fc_params : bool
1546            If True (default), compute parameters in log2FC space relative to NTC:
1547            - x-axis: log2(x) - log2(x_ntc) where x_ntc is cis gene NTC mean
1548            - y-axis: log2(y) - log2(y_ntc) where y_ntc is trans gene NTC mean
1549            Requires posterior_samples_ntc to be available, or x_ntc/y_ntc to be
1550            provided manually.
1551        x_ntc : float, optional
1552            Manually provided NTC mean for the cis gene (x-axis reference point).
1553            If None (default), computed from posterior_samples_ntc of the cis modality.
1554            Useful when fit_technical was not run (e.g., single-group subsets).
1555        y_ntc : array-like, optional
1556            Manually provided NTC means for each trans feature (y-axis reference points).
1557            Shape: (n_features,). If None (default), computed from posterior_samples_ntc
1558            of the trans modality.
1559        compute_lfc_ci : bool
1560            If True (default), compute 95% credible intervals for observed_log2fc and
1561            full_log2fc by iterating over all posterior samples. This is the main
1562            bottleneck for large feature sets (~1.5h for 20k features × 1000 samples).
1563            Set to False to skip the CI loops and use the posterior mean for lower/upper
1564            bounds instead. EC50_log2fc, inflection_log2fc, and all parameter CIs are
1565            unaffected — they remain fast vectorised computations.
1566        """
1567        if output_dir is None:
1568            output_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
1569
1570        if modality_name is None:
1571            modality_name = self.model.primary_modality
1572
1573        # Get modality
1574        modality = self.model.get_modality(modality_name)
1575
1576        # Check if trans fit has been run for this modality
1577        # Primary modality: use model-level posterior (model.posterior_samples_trans)
1578        # Non-primary modality: use modality-level posterior
1579        if modality_name == self.model.primary_modality:
1580            if not hasattr(self.model, 'posterior_samples_trans') or self.model.posterior_samples_trans is None:
1581                raise ValueError(f"Trans fit not found for primary modality '{modality_name}'. Run fit_trans() first.")
1582            posterior = self.model.posterior_samples_trans
1583        else:
1584            if not hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_trans') or modality.posterior_samples_trans is None:
1585                raise ValueError(f"Trans fit not found for modality '{modality_name}'. Run fit_trans(modality_name='{modality_name}') first.")
1586            posterior = modality.posterior_samples_trans
1587
1588        # Get feature names - prefer modality.feature_names (what users see and use)
1589        feature_meta = modality.feature_meta
1590
1591        # Extract per-feature actual category count for multinomial masking.
1592        # Used to identify phantom (padded) category slots so they are excluded
1593        # from FDR computation and the correct A_K (residual baseline) is selected.
1594        n_cats_per_feature = None
1595        if modality.distribution == 'multinomial' and feature_meta is not None and len(feature_meta) > 0:
1596            if 'n_categories' in feature_meta.columns:
1597                n_cats_per_feature = feature_meta['n_categories'].values.astype(int)
1598        if modality.feature_names is not None:
1599            # First priority: use modality.feature_names (this is what users see)
1600            feature_names = modality.feature_names
1601        elif feature_meta is not None and len(feature_meta) > 0:
1602            # Fallback: try feature_meta columns or index
1603            # Check if index is integer-based (RangeIndex or integer dtype)
1604            index_is_integer = (
1605                isinstance(feature_meta.index, pd.RangeIndex) or
1606                feature_meta.index.dtype in ['int64', 'int32', 'int']
1607            )
1608
1609            if index_is_integer:
1610                # Prefer named columns for feature identifiers
1611                if 'gene' in feature_meta.columns:
1612                    feature_names = feature_meta['gene'].tolist()
1613                elif 'gene_name' in feature_meta.columns:
1614                    feature_names = feature_meta['gene_name'].tolist()
1615                elif 'feature' in feature_meta.columns:
1616                    feature_names = feature_meta['feature'].tolist()
1617                else:
1618                    # Fall back to index
1619                    feature_names = feature_meta.index.tolist()
1620            else:
1621                # Index is named, use it
1622                feature_names = feature_meta.index.tolist()
1623        else:
1624            # No feature_names or feature_meta, use range
1625            feature_names = list(range(modality.counts.shape[0]))
1626
1627        n_features = len(feature_names)
1628
1629        # Optionally limit to first N features (useful for testing / debugging speed)
1630        if max_features is not None and max_features < n_features:
1631            _orig_n = n_features
1632            feature_names = feature_names[:max_features]
1633            n_features = max_features
1634            if n_cats_per_feature is not None:
1635                n_cats_per_feature = n_cats_per_feature[:max_features]
1636            posterior = self._subset_posterior_features(posterior, max_features, _orig_n)
1637            if verbose:
1638                print(f"[save_trans_summary] max_features={max_features}: "
1639                      f"using first {max_features} of {_orig_n} features")
1640
1641        # Determine function type from posterior keys
1642        keys = set(posterior.keys())
1643        if {'poly_coefs'} <= keys:
1644            function_type = 'polynomial'
1645        elif {'Vmax_a','K_a','n_a','Vmax_b','K_b','n_b'} <= keys:
1646            # Could be additive or nested; decide by presence of an indicator you store,
1647            # OR fall back to model setting if available.
1648            function_type = getattr(self.model, 'function_type', 'additive_hill')
1649        elif {'Vmax_a','K_a','n_a'} <= keys:
1650            function_type = 'single_hill'
1651        else:
1652            raise ValueError(
1653                f"Cannot determine function_type from posterior_samples_trans keys. "
1654                f"Found: {list(posterior.keys())}"
1655            )
1656
1657        # Initialize DataFrame with basic info
1658        data = {
1659            'feature': feature_names,
1660            'modality': modality_name,
1661            'distribution': modality.distribution,
1662            'function_type': function_type
1663        }
1664
1665        # Get x_range from model (guide-level x_true values)
1666        # This defines the "observed" x range as min to max of x_eff_g (guide-level x_true).
1667        # If the modality covers fewer cells than the model, use only the modality's cells
1668        # so x_obs_min/x_obs_max reflect the x values actually used during fitting.
1669        x_range = None
1670        x_obs_min = None
1671        x_obs_max = None
1672        if hasattr(self.model, 'x_true') and self.model.x_true is not None:
1673            x_true = self.model.x_true
1674            if isinstance(x_true, torch.Tensor):
1675                x_true = x_true.cpu().numpy()
1676            if x_true.ndim > 1:
1677                x_true = x_true.mean(axis=0)  # Average over posterior samples
1678            # Subset to modality cells when the modality covers fewer cells than the model
1679            if modality.cell_names is not None:
1680                all_model_cells = self.model.meta['cell'].tolist()
1681                _cidx_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(all_model_cells)}
1682                _cidx = [_cidx_map[c] for c in modality.cell_names if c in _cidx_map]
1683                x_true = x_true[_cidx]
1684            # Store observed x range (min to max of guide-level x_true)
1685            x_obs_min = max(x_true.min(), 1e-6)
1686            x_obs_max = x_true.max()
1687            x_range, x_obs_min, x_obs_max = self._build_x_range_from_x_true(x_true, n_grid=6000, eps=1e-6)
1688            data['x_obs_min'] = x_obs_min
1689            data['x_obs_max'] = x_obs_max
1690
1691
1692        # Get x_ntc and y_ntc for log2FC parameter computation.
1693        # Always look these up and add to data if found — they are useful metadata
1694        # regardless of whether compute_log2fc_params is True.
1695        _x_ntc = float(x_ntc) if x_ntc is not None else None
1696        _y_ntc = np.asarray(y_ntc) if y_ntc is not None else None
1697
1698        # x_ntc: from cis modality's technical fit (mu_ntc averaged over samples/groups)
1699        if _x_ntc is None:
1700            try:
1701                cis_mod = self.model.get_modality('cis')
1702                if hasattr(cis_mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc') and cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc is not None:
1703                    if 'mu_ntc' in cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc:
1704                        mu_ntc_cis = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc['mu_ntc']
1705                        if isinstance(mu_ntc_cis, torch.Tensor):
1706                            mu_ntc_cis = mu_ntc_cis.cpu().numpy()
1707                        _x_ntc = float(mu_ntc_cis.mean())
1708            except Exception:
1709                pass
1710
1711        # y_ntc: from trans modality's technical fit (mu_ntc averaged over posterior samples → [T])
1712        if _y_ntc is None:
1713            if hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc') and modality.posterior_samples_ntc is not None:
1714                if 'mu_ntc' in modality.posterior_samples_ntc:
1715                    mu_ntc_trans = modality.posterior_samples_ntc['mu_ntc']
1716                    if isinstance(mu_ntc_trans, torch.Tensor):
1717                        mu_ntc_trans = mu_ntc_trans.cpu().numpy()
1718                    while mu_ntc_trans.ndim > 2:
1719                        mu_ntc_trans = mu_ntc_trans.mean(axis=0)
1720                    _y_ntc = mu_ntc_trans.mean(axis=0)
1721
1722        # Subset y_ntc to match max_features if applied
1723        if max_features is not None and _y_ntc is not None:
1724            _y_ntc_arr = np.asarray(_y_ntc)
1725            if _y_ntc_arr.ndim >= 1 and _y_ntc_arr.shape[0] > max_features:
1726                _y_ntc = _y_ntc_arr[:max_features]
1727
1728        # Guard: y_ntc must match n_features.  A common cause of mismatch is that
1729        # posterior_samples_ntc['mu_ntc'] was not subsetted when the modality was
1730        # subsetted to fewer features (e.g. a random 100-gene subset).  When the
1731        # modality has feature_names we try to align by name; otherwise we fall back
1732        # to discarding y_ntc so the rest of the summary still completes.
1733        if _y_ntc is not None and np.asarray(_y_ntc).shape[0] != n_features:
1734            _y_ntc_arr = np.asarray(_y_ntc)
1735            aligned = False
1736            # Try name-based alignment
1737            ntc_feat_names = None
1738            if (hasattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc')
1739                    and isinstance(modality.posterior_samples_ntc, dict)):
1740                ntc_feat_names = modality.posterior_samples_ntc.get('feature_names')
1741            cur_feat_names = getattr(modality, 'feature_names', None)
1742            if ntc_feat_names is not None and cur_feat_names is not None:
1743                ntc_idx_map = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(ntc_feat_names)}
1744                subset_idx = [ntc_idx_map.get(n, -1) for n in cur_feat_names]
1745                if all(si >= 0 for si in subset_idx):
1746                    _y_ntc = _y_ntc_arr[subset_idx]
1747                    aligned = True
1748            if not aligned:
1749                print(
1750                    f"[WARNING] y_ntc length ({_y_ntc_arr.shape[0]}) does not match "
1751                    f"n_features ({n_features}) and cannot be aligned by feature name. "
1752                    f"y_ntc will be ignored for log2FC computation. "
1753                    f"To fix: subset posterior_samples_ntc['mu_ntc'] to match the current "
1754                    f"modality features, or pass y_ntc manually to save_trans_summary()."
1755                )
1756                _y_ntc = None
1757
1758        # Always add x_ntc / y_ntc to data if available (useful metadata even without log2fc params)
1759        if _x_ntc is not None:
1760            data['x_ntc'] = _x_ntc
1761        if _y_ntc is not None:
1762            data['y_ntc'] = _y_ntc
1763
1764        if compute_log2fc_params:
1765            if _x_ntc is None:
1766                print("[WARNING] Cannot compute log2FC params: x_ntc not available from cis modality. "
1767                      "Provide x_ntc manually to save_trans_summary().")
1768                compute_log2fc_params = False
1769            if _y_ntc is None:
1770                print("[WARNING] Cannot compute log2FC params: y_ntc not available from trans modality. "
1771                      "Provide y_ntc manually to save_trans_summary().")
1772                compute_log2fc_params = False
1773
1774        # Add function-specific parameters
1775        _S = next((v.shape[0] for v in posterior.values()
1776                   if isinstance(v, (np.ndarray, torch.Tensor)) and
1777                   (v.numpy() if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else v).ndim >= 2), '?')
1778        if verbose:
1779            print(f"\n[save_trans_summary] function_type={function_type}  "
1780                  f"n_features={n_features}  posterior_samples={_S}")
1781            print(f"  compute_derivative_roots={compute_derivative_roots}  "
1782                  f"compute_log2fc_params={compute_log2fc_params}  "
1783                  f"compute_inflection={compute_inflection}")
1784            print(f"  x_ntc={'set' if _x_ntc is not None else 'None'}  "
1785                  f"y_ntc={'set' if _y_ntc is not None else 'None'}")
1786        _t0 = time.time()
1787
1788        if function_type == 'additive_hill':
1789            data = self._add_additive_hill_params(
1790                data, posterior, n_features,
1791                compute_inflection,
1792                compute_derivative_roots, x_range,
1793                compute_log2fc_params, _x_ntc, _y_ntc,
1794                x_obs_min, x_obs_max,
1795                n_cats_per_feature=n_cats_per_feature,
1796                compute_lfc_ci=compute_lfc_ci,
1797                verbose=verbose,
1798            )
1799        elif function_type == 'single_hill':
1800            data = self._add_single_hill_params(
1801                data, posterior, n_features,
1802                compute_inflection=compute_inflection,
1803                compute_derivative_roots=compute_derivative_roots,
1804                x_range=x_range,
1805                x_obs_min=x_obs_min,
1806                x_obs_max=x_obs_max,
1807                compute_log2fc_params=compute_log2fc_params,
1808                compute_lfc_ci=compute_lfc_ci,
1809                x_ntc=_x_ntc,
1810                y_ntc=_y_ntc,
1811                verbose=verbose,
1812            )
1813        elif function_type == 'polynomial':
1814            data = self._add_polynomial_params(
1815                data, posterior, n_features,
1816                compute_derivative_roots=compute_derivative_roots,
1817                compute_log2fc_params=compute_log2fc_params,
1818                x_range=x_range,
1819                x_obs_min=x_obs_min,
1820                x_obs_max=x_obs_max,
1821                verbose=verbose,
1822            )
1823        if verbose:
1824            print(f"  _add_{function_type}_params: {time.time() - _t0:.1f}s")
1825
1826        # Compute Bayesian q-values (FDR columns) for Hill components
1827        _t0 = time.time()
1828        fdr_cols = self._compute_bayesian_fdr(posterior, function_type, n_features,
1829                                              n_cats_per_feature=n_cats_per_feature)
1830        data.update(fdr_cols)
1831        if verbose:
1832            print(f"  _compute_bayesian_fdr:      {time.time() - _t0:.1f}s")
1833
1834        # Add phi_y (overdispersion) from posterior o_y: phi_y = 1 / o_y^2
1835        # Also add o_y directly.
1836        if 'o_y' in posterior:
1837            o_y = posterior['o_y']
1838            if isinstance(o_y, torch.Tensor):
1839                o_y = o_y.cpu().numpy()
1840            # Handle [n_samples, n_features] or [n_samples, 1, n_features]
1841            if o_y.ndim == 3 and o_y.shape[1] == 1:
1842                o_y = o_y.squeeze(1)
1843            phi_y = 1.0 / (o_y ** 2)
1844            if phi_y.ndim >= 2:
1845                data['phi_y_median'] = np.median(phi_y, axis=0)
1846                data['phi_y_lower'] = np.quantile(phi_y, 0.025, axis=0)
1847                data['phi_y_upper'] = np.quantile(phi_y, 0.975, axis=0)
1848                data['o_y_median'] = np.median(o_y, axis=0)
1849                data['o_y_lower'] = np.quantile(o_y, 0.025, axis=0)
1850                data['o_y_upper'] = np.quantile(o_y, 0.975, axis=0)
1851            else:
1852                data['phi_y_median'] = phi_y
1853                data['phi_y_lower'] = phi_y
1854                data['phi_y_upper'] = phi_y
1855                data['o_y_median'] = o_y
1856                data['o_y_lower'] = o_y
1857                data['o_y_upper'] = o_y
1858
1859        # Add fit_ntc o_y (median across posterior samples, per feature)
1860        ps_ntc = getattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc', None) or {}
1861        ntc_oy = ps_ntc.get('o_y')
1862        if ntc_oy is not None:
1863            if isinstance(ntc_oy, torch.Tensor):
1864                ntc_oy = ntc_oy.cpu().numpy()
1865            if ntc_oy.ndim == 3 and ntc_oy.shape[1] == 1:
1866                ntc_oy = ntc_oy.squeeze(1)
1867            if ntc_oy.ndim >= 2:
1868                data['o_y_ntc_median'] = np.median(ntc_oy, axis=0)[:n_features]
1869            else:
1870                data['o_y_ntc_median'] = ntc_oy[:n_features]
1871
1872        # Add alpha_y (technical group effects) from modality.alpha_y_prefit
1873        if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit') and modality.alpha_y_prefit is not None:
1874            # Get alpha_y (prefer distribution-specific versions)
1875            if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_mult') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_mult is not None:
1876                alpha_y_tech = modality.alpha_y_prefit_mult
1877            elif hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None:
1878                alpha_y_tech = modality.alpha_y_prefit_add
1879            else:
1880                alpha_y_tech = modality.alpha_y_prefit
1881            if isinstance(alpha_y_tech, torch.Tensor):
1882                alpha_y_tech = alpha_y_tech.cpu().numpy()
1883            # Shape: [n_samples, n_groups, n_features] (legacy posterior) or [n_groups, n_features] (point)
1884            if alpha_y_tech.ndim == 3:
1885                alpha_y_median = np.median(alpha_y_tech, axis=0)  # [n_groups, n_features]
1886            elif alpha_y_tech.ndim == 2:
1887                alpha_y_median = alpha_y_tech  # already [n_groups, n_features] point estimate
1888            else:
1889                alpha_y_median = None
1890            if alpha_y_median is not None and alpha_y_median.ndim == 2:
1891                n_groups = alpha_y_median.shape[0]
1892                for g in range(n_groups):
1893                    data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_median'] = alpha_y_median[g, :n_features]
1894
1895        df = pd.DataFrame(data)
1896
1897        # Merge with feature_meta from modality
1898        if modality.feature_meta is not None and len(modality.feature_meta) > 0:
1899            # Reset index to get feature names as a column for merging
1900            feature_meta_df = modality.feature_meta.reset_index()
1901            # Rename index column to avoid conflicts
1902            if 'index' in feature_meta_df.columns:
1903                feature_meta_df = feature_meta_df.rename(columns={'index': 'feature_meta_idx'})
1904
1905            # Ensure feature column is string type for consistent merging
1906            df['feature'] = df['feature'].astype(str)
1907
1908            # Merge on feature names - try to match by index or common columns
1909            if 'feature' in feature_meta_df.columns:
1910                feature_meta_df['feature'] = feature_meta_df['feature'].astype(str)
1911                df = df.merge(feature_meta_df, on='feature', how='left')
1912            elif 'gene' in feature_meta_df.columns:
1913                feature_meta_df['gene'] = feature_meta_df['gene'].astype(str)
1914                df = df.merge(feature_meta_df, left_on='feature', right_on='gene', how='left')
1915            elif 'gene_name' in feature_meta_df.columns:
1916                feature_meta_df['gene_name'] = feature_meta_df['gene_name'].astype(str)
1917                df = df.merge(feature_meta_df, left_on='feature', right_on='gene_name', how='left')
1918            else:
1919                # Try direct concatenation if feature order matches
1920                if len(feature_meta_df) == len(df):
1921                    for col in feature_meta_df.columns:
1922                        if col not in df.columns:
1923                            df[col] = feature_meta_df[col].values
1924
1925        # Save
1926        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
1927        output_file = os.path.join(output_dir, f'trans_feature_summary_{modality_name}.csv')
1928        df.to_csv(output_file, index=False)
1929
1930        print(f"[SAVE] Trans summary saved to {output_file}")
1931        print(f"       {n_features} features, function_type={function_type}")
1932
1933        return df

Save trans fit parameters as feature-wise CSV.

Creates: trans_feature_summary_{modality}.csv

Columns (depend on function_type and distribution):

  • feature: Feature name
  • modality: Modality name
  • distribution: Distribution type
  • function_type: Function type (additive_hill, single_hill, polynomial)
  • x_obs_min, x_obs_max: Observed x range (min/max of guide-level x_true)

For negbinom/normal/studentt distributions:

  • observed_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over observed x range from fitted function
  • full_log2fc_median/lower/upper: log2(y_max / y_min) over theoretical x range (0 to ∞)

For binomial distributions (e.g., splicing_sj):

  • observed_delta_p: y_max - y_min over observed x range (probability difference)
  • full_delta_p_median/lower/upper: y_max - y_min over theoretical x range

FDR columns (all function types):

  • fdr_alpha: Bayesian q-value for component A (positive Hill, or the single Hill component in single_hill). The minimum expected FDR among all called sets that include this feature's component A. Analogous to a Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value: calling all features with fdr_alpha <= q controls the expected false discovery rate at q. For additive_hill, computed over the pooled family of 2*n_features tests (alpha + beta), which accounts for the increased multiple-testing burden relative to single_hill.
  • fdr_beta: Bayesian q-value for component B (negative Hill). NaN for single_hill and polynomial. Computed in the same pooled family as fdr_alpha for additive_hill.

For additive_hill (all parameters needed to recreate: y = A + alphaVmax_aHill(x;K_a,n_a) + betaVmax_bHill(x;K_b,n_b)):

  • A_median, A_lower, A_upper: Baseline (intercept)
  • Vmax_a_median, Vmax_a_lower, Vmax_a_upper: Component A magnitude
  • K_a_median, K_a_lower, K_a_upper: Component A half-max (EC50)
  • EC50_a_median, EC50_a_lower, EC50_a_upper: Same as K_a (alias)
  • n_a_median, n_a_lower, n_a_upper: Component A Hill coefficient (cooperativity)
  • alpha_median, alpha_lower, alpha_upper: Component A weight
  • Vmax_b_median, Vmax_b_lower, Vmax_b_upper: Component B magnitude
  • K_b_median, K_b_lower, K_b_upper: Component B half-max (EC50)
  • EC50_b_median, EC50_b_lower, EC50_b_upper: Same as K_b (alias)
  • n_b_median, n_b_lower, n_b_upper: Component B Hill coefficient (cooperativity)
  • beta_median, beta_lower, beta_upper: Component B weight
  • pi_y_median, pi_y_lower, pi_y_upper: Sparsity weight (optional)
  • inflection_a_median, inflection_a_lower, inflection_a_upper: Component A inflection x
  • inflection_b_median, inflection_b_lower, inflection_b_upper: Component B inflection x
  • classification: Function shape classification based on dependency masks:
    • 'single_positive': Only one Hill component active, with positive n (increasing)
    • 'single_negative': Only one Hill component active, with negative n (decreasing)
    • 'additive_positive': Both components active, both with positive n
    • 'additive_negative': Both components active, both with negative n
    • 'non_monotonic_min': Both active, opposite signs, concave up at x=x_ntc (local min)
    • 'non_monotonic_max': Both active, opposite signs, concave down at x=x_ntc (local max)
    • 'flat': No active components
  • first_deriv_roots_median: Roots of first derivative (x values where dy/dx=0)
  • second_deriv_roots_median: Roots of second derivative (x values where d²y/dx²=0, inflections)
  • third_deriv_roots_median: Roots of third derivative (x values where d³y/dx³=0)
  • n_first_deriv_roots: Number of first derivative roots (0 for monotonic)
  • n_second_deriv_roots: Number of second derivative roots (inflection points)
  • n_third_deriv_roots: Number of third derivative roots

If compute_log2fc_params=True (log2FC relative to NTC):

  • x_ntc: NTC mean for cis gene (same for all trans genes)
  • y_ntc: NTC mean for each trans gene
  • log2fc_at_u0: log2FC value at u=0 (x = x_ntc), i.e., g(0) = log2(y(x_ntc)) - log2(y_ntc)
  • EC50_a_log2fc, EC50_b_log2fc: EC50 in log2FC x-space (log2(K) - log2(x_ntc))
  • inflection_a_log2fc_median, inflection_b_log2fc_median: Inflection points in log2FC x-space

For negbinom/normal/studentt (log2FC y-space):

  • dg_du_at_u0, dg_du_at_u0_lower, dg_du_at_u0_upper: First derivative of log2FC at u=0 with 95% CI
  • d2g_du2_at_u0, d2g_du2_at_u0_lower, d2g_du2_at_u0_upper: Second derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
  • d3g_du3_at_u0, d3g_du3_at_u0_lower, d3g_du3_at_u0_upper: Third derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
  • first_deriv_roots_log2fc_median: Roots of dg/du=0 in u-space (g = log2(y) - log2(y_ntc))
  • second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median: Roots of d²g/du²=0
  • third_deriv_roots_log2fc_median: Roots of d³g/du³=0
  • A_log2fc: Baseline in log2FC y-space (log2(A) - log2(y_ntc))

For binomial distributions (delta_p y-space):

  • delta_p_at_u0: Probability difference at u=0, i.e., p(x_ntc) - p_ntc
  • dp_du_at_u0, dp_du_at_u0_lower, dp_du_at_u0_upper: First derivative of delta_p at u=0 with 95% CI
  • d2p_du2_at_u0, d2p_du2_at_u0_lower, d2p_du2_at_u0_upper: Second derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
  • d3p_du3_at_u0, d3p_du3_at_u0_lower, d3p_du3_at_u0_upper: Third derivative at u=0 with 95% CI
  • first_deriv_roots_delta_p_median: Roots of dp/du=0 in u-space
  • second_deriv_roots_delta_p_median: Roots of d²p/du²=0
  • third_deriv_roots_delta_p_median: Roots of d³p/du³=0
  • A_delta_p: Baseline in delta_p space (A - y_ntc)

For single_hill:

  • B_median, B_lower, B_upper: Hill magnitude
  • K_median, K_lower, K_upper: Hill coefficient
  • xc_median, xc_lower, xc_upper: Half-max point (EC50 or IC50)
  • inflection_median, inflection_lower, inflection_upper: Inflection x
  • full_log2fc_median, full_log2fc_lower, full_log2fc_upper: Full dynamic range

For polynomial:

  • coef_{i}_median, coef_{i}_lower, coef_{i}_upper: Coefficient i
  • full_log2fc_median, full_log2fc_lower, full_log2fc_upper: Full dynamic range

Overdispersion and technical group effects (for simulation):

  • phi_y_median, phi_y_lower, phi_y_upper: NB overdispersion (phi_y = 1/o_y^2) from fit_trans
  • o_y_median, o_y_lower, o_y_upper: Posterior o_y (sqrt overdispersion) from fit_trans
  • o_y_ntc_median: Median o_y from fit_ntc (posterior_samples_ntc)
  • group_{g}_alpha_y_median: Technical group effect for group g (median, from fit_ntc)

Parameters

output_dir : str, optional Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label) modality_name : str, optional Modality to export (default: primary modality) compute_inflection : bool Whether to compute inflection points for Hill functions (default: True) compute_derivative_roots : bool Whether to compute roots of first and second derivatives (default: True). Roots are found empirically over the observed x_range. compute_log2fc_params : bool If True (default), compute parameters in log2FC space relative to NTC: - x-axis: log2(x) - log2(x_ntc) where x_ntc is cis gene NTC mean - y-axis: log2(y) - log2(y_ntc) where y_ntc is trans gene NTC mean Requires posterior_samples_ntc to be available, or x_ntc/y_ntc to be provided manually. x_ntc : float, optional Manually provided NTC mean for the cis gene (x-axis reference point). If None (default), computed from posterior_samples_ntc of the cis modality. Useful when fit_technical was not run (e.g., single-group subsets). y_ntc : array-like, optional Manually provided NTC means for each trans feature (y-axis reference points). Shape: (n_features,). If None (default), computed from posterior_samples_ntc of the trans modality. compute_lfc_ci : bool If True (default), compute 95% credible intervals for observed_log2fc and full_log2fc by iterating over all posterior samples. This is the main bottleneck for large feature sets (~1.5h for 20k features × 1000 samples). Set to False to skip the CI loops and use the posterior mean for lower/upper bounds instead. EC50_log2fc, inflection_log2fc, and all parameter CIs are unaffected — they remain fast vectorised computations.

def classify_second_deriv_roots( self, df: pandas.core.frame.DataFrame, root_col: str = 'second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median', tol_f: float = 1e-10, tol_f3: float = 1e-12) -> pandas.core.frame.DataFrame: 
4796    def classify_second_deriv_roots(
4797        self,
4798        df: "pd.DataFrame",
4799        root_col: str = "second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median",
4800        tol_f: float = 1e-10,
4801        tol_f3: float = 1e-12,
4802    ) -> "pd.DataFrame":
4803        """
4804        Classify second-derivative roots as local maxima or minima of |g'(u)|.
4805
4806        At each root u* where g''(u*) = 0, the first derivative g'(u) is either at a
4807        local maximum or minimum of its absolute value:
4808          - sign(g') * g'''  > 0  →  local_min_abs  (|g'| decreasing through u*)
4809          - sign(g') * g'''  < 0  →  local_max_abs  (|g'| increasing through u*)
4810          - g' ≈ 0                →  local_min_abs  (|g'| can't go below 0)
4811
4812        Only supported for additive_hill function type.  Rows with missing parameters
4813        or no roots are skipped.
4814
4815        Parameters
4816        ----------
4817        df : pd.DataFrame
4818            Summary DataFrame returned by ``save_trans_summary`` (with
4819            ``compute_derivative_roots=True``).  Required columns:
4820            ``feature``, ``x_ntc``, ``A_median``, ``alpha_median``, ``beta_median``,
4821            ``Vmax_a_median``, ``K_a_median``, ``n_a_median``, ``Vmax_b_median``,
4822            ``K_b_median``, ``n_b_median``, and the root column specified by
4823            ``root_col``.
4824        root_col : str
4825            Column in *df* containing the semicolon-separated root strings to
4826            evaluate (default: ``"second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median"``).
4827        tol_f : float
4828            Absolute tolerance below which g'(u) is treated as zero (default 1e-10).
4829        tol_f3 : float
4830            Absolute tolerance below which g'''(u) is treated as zero (default 1e-12).
4831
4832        Returns
4833        -------
4834        pd.DataFrame
4835            One row per (feature, root) with columns:
4836            - ``feature``: feature name
4837            - ``u_root``: the root value in log2FC space
4838            - ``dg_du``: first derivative g'(u) at the root
4839            - ``d3g_du3``: third derivative g'''(u) at the root
4840            - ``abs_dg_du``: absolute value of g'(u)
4841            - ``extremum_type_abs``: ``"local_min_abs"``, ``"local_max_abs"``,
4842              or ``"ambiguous"``
4843            - ``classification``: the feature's classification column from *df*
4844              (passed through unchanged, NaN if absent)
4845
4846        Examples
4847        --------
4848        >>> df = model.save_trans_summary(compute_derivative_roots=True)
4849        >>> df_roots = model.classify_second_deriv_roots(df)
4850        >>> # Keep only clear local maxima of rate of change
4851        >>> peaks = df_roots[df_roots["extremum_type_abs"] == "local_max_abs"]
4852        """
4853        required_params = ["x_ntc", "A_median", "alpha_median", "beta_median",
4854                           "Vmax_a_median", "K_a_median", "n_a_median",
4855                           "Vmax_b_median", "K_b_median", "n_b_median"]
4856        missing = [c for c in ["feature", root_col] + required_params if c not in df.columns]
4857        if missing:
4858            raise ValueError(
4859                f"classify_second_deriv_roots: DataFrame is missing required columns: {missing}. "
4860                "Ensure save_trans_summary was called with compute_derivative_roots=True and "
4861                "function_type='additive_hill'."
4862            )
4863
4864        rows = []
4865        for _, r in df.iterrows():
4866            roots_u = self._parse_semicolon_roots(r.get(root_col, ""))
4867            if not roots_u:
4868                continue
4869
4870            try:
4871                x_ntc  = float(r["x_ntc"])
4872                A      = float(r["A_median"])
4873                alpha  = float(r["alpha_median"])
4874                beta   = float(r["beta_median"])
4875                Vmax_a = float(r["Vmax_a_median"])
4876                K_a    = float(r["K_a_median"])
4877                n_a    = float(r["n_a_median"])
4878                Vmax_b = float(r["Vmax_b_median"])
4879                K_b    = float(r["K_b_median"])
4880                n_b    = float(r["n_b_median"])
4881            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
4882                continue
4883
4884            u_arr = np.array(roots_u, dtype=float)
4885            g1, _g2, g3 = self._g_derivs_at_u(
4886                u_arr, A, alpha, Vmax_a, K_a, n_a, beta, Vmax_b, K_b, n_b, x_ntc
4887            )
4888
4889            feat = r["feature"]
4890            classif = r.get("classification", None)
4891            for u, dg_du, d3g_du3 in zip(roots_u, g1, g3):
4892                rows.append({
4893                    "feature":        feat,
4894                    "u_root":         u,
4895                    "dg_du":          dg_du,
4896                    "d3g_du3":        d3g_du3,
4897                    "classification": classif,
4898                })
4899
4900        if not rows:
4901            return pd.DataFrame(columns=["feature", "u_root", "dg_du", "d3g_du3",
4902                                         "abs_dg_du", "extremum_type_abs", "classification"])
4903
4904        df_roots = pd.DataFrame(rows)
4905        df_roots = (df_roots
4906                    .replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
4907                    .dropna(subset=["u_root", "dg_du", "d3g_du3"])
4908                    .reset_index(drop=True))
4909
4910        f  = df_roots["dg_du"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
4911        f3 = df_roots["d3g_du3"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
4912
4913        sgn_f = np.zeros_like(f)
4914        sgn_f[f >  tol_f] =  1.0
4915        sgn_f[f < -tol_f] = -1.0
4916
4917        curv_abs = sgn_f * f3
4918
4919        ext_type = np.full(len(df_roots), "ambiguous", dtype=object)
4920        # |g'| ~ 0 → can only be a minimum of |g'|
4921        ext_type[np.abs(f) <= tol_f] = "local_min_abs"
4922        mask = np.abs(f) > tol_f
4923        ext_type[mask & (curv_abs >  tol_f3)] = "local_min_abs"
4924        ext_type[mask & (curv_abs < -tol_f3)] = "local_max_abs"
4925
4926        df_roots["extremum_type_abs"] = ext_type
4927        df_roots["abs_dg_du"]         = np.abs(f)
4928
4929        return df_roots

Classify second-derivative roots as local maxima or minima of |g'(u)|.

At each root u* where g''(u*) = 0, the first derivative g'(u) is either at a local maximum or minimum of its absolute value:

  • sign(g') * g''' > 0 → local_min_abs (|g'| decreasing through u*)
  • sign(g') * g''' < 0 → local_max_abs (|g'| increasing through u*)
  • g' ≈ 0 → local_min_abs (|g'| can't go below 0)

Only supported for additive_hill function type. Rows with missing parameters or no roots are skipped.

Parameters

df : pd.DataFrame Summary DataFrame returned by save_trans_summary (with compute_derivative_roots=True). Required columns: feature, x_ntc, A_median, alpha_median, beta_median, Vmax_a_median, K_a_median, n_a_median, Vmax_b_median, K_b_median, n_b_median, and the root column specified by root_col. root_col : str Column in df containing the semicolon-separated root strings to evaluate (default: "second_deriv_roots_log2fc_median"). tol_f : float Absolute tolerance below which g'(u) is treated as zero (default 1e-10). tol_f3 : float Absolute tolerance below which g'''(u) is treated as zero (default 1e-12).

Returns

pd.DataFrame One row per (feature, root) with columns: - feature: feature name - u_root: the root value in log2FC space - dg_du: first derivative g'(u) at the root - d3g_du3: third derivative g'''(u) at the root - abs_dg_du: absolute value of g'(u) - extremum_type_abs: "local_min_abs", "local_max_abs", or "ambiguous" - classification: the feature's classification column from df (passed through unchanged, NaN if absent)

Examples

>>> df = model.save_trans_summary(compute_derivative_roots=True)
>>> df_roots = model.classify_second_deriv_roots(df)
>>> # Keep only clear local maxima of rate of change
>>> peaks = df_roots[df_roots["extremum_type_abs"] == "local_max_abs"]
